title: Pentateuhul Samaritean — Levitic
description: Levitic din Pentateuhul Samaritean, păstrând textul samaritean, versetele și textul englez din sursa de bază, cu adaptare în limba română.

samaritan_hebrew.dataset: DT-UCPH/sp - Text-Fabric Dataset of the Samaritan Pentateuch
samaritan_hebrew.project: Samaritanus project, Martin-Luther-Universitat Halle-Wittenberg (dir. Stefan Schorch)
manuscripts: MS Dublin Chester Beatty Library 751 (Genesis 1 - Deuteronomy 32:36)
samaritan_hebrew.critical_edition: Stefan Schorch (ed.), The Samaritan Pentateuch: A Critical editio maior, Berlin: de Gruyter, 2018-
samaritan_hebrew.processing: Verse text rendered via the Text-Fabric text API (T.text); NFKC normalisation; combining marks (vowel/consonant-disambiguation points) stripped; whitespace collapsed to produce clean consonantal Hebrew in standard square script.

english_translation.alignment_method: For each verse, the Alamo Polyglot Samaritan Hebrew column was compared (after the same normalisation) to the Chester Beatty 751/Garizim 1 Hebrew at the same (book, chapter, verse). English was attached only when the two Hebrew texts matched closely (identical or minor orthographic variants). Where the Samaritan verse divisions diverge from the English source's verse scheme (observed in parts of Genesis 32, Exodus 7-8 and 20, Leviticus 5-6, Numbers 16-17 and 21), the source English describes a different, shifted verse, so it was withheld rather than misattached.

verse_scheme: Samaritan Pentateuch verse divisions, as transcribed in DT-UCPH/sp from the source manuscripts

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא אל משה וידבר יהוה אליו מאהל מועד לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a chemat unto Moise, și a vorbit lui out of Cortul Întâlnirii, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם אדם כי יקריב מכם קרבן ליהוה מן הבהמה מן הבקר או מן הצאן תקריבו את קרבניכם
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the LORD, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, [even] of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, dacă vreun om al vostru a aduce an jertfă unto DOMNUL, să a aduce vostru jertfă of the cattle, [even] of the cireadă, și of the turmă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם עלה קרבנו מן הבקר זכר תמים יקריבנו אל פתח אהל מועד יקריב אתו לרצונו לפני יהוה
verses.english: If his offering [be] a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD.
verses.romanian: dacă lui jertfă [fi] a ardere-de-tot of the cireadă, let lui a aduce a mascul fără cusur: el să a aduce it of lui own voluntary will at the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך את ידו על ראש העלה ונרצה לו לכפר עליו
verses.english: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.romanian: și el să a pune lui hand upon the cap of the ardere-de-tot; și it shall fi accepted pentru el to a face ispășire pentru el.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושחט את בן הבקר לפני יהוה והקריבו בני אהרן הכהנים את הדם וזרקו את הדם על המזבח סביב אשר פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And he shall kill the bullock before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that [is by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și el să a ucide the vițel înainte DOMNUL: și the preoți, Aaron's fii, shall a aduce the sânge, și a stropi the sânge round about upon altarul că [este by] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והפשיטו את העלה ונתחו אתה לנתחיה
verses.english: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.romanian: și el să flay the ardere-de-tot, și a tăia it into lui pieces.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנו בני אהרן הכהנים אש על המזבח וערכו עצים על האש
verses.english: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.romanian: și the fii of Aaron the preot shall a pune foc upon altarul, și lay the lemn in order upon the foc:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וערכו בני אהרן הכהנים את הנתחים ואת הראש ואת הפדר על העצים אשר על האש אשר על המזבח
verses.english: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, and the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that [is] on the fire which [is] upon the altar:
verses.romanian: și the preoți, Aaron's fii, shall lay the parts, și the cap, și the fat, in order upon the lemn că [este] on the foc care [este] upon altarul:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקרבו וכרעיו ירחצו במים והקטיר הכהן הכל המזבחה עלה הוא אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, [to be] a burnt sacrifice, it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: dar lui inwards și lui legs shall he a spăla in apă: și the preot shall a arde toți on altarul, [to fi] a ardere-de-tot, it este an jertfă mistuită de foc, of a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מן הצאן עלה קרבנו ליהוה מן הכשבים או מן העזים זכר תמים יקריבנו אל פתח אהל מועד יקריב אתו
verses.english: And if his burnt offering to the LORD [be] of the flocks, [namely], of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish. To the entrance of the Tent of Appointment he shall bring it.
verses.romanian: și dacă lui ardere-de-tot to DOMNUL [fi] of the flocks, [namely], of the sheep, sau of the țapi, căci a ardere-de-tot; el să a aduce it a mascul fără cusur. To the entrance of the Tent of Appointment el să a aduce it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושחט אתו על ירך המזבח צפונה לפני יהוה וזרקו בני אהרן הכהנים את דמו על המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the LORD: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.romanian: și el să a ucide it on the latură of altarul northward înainte DOMNUL: și the preoți, Aaron's fii, shall a stropi lui sânge round about upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתחו אתו לנתחיו ואת ראשו ואת פדרו יעריך הכהן אתם על העצים אשר על האש אשר על המזבח
verses.english: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that [is] on the fire which [is] upon the altar:
verses.romanian: și el să a tăia it into lui pieces, cu lui cap și lui fat: the preot shall lay ei in order on the lemn că [este] on the foc care [este] upon altarul:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרב והכרעים ירחץ במים והקריב הכהן את הכל והקטיר המזבחה עלה הוא אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring [it] all, and burn [it] upon the altar: it [is] a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: dar el să a spăla the inwards și the legs cu apă: și the preot shall a aduce [it] toți, și a arde [it] upon altarul: it [este] a ardere-de-tot, an jertfă mistuită de foc, of a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מן העוף עלה קרבנו ליהוה והקריב מן התרים או מבני היונה את קרבנו
verses.english: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the LORD [be] of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.romanian: și dacă the ardere-de-tot căci lui jertfă to DOMNUL [fi] of fowls, atunci el să a aduce lui jertfă of turtledoves, sau of young pigeons.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריבו הכהן אל המזבח ומלק את ראשו והקטיר המזבחה ונמצא דמו אל קיר המזבח
verses.english: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn [it] on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a aduce it unto altarul, și wring off lui cap, și a arde [it] on altarul; și the sânge thereof shall fi wrung out at the latură of altarul:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והסיר את מרתו בנצתו והשליך אתו אצל המזבח קדמה אל מקום הדשן
verses.english: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.romanian: și el să pluck away lui crop cu lui feathers, și cast it beside altarul on the east part, by the loc of the ashes:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושסע אתו בכנפיו ולא יבדל והקטיר אתו הכהן המזבחה על העצים אשר על האש עלה הוא אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide [it] asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that [is] upon the fire: it [is] a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și el să cleave it cu the wings thereof, dar shall nu divide [it] asunder: și the preot shall a arde it upon altarul, upon the lemn că [este] upon the foc: it [este] a ardere-de-tot, an jertfă mistuită de foc, of a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפש כי תקריב קרבן מנחה ליהוה סלת יהיה קרבנו ויצק עליה שמן ונתן עליה לבונה מנחה היא
verses.english: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be [of] fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:it is a present
verses.romanian: și când vreun will a aduce a dar de mâncare unto DOMNUL, lui jertfă shall fi [of] făină fină; și el să a turna oil upon it, și a pune tămâie thereon: it este a present

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביאה אל בני אהרן הכהנים וקמץ ממנה מלוא קמצו מסלתה ומשמנה על כל לבונתה והקטיר הכהן את אזכרתה המזבחה אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, [to be] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce it to Aaron's fii the preoți: și el să a lua thereout lui handful of the făină thereof, și of the oil thereof, cu toți the tămâie thereof; și the preot shall a arde the memorial of it upon altarul, [to fi] an jertfă mistuită de foc, of a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנותרת מן המנחה לאהרן ולבניו קדש קדשים מאשי יהוה
verses.english: And the remnant of the meat offering [shall be] Aaron's and his sons': [it is] a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.romanian: și the remnant of the dar de mâncare [shall fi] Aaron's și lui fii': [it este] a thing preasfânt of the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תקריב קרבן מנחה מאפה תנור סלת חלות מצות בללות בשמן ורקיקי מצות משחים בשמן
verses.english: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, [it shall be] unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.romanian: și dacă tu a aduce an oblation of a dar de mâncare baken in the oven, [it shall fi] azime of făină fină mingled cu oil, sau unleavened foi uns cu oil.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מנחה על מחבת קרבנך סלת בלולה בשמן מצה תהיה
verses.english: And if thy oblation [be] a meat offering [baken] in a pan, it shall be [of] fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.romanian: și dacă tău oblation [fi] a dar de mâncare [baken] in a pan, it shall fi [of] făină fină unleavened, mingled cu oil.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פתת אתה פתים ויצקת עליה שמן מנחה היא
verses.english: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it [is] a meat offering.
verses.romanian: să part it in pieces, și a turna oil thereon: it [este] a dar de mâncare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מנחה מרחשת קרבנך סלת בשמן תעשה
verses.english: And if thy oblation [be] a meat offering [baken] in the fryingpan, it shall be made [of] fine flour with oil.
verses.romanian: și dacă tău oblation [fi] a dar de mâncare [baken] in the fryingpan, it shall fi a făcut [of] făină fină cu oil.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבאת את המנחה אשר יעשה מאלה ליהוה והקריבה אל הכהן והגישה אל המזבח
verses.english: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.romanian: și să a aduce the dar de mâncare că este a făcut of these things unto DOMNUL: și când it este presented unto the preot, el să a aduce it unto altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והרים הכהן מן המנחה את אזכרתה והקטיר המזבחה אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn [it] upon the altar: [it is] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua din the dar de mâncare a memorial thereof, și shall a arde [it] upon altarul: [it este] an jertfă mistuită de foc, of a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנותרת מן המנחה לאהרן ולבניו קדש קדשים מאשי יהוה
verses.english: And that which is left of the meat offering [shall be] Aaron's and his sons': [it is] a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.
verses.romanian: și că care este left of the dar de mâncare [shall fi] Aaron's și lui fii': [it este] a thing preasfânt of the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל המנחה אשר תקריבו ליהוה לא תעשה חמץ כי כל שאר וכל דבש לא תקריבו ממנו אשה ליהוה
verses.english: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye bring burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.
verses.romanian: No dar de mâncare, care să a aduce unto DOMNUL, shall fi a făcut cu leaven: căci voi a aduce a arde no leaven, nor vreun honey, in vreun jertfă of DOMNUL a făcut by foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קרבן ראשית תקריבו אתם ליהוה ואל המזבח לא יעלו לריח ניחח
verses.english: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
verses.romanian: As căci the oblation of the pârga, să a aduce ei unto DOMNUL: dar ei să nu fi burnt on altarul căci a aromă plăcută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל קרבן מנחתך במלח תמלח ולא תשבית מלח ברית אלהיך מעל מנחתך על כל קרבניך תקריב מלח
verses.english: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.romanian: și fiecare oblation of tău dar de mâncare shalt tu season cu sare; neither shalt tu suffer the sare of the legământ of tău Dumnezeu to fi lacking din tău dar de mâncare: cu toți thine jertfe să a aduce sare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם תקריב מנחת בכורים ליהוה אביב קלי באש גרש כרמל תקריב את מנחת בכוריך
verses.english: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, [even] corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.romanian: și dacă tu a aduce a dar de mâncare of tău pârga unto DOMNUL, să a aduce căci the dar de mâncare of tău pârga green ears of grâu dried by the foc, [even] grâu beaten out of full ears.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתה עליה שמן ושמת עליה לבונה מנחה היא
verses.english: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it [is] a meat offering.
verses.romanian: și să a pune oil upon it, și lay tămâie thereon: it [este] a dar de mâncare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקטיר הכהן את אזכרתה מגרשה ומשמנה על כל לבונתה אשה ליהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, [part] of the beaten corn thereof, and [part] of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: [it is] an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a arde the memorial of it, [part] of the beaten grâu thereof, și [part] of the oil thereof, cu toți the tămâie thereof: [it este] an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם זבח שלמים קרבנו אם מן הבקר הוא מקריב אם זכר אם נקבה תמים יקריבנו לפני יהוה
verses.english: And if his oblation [be] a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer [it] of the herd; whether [it be] a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și dacă lui oblation [fi] a jertfă of jertfă de pace, dacă he a aduce [it] of the cireadă; whether [it fi] a mascul sau femelă, el să a aduce it fără cusur înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך את ידו על ראש קרבנו ושחטו פתח אהל מועד וזרקו בני אהרן הכהנים את הדם על המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.romanian: și el să lay lui hand upon the cap of lui jertfă, și a ucide it [at] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii: și Aaron's fii the preoți shall a stropi the sânge upon altarul round about.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב מזבח השלמים אשה ליהוה את החלב המכסה את הקרב ואת כל החלב אשר על הקרב
verses.english: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce of the jertfă of the jertfă de pace an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL; the fat că covereth the inwards, și toți the fat că [este] upon the inwards

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת שתי הכליות ואת החלב אשר עליהן אשר על הכסלים ואת היותרת על הכבד על הכליות יסירנה
verses.english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.romanian: și the doi kidneys, și the fat că [este] on ei, care [este] by the flanks, și the caul deasupra the liver, cu the kidneys, it shall he a lua away.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקטירו אתו בני אהרן המזבחה על העלה אשר על העצים אשר על האש אשר על המזבח אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which [is] upon the wood that [is] on the fire that is over the altar: [it is] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și Aaron's fii shall a arde it on altarul upon the ardere-de-tot, care [este] upon the lemn că [este] on the foc că este peste altarul: [it este] an jertfă mistuită de foc, of a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מן הצאן קרבנו לזבח השלמים ליהוה זכר או נקבה תמים יקריבנו
verses.english: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the LORD [be] of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.romanian: și dacă lui jertfă căci a jertfă of jertfă de pace unto DOMNUL [fi] of the turmă; mascul sau femelă, el să a aduce it fără cusur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם כשב הוא מקריב את קרבנו והקריב אתו לפני יהוה
verses.english: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the LORD.
verses.romanian: dacă he a aduce a miel căci lui jertfă, atunci shall he a aduce it înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך את ידו על ראש קרבנו ושחט אתו לפני אהל מועד וזרקו בני אהרן את הדם על המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.romanian: și el să lay lui hand upon the cap of lui jertfă, și a ucide it înainte Cortul Întâlnirii: și Aaron's fii shall a stropi the sânge thereof round about upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב מזבח השלמים אשה ליהוה חלבו האליה תמימה לעמת העצה יסירנה את החלב המכסה את הקרב ואת כל החלב אשר על הקרב
verses.english: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat thereof, [and] the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce of the jertfă of the jertfă de pace an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL; the fat thereof, [și] the whole rump, it shall he a lua off hard by the backbone; the fat că covereth the inwards, și toți the fat că [este] upon the inwards

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת שתי הכליות ואת החלב אשר עליהן אשר על הכסלים ואת היותרת על הכבד על הכליות יסירנה
verses.english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.romanian: și the doi kidneys, și the fat că [este] upon ei, care [este] by the flanks, și the caul deasupra the liver, cu the kidneys, it shall he a lua away.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקטיר הכהן המזבחה לחם אשה ליהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: [it is] the food of the offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a arde it upon altarul: [it este] the food of the jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם עז קרבנו והקריבו לפני יהוה
verses.english: And if his offering [be] a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și dacă lui jertfă [fi] a țap, atunci el să a aduce it înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך את ידו על ראשו ושחט אתו לפני אהל מועד וזרקו בני אהרן הכהנים את דמו על המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron, priests shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.romanian: și el să lay lui hand upon the cap of it, și a ucide it înainte Cortul Întâlnirii: și the fii of Aaron, preoți shall a stropi the sânge thereof upon altarul round about.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב ממנו קרבנו אשה ליהוה את החלב המכסה את הקרב ואת כל החלב אשר על הקרב
verses.english: And he shall offer thereof his offering, [even] an offering made by fire unto the LORD; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce thereof lui jertfă, [even] an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL; the fat că covereth the inwards, și toți the fat că [este] upon the inwards

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת שתי הכליות ואת החלב אשר עליהן אשר על הכסלים ואת היותרת על הכבד על הכליות יסירנה
verses.english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.romanian: și the doi kidneys, și the fat că [este] upon ei, care [este] by the flanks, și the caul deasupra the liver, cu the kidneys, it shall he a lua away.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקטירם הכהן המזבחה לחם אשה לריח ניחח ליהוה כל חלב ליהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: [it is] the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour to the LORD: all the fat [is] the LORD's.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a arde ei upon altarul: [it este] the food of the jertfă mistuită de foc căci a aromă plăcută to DOMNUL: toți the fat [este] DOMNUL's.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: חקת עולם לדרתיכם בכל מושבתיכם כל חלב וכל דם לא תאכלו
verses.english: [It shall be] a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.romanian: [It shall fi] a perpetual decret căci vostru generations throughout toți vostru dwellings, că voi eat neither fat nor sânge.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל לאמר נפש כי תחטא בשגגה מכל מצות יהוה אשר לא תעשיהן ועשה מאחת מהן
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD [concerning things] which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, saying, dacă a soul shall păcat prin ignorance împotriva vreun of the porunci of DOMNUL [concerning things] care ought nu to fi done, și shall a face împotriva vreun al lor:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם הכהן המשיח יחטא לאשמת העם והקריב על חטאתו אשר חטא פר בן בקר תמים ליהוה לחטאת
verses.english: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.
verses.romanian: dacă the preot că este uns a face păcat după the păcat of the people; atunci let lui a aduce căci lui păcat, care he sunt sinned, a young vițel fără cusur unto DOMNUL căci a jertfă de păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא את הפר אל פתח אהל מועד לפני יהוה וסמך את ידו על ראש הפר ושחט את הפר לפני יהוה
verses.english: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce the vițel unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii înainte DOMNUL; și shall lay lui hand upon the vițel's cap, și a ucide the vițel înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן המשיח אשר מלא את ידו מדם הפר והביא אתו אל אהל מועד
verses.english: And the priest that is anointed shall take full hand of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.romanian: și the preot că este uns shall a lua full hand of the vițel's sânge, și a aduce it to Cortul Întâlnirii:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וטבל הכהן את אצבעו בדם והזה מן הדם שבע פעמים באצבעו לפני יהוה את פני פרכת הקדש
verses.english: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times with his finger before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall dip lui finger in the sânge, și a stropi of the sânge de șapte ori cu lui finger înainte DOMNUL, înainte the văl of Sanctuarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן הכהן מן הדם על קרנות המזבח קטרת הסמים לפני יהוה אשר באהל מועד ואת כל הדם ישפך אל יסוד מזבח העלה אשר פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And the priest shall put [some] of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which [is] in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which [is at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a pune [some] of the sânge upon the coarne of altarul of sweet tămâie înainte DOMNUL, care [este] in Cortul Întâlnirii; și shall a turna toți the sânge of the vițel at the bottom of altarul of the ardere-de-tot, care [este at] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל חלב פר החטאת ירים ממנו את החלב המכסה את הקרב ואת כל החלב אשר על הקרב
verses.english: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that [is] upon the inwards
verses.romanian: și el să a lua off din it toți the fat of the vițel căci the jertfă de păcat; the fat că covereth the inwards, și toți the fat că [este] upon the inwards

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת שתי הכליות ואת החלב אשר עליהן אשר על הכסלים ואת היותרת על הכבד על הכליות יסירנה
verses.english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] upon them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away
verses.romanian: și the doi kidneys, și the fat că [este] upon ei, care [este] by the flanks, și the caul deasupra the liver, cu the kidneys, it shall he a lua away

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאשר יורם משור זבח השלמים והקטירם הכהן על מזבח העלה
verses.english: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.romanian: As it era luat off din the vițel of the jertfă of peace jertfe: și the preot shall a arde ei upon altarul of the ardere-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת עור הפר ואת כל בשרו על ראשו ועל כרעיו וקרבו ופרשו
verses.english: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung
verses.romanian: și the piele of the vițel, și toți lui flesh, cu lui cap, și cu lui legs, și lui inwards, și lui dung

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והוציאו את כל הפר אל מחוץ למחנה אל מקום טהור על שפך הדשן ושרפו אתו על העצים באש על שפך הדשן ישרף
verses.english: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
verses.romanian: Even the whole vițel shall he carry forth fără the tabără unto a curat loc, where the ashes sunt a turnat out, și a arde lui on the lemn cu foc: where the ashes sunt a turnat out shall he fi burnt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם כל עדת ישראל ישגו ונעלם דבר מעיני הקהל ועשו אחת מכל מצות יהוה אשר לא תעשיהן ואשמו
verses.english: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done [somewhat against] any of the commandments of the LORD [concerning things] which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.romanian: și dacă the whole congregation of Israel păcat prin ignorance, și the thing fi hid din the eyes of the assembly, și they au done [somewhat împotriva] vreun of the porunci of DOMNUL [concerning things] care should nu fi done, și sunt vinovat;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונודע החטאת אשר חטאו עליה והקריבו הקהל פר בן בקר תמים לחטאת והביאו אתו לפני אהל מועד
verses.english: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a flawless young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: când the păcat, care they au sinned împotriva it, este known, atunci obștea shall a aduce a flawless young vițel căci the păcat, și a aduce lui înainte Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמכו זקני העדה את ידיהם על ראש הפר לפני יהוה ושחט את הפר לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD: and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the elders of obștea shall lay lor hands upon the cap of the vițel înainte DOMNUL: și the vițel shall fi a ucis înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא הכהן המשיח מדם הפר אל אהל מועד
verses.english: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.romanian: și the preot că este uns shall a aduce of the vițel's sânge to Cortul Întâlnirii:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וטבל הכהן את אצבעו מן הדם והזה מן הדם שבע פעמים לפני יהוה את פני פרכת הקדש
verses.english: And the priest shall dip with his finger [in some] of the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD, [even] before the veil of the sanctuary.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall dip cu lui finger [in some] of the sânge, și a stropi of the sânge de șapte ori înainte DOMNUL, [even] înainte the văl of Sanctuarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומן הדם יתן הכהן על קרנות המזבח קטרת הסמים אשר לפני יהוה אשר באהל מועד ואת כל הדם ישפך אל יסוד מזבח העלה אשר פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And the priest shall put [some] of the blood upon the horns of the altar of smoking incense which [is] before the LORD, that [is] in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which [is at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a pune [some] of the sânge upon the coarne of altarul of smoking tămâie care [este] înainte DOMNUL, că [este] in Cortul Întâlnirii, și shall a turna out toți the sânge at the bottom of altarul of the ardere-de-tot, care [este at] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל חלבו ירים ממנו והקטיר המזבחה
verses.english: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn [it] upon the altar.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua toți lui fat de la el, și a arde [it] upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה לפר כאשר עשה לפר החטאת כן יעשה לו וכפר עליהם הכהן ונסלח להם
verses.english: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.romanian: și el să a face cu the vițel as he a făcut cu the vițel căci a jertfă de păcat, so shall he a face cu this: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru ei, și it îi va fi iertat ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והוציא את הפר אל מחוץ למחנה ושרף אתו כאשר שרף את הפר הראישון חטאת הקהל היא
verses.english: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it [is] a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.romanian: și el să carry forth the vițel fără the tabără, și a arde lui as he ars the first vițel: it [este] a jertfă de păcat căci obștea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר נשיא יחטא ועשה אחת מכל מצות יהוה אלהיו אשר לא תעשיהן בשגגה ואשם
verses.english: When a ruler hath sinned, and done [somewhat] through ignorance [against] any of the commandments of the LORD his God [concerning things] which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.romanian: când a ruler sunt sinned, și done [somewhat] prin ignorance [împotriva] vreun of the porunci of DOMNUL lui Dumnezeu [concerning things] care should nu fi done, și este vinovat;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או הודע אליו חטאתו אשר חטא בה והביא את קרבנו שעיר עזים זכר תמים
verses.english: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.romanian: sau dacă lui păcat, wherein he sunt sinned, a veni to lui knowledge; el să a aduce lui jertfă, a kid of the țapi, a mascul fără cusur:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך את ידו על ראש השעיר ושחט אתו במקום אשר ישחטו את העלה לפני יהוה חטאת היא
verses.english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD: it [is] a sin offering.
verses.romanian: și el să lay lui hand upon the cap of the țap, și a ucide it in the loc where they a ucide the ardere-de-tot înainte DOMNUL: it [este] a jertfă de păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן מדם החטאת באצבעו ונתן על קרנות מזבח העלה ואת דמו ישפך אל יסוד מזבח העלה
verses.english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua of the sânge of the jertfă de păcat cu lui finger, și a pune [it] upon the coarne of altarul arderii-de-tot, și shall a turna out lui sânge at the bottom of altarul arderii-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל חלבו יקטיר המזבחה כחלב זבח השלמים וכפר עליו הכהן מחטאתו ונסלח לו
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם נפש אחת תחטא בשגגה מעם הארץ בעשותה אחת מכל מצות יהוה אשר לא תעשיהן ואשם
verses.english: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth [somewhat against] one of the commandments of the LORD [concerning things] which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
verses.romanian: și dacă vreun unu of the common people păcat prin ignorance, în timp ce he doeth [somewhat împotriva] unu of the porunci of DOMNUL [concerning things] care ought nu to fi done, și fi vinovat;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או הודע אליו חטאתו אשר חטא עליה והביא את קרבנו שעירת עזים נקבה תמימה על חטאתו אשר חטא
verses.english: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.romanian: sau dacă lui păcat, care he sunt sinned, a veni to lui knowledge: atunci el să a aduce lui jertfă, a kid of the țapi, a femelă fără cusur, căci lui păcat care he sunt sinned.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך את ידו על ראש החטאת ושחט את החטאת במקום אשר ישחטו את העלה
verses.english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place where they are slaying the burnt offering.
verses.romanian: și el să lay lui hand upon the cap of the jertfă de păcat, și slay the jertfă de păcat in the loc where they sunt slaying the ardere-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן מדמה באצבעו ונתן על קרנות מזבח העלה ואת כל דמה ישפך אל יסוד מזבח העלה
verses.english: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua of the sânge thereof cu lui finger, și a pune [it] upon the coarne of altarul arderii-de-tot, și shall a turna out toți the sânge thereof at the bottom of altarul arderii-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל חלבה יסיר כאשר יסיר החלב מעל זבח השלמים והקטיר הכהן המזבחה לריח ניחח ליהוה וכפר עליו הכהן ונסלח לו
verses.english: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn [it] upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua away toți the fat thereof, as the fat este luat away din off the jertfă of peace jertfe; și the preot shall a arde [it] upon altarul căci a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL; și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el, și it îi va fi iertat lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם כשבה יביא קרבנו לחטאת נקבה תמימה יביאנה
verses.english: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.romanian: și dacă he a aduce a miel căci a jertfă de păcat, el să a aduce it a femelă fără cusur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך את ידו על ראש החטאת ושחט אתה לחטאת במקום אשר ישחטו את העלה
verses.english: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.romanian: și el să lay lui hand upon the cap of the jertfă de păcat, și slay it căci a jertfă de păcat in the loc where they a ucide the ardere-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן מדם החטאת באצבעו ונתן על קרנות מזבח העלה ואת כל דמה ישפך אל יסוד מזבח העלה
verses.english: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua of the sânge of the jertfă de păcat cu lui finger, și a pune [it] upon the coarne of altarul arderii-de-tot, și shall a turna out toți the sânge thereof at the bottom of altarul arderii-de-tot

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל חלבה יסיר כאשר יסיר חלב הכשב מזבח השלמים והקטיר הכהן המזבחה על אשי יהוה וכפר עליו הכהן על חטאתו אשר חטא ונסלח לו
verses.english: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua away toți the fat thereof, as the fat of the miel este luat away din the jertfă of the peace jertfe; și the preot shall a arde ei upon altarul, după the jertfe a făcut by foc unto DOMNUL: și the preot shall a face an ispășire căci lui păcat că he sunt committed, și it îi va fi iertat lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפש כי תחטא ושמעה קול אלה והוא עד או ראה או ידע אם לא יגיד ונשא עונו
verses.english: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and [is] a witness, whether he hath seen or known [of it]; if he do not utter [it], then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.romanian: și dacă a soul păcat, și a auzi the voice of swearing, și [este] a witness, whether he sunt seen sau known [of it]; dacă he a face nu utter [it], atunci el să bear lui nelegiuire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או נפש כי תגע בכל דבר טמא או בנבלת חיה טמאה או בנבלת בהמה טמאה או בנבלת שרץ טמא ונעלם ממנו והוא טמא ואשם
verses.english: Or if a soul that touch any unclean thing, whether [it be] a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and [if] it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
verses.romanian: sau dacă a soul că touch vreun necurat thing, whether [it fi] a carcase of an necurat beast, sau a carcase of necurat cattle, sau the carcase of necurat creeping things, și [dacă] it fi hidden de la el; he de asemenea shall fi necurat, și vinovat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או כי יגע בטמאת אדם לכל טמאתו אשר יטמא בה ונעלם ממנו והוא ידע ואשם
verses.english: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness [it be] that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth [of it], then he shall be guilty.
verses.romanian: sau dacă he touch the necurăție of om, whatsoever necurăție [it fi] că a om shall fi pângărit withal, și it fi hid de la el; când he knoweth [of it], atunci el să fi vinovat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפש כי תשבע לבטא בשפתים להריע או להטיב לכל אשר יבטא האדם בשבועה ונעלם ממנו והוא ידע ואשם לאחת מאלה
verses.english: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with [his] lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever [it be] that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth [of it], then he shall be guilty in one of these.
verses.romanian: sau dacă a soul a jura, pronouncing cu [lui] lips to a face evil, sau to a face good, whatsoever [it fi] că a om shall a declara cu an jurământ, și it fi hid de la el; când he knoweth [of it], atunci el să fi vinovat in unu of these.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי יחטא לאחת מאלה והתודה את אשר חטא עליה
verses.english: And it shall be, when he shall sin in one of these [things], that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that [thing]:
verses.romanian: și it shall fi, când el să păcat in unu of these [things], că el să confess că he sunt sinned in că [thing]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא את אשמו ליהוה על חטאתו אשר חטא נקבה מן הצאן כשבה או שעירת עזים לחטאת וכפר עליו הכהן על חטאתו אשר חטא ונסלח לו
verses.english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement over him concerning his sin with which he sinned and it is forgiven to him.
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce lui jertfă pentru vină unto DOMNUL căci lui păcat care he sunt sinned, a femelă din the turmă, a miel sau a kid of the țapi, căci a jertfă de păcat; și the preot shall a face an ispășire peste lui concerning lui păcat cu care he sinned și it este forgiven to lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא תשיג ידו די שה והביא על אשמו אשר חטא שתי תרים או שני בני יונה ליהוה אחד לחטאת ואחד לעלה
verses.english: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.romanian: și dacă he fi nu able to a aduce a miel, atunci el să a aduce căci lui trespass, care he sunt committed, doi turtledoves, sau doi young pigeons, unto DOMNUL; unu căci a jertfă de păcat, și the other căci a ardere-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא אתם אל הכהן והקריב את אשר לחטאת ראישון ומלק הכהן את ראשו ממול ערפו ולא יבדל
verses.english: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer [that] which [is] for the sin offering first, and the priest shall wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide [it] asunder:
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce ei unto the preot, care shall a aduce [că] care [este] căci the jertfă de păcat first, și the preot shall wring off lui cap din lui neck, dar shall nu divide [it] asunder:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והזה מדם החטאת אל קיר המזבח והנשאר בדם ימצא אל יסוד המזבח חטאת היא
verses.english: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it [is] a sin offering.
verses.romanian: și el să a stropi of the sânge of the jertfă de păcat upon the latură of altarul; și the odihnă of the sânge shall fi wrung out at the bottom of altarul: it [este] a jertfă de păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת השני יעשה עלה כמשפט וכפר עליו הכהן מחטאתו אשר חטא ונסלח לו
verses.english: And he shall offer the second [for] a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce the second [căci] a ardere-de-tot, după the manner: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el căci lui păcat care he sunt sinned, și it îi va fi iertat lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא תשיג ידו לשתי תרים או לשני בני יונה והביא את קרבנו אשר חטא עשירת האיפה סלת לחטאת לא יצק עליה שמן ולא יתן עליה לבונה כי חטאת היא
verses.english: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall pour no oil upon it, neither shall he put [any] frankincense thereon: for it [is] a sin offering.
verses.romanian: dar dacă he fi nu able to a aduce doi turtledoves, sau doi young pigeons, atunci he că sinned shall a aduce căci lui jertfă the tenth part of an ephah of făină fină căci a jertfă de păcat; el să a turna no oil upon it, neither shall he a pune [vreun] tămâie thereon: căci it [este] a jertfă de păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביאה אל הכהן וקמץ ממנה מלוא קמצו את אזכרתה והקטיר המזבחה על אשי יהוה חטאת היא
verses.english: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, [even] a memorial thereof, and burn [it] on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD: it [is] a sin offering.
verses.romanian: atunci shall he a aduce it to the preot, și the preot shall a lua lui handful of it, [even] a memorial thereof, și a arde [it] on altarul, după the jertfe a făcut by foc unto DOMNUL: it [este] a jertfă de păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכפר עליו הכהן על חטאתו אשר חטא מאחת מאלה ונסלח לו והיתה לכהן כמנחה
verses.english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and [the remnant] shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el as touching lui păcat că he sunt sinned in unu of these, și it îi va fi iertat lui: și [the remnant] shall fi the preot's, as a dar de mâncare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נפש כי תמעל מעל וחטאה בשגגה מקדשי יהוה והביא את אשמו ליהוה איל תמים מן הצאן בערכך כסף שקלים בשקל הקדש לאשם
verses.english: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:
verses.romanian: dacă a soul commit a trespass, și păcat prin ignorance, in the lucrurile sfinte of DOMNUL; atunci el să a aduce căci lui trespass unto DOMNUL a berbec fără cusur out of the flocks, cu tău estimation by shekels of argint, după the shekel of Sanctuarul, căci a jertfă pentru vină:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת אשר חטא מן הקדש ישלם ואת חמישתו יסף עליו ונתן אתו לכהן והכהן יכפר עליו באיל האשם ונסלח לו
verses.english: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.romanian: și el să a face amends căci the harm că he sunt done in the sfânt thing, și shall add the fifth part thereto, și a da it unto the preot: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el cu the berbec of the jertfă pentru vină, și it îi va fi iertat lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם נפש אחת תחטא ועשתה אחת מכל מצות יהוה אשר לא תעשיהן ולא ידע ואשם ונשא עונו
verses.english: And if a one soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD; though he wist [it] not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.romanian: și dacă a unu soul păcat, și commit vreun of these things care sunt forbidden to fi done by the porunci of DOMNUL; though he wist [it] nu, yet este he vinovat, și shall bear lui nelegiuire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא איל תמים מן הצאן בערכך לאשם אל הכהן וכפר עליו הכהן על שגגתו אשר שגג והוא לא ידע ונסלח לו
verses.english: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist [it] not, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce a berbec fără cusur out of the turmă, cu tău estimation, căci a jertfă pentru vină, unto the preot: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el concerning lui ignorance wherein he erred și wist [it] nu, și it îi va fi iertat lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשם הוא אשם אשם ליהוה
verses.english: It [is] a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD.
verses.romanian: It [este] a jertfă pentru vină: he sunt certainly trespassed împotriva DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או מצא אבדה וכחש בה ונשבע על שקר על אחת מכל אשר יעשה האדם לחטא בהן
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי יחטא ואשם והשיב את הגזל אשר גזל או את העשוק אשר עשק או את הפקדון אשר הפקד אתו או את האבדה אשר מצא
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או מכל דבר אשר ישבע עליו לשקר ושלם אתו בראשו וחמישתו יסף עליו לאשר הוא לו יתננו ביום אשמתו
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת אשמו יביא ליהוה איל תמים מן הצאן בערכך לאשם
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכפר עליו הכהן לפני יהוה ונסלח לו על אחת מכל אשר יעשה לאשמה בה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צוי את אהרן ואת בניו לאמר זאת תורת העלה היא העלה על המוקדה על המזבח כל הלילה עד בקר ואש המזבח תוקד בו
verses.english: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This [is] the law of the burnt offering: It [is] the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
verses.romanian: a porunci Aaron și lui fii, saying, This [este] the lege of the ardere-de-tot: It [este] the ardere-de-tot, pentru că of the burning upon altarul toți night unto the morning, și the foc of altarul shall fi burning in it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולבש הכהן מדי בד ומכנסי בד ילבש על בשרו והרים את הדשן אשר תאכל האש את העלה על המזבח ושמו אצל המזבח
verses.english: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a pune on lui in veșmânt, și lui in izmene shall he a pune upon lui flesh, și a lua up the ashes care the foc sunt consumed cu the ardere-de-tot on altarul, și el să a pune ei beside altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופשט את בגדיו ולבש בגדים אחרים והוציא את הדשן אל מחוץ למחנה אל מקום טהור
verses.english: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.romanian: și el să a pune off lui veșminte, și a pune on other veșminte, și carry forth the ashes fără the tabără unto a curat loc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאש על המזבח תוקד בו לא תכבה ובער עליה הכהן עצים בבקר בבקר וערך עליה העלה והקטיר עליה חלבי שלמים
verses.english: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.romanian: și the foc upon altarul shall fi burning in it; it shall nu fi a pune out: și the preot shall a arde lemn on it fiecare morning, și lay the ardere-de-tot in order upon it; și el să a arde thereon the fat of the peace jertfe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אש תמיד תוקד על המזבח לא תכבה
verses.english: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.romanian: The foc shall ever fi burning upon altarul; it shall never a merge out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת תורת המנחה הקריבו אתה בני אהרן לפני יהוה אל פני המזבח
verses.english: And this [is] the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD, before the altar.
verses.romanian: și this [este] the lege of the dar de mâncare: the fii of Aaron shall a aduce it înainte DOMNUL, înainte altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והרים ממנה בקמצו מסלת המנחה ומשמנה ואת כל הלבונה אשר על המנחה והקטיר המזבחה אשה ריח ניחח אזכרתה ליהוה
verses.english: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which [is] upon the meat offering, and shall burn [it] upon the altar [for] a sweet savour, [even] the memorial of it, unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua of it lui handful, of the făină of the dar de mâncare, și of the oil thereof, și toți the tămâie care [este] upon the dar de mâncare, și shall a arde [it] upon altarul [căci] a aromă plăcută, [even] the memorial of it, unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנותרת ממנה יאכל אהרן ובניו מצות תאכל במקום קדוש בחצר אהל מועד יאכלוה
verses.english: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
verses.romanian: și the remainder thereof shall Aaron și lui fii eat: cu pâine nedospită shall it fi eaten in locul sfânt; in the court of Cortul Întâlnirii they să mănânce it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאפה חמץ חלקם נתתי אתה מאשי יהוה קדש קדשים היא כחטאת כאשם
verses.english: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it [unto them for] their portion of my offerings made by fire of the LORD; it [is] most holy, as [is] the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
verses.romanian: It shall nu fi baken cu leaven. I au dat it [lor căci] lor portion of meu jertfe a făcut by foc of DOMNUL; it [este] preasfânt, as [este] the jertfă de păcat, și as the jertfă pentru vină.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל זכר בבני אהרן יאכלנה חק עולם לדרתיכם מאשי יהוה כל אשר יגע בהם יקדש
verses.english: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. [It shall be] a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.romanian: toți the males în mijlocul the copii of Aaron să mănânce of it. [It shall fi] a decret veșnic in vostru generations concerning the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc: fiecare unu că toucheth ei shall fi sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זה קרבן אהרן ובניו אשר יקריבו ליהוה ביום המשיח אתו עשירת האיפה סלת למנחה תמיד מחציתה בבקר ומחציתה בין הערבים
verses.english: This [is] the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof between the evenings.
verses.romanian: This [este] the jertfă of Aaron și of lui fii, care ei să a aduce unto DOMNUL in the zi când he este uns; the tenth part of an ephah of făină fină căci a dar de mâncare perpetual, half of it in the morning, și half thereof between the evenings.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על המחבת בשמן תעשה מרבכת תביאנה תופני מנחת פתים תקריב ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: In a pan it shall be made with oil; [and when it is] baken, thou shalt bring it in: [and] the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer [for] a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: In a pan it shall fi a făcut cu oil; [și când it este] baken, să a aduce it in: [și] the baken pieces of the dar de mâncare shalt tu a aduce [căci] a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הכהן המשיח תחתיו מבניו יעשה אתה חק עולם ליהוה כליל תקטיר
verses.english: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: [it is] a statute for ever unto the LORD; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.romanian: și the preot of lui fii că este uns in lui stead shall a aduce it: [it este] a decret veșnic unto DOMNUL; it shall fi wholly burnt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל מנחת כהן כליל תהיה לא תאכל
verses.english: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.romanian: căci fiecare dar de mâncare căci the preot shall fi wholly burnt: it shall nu fi eaten.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל אהרן ואל בניו לאמר זאת תורת החטאת במקום אשר תשחט העלה תשחט החטאת לפני יהוה קדש קדשים היא
verses.english: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This [is] the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD: it [is] most holy.
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Aaron și to lui fii, saying, This [este] the lege of the jertfă de păcat: In the loc where the ardere-de-tot este a ucis shall the jertfă de păcat fi a ucis înainte DOMNUL: it [este] preasfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הכהן המחטא אתה יאכלנה במקום קדוש תאכל בחצר אהל מועד
verses.english: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: The preot că offereth it căci păcat să mănânce it: in locul sfânt shall it fi eaten, in the court of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל אשר יגע בבשרה יקדש ואשר יזה מדמה על הבגד אשר תזה עליו יכבס במקום קדוש
verses.english: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, he shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.romanian: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall fi sfânt: și când acolo este stropit of the sânge thereof upon vreun veșmânt, he shalt a spăla că whereon it era stropit in locul sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכלי חרש אשר תבשל בו ישבר ואם בכלי נחשת בשלה ומרק ושטף במים
verses.english: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.romanian: dar the earthen vessel wherein it este sodden shall fi broken: și dacă it fi sodden in a brasen pot, it shall fi both scoured, și rinsed in apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל זכר בכהנים יאכל אתה קדש קדשים היא
verses.english: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it [is] most holy.
verses.romanian: toți the males în mijlocul the preoți să mănânce thereof: it [este] preasfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל חטאת אשר יבוא מדמה אל אהל מועד לכפר בקדש לא תאכל באש תשרף
verses.english: And no sin offering, whereof [any] of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile [withal] in the holy [place], shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.romanian: și no jertfă de păcat, whereof [vreun] of the sânge este a adus into Cortul Întâlnirii to a împăca [withal] in the sfânt [loc], shall fi eaten: it shall fi burnt in the foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת תורת האשם קדש קדשים הוא
verses.english: Likewise this [is] the law of the trespass offering: it [is] most holy.
verses.romanian: Likewise this [este] the lege of the jertfă pentru vină: it [este] preasfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: במקום אשר ישחטו את העלה ישחטו את האשם ואת דמו יזרקו על המזבח סביב
verses.english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.romanian: In the loc where they a ucide the ardere-de-tot shall they a ucide the jertfă pentru vină: și the sânge thereof shall he a stropi round about upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל חלבו יקריב ממנו את האליה ואת החלב המכסה את הקרב ואת כל החלב אשר על הקרב
verses.english: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards, and with all fat that is over the inwards
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce of it toți the fat thereof; the rump, și the fat că covereth the inwards, și cu toți fat că este peste the inwards

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת שתי הכליות ואת החלב אשר עליהן אשר על הכסלים ואת היותרת על הכבד על הכליות יסירנה
verses.english: And the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them, which [is] by the flanks, and the caul [that is] above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.romanian: și the doi kidneys, și the fat că [este] on ei, care [este] by the flanks, și the caul [că este] deasupra the liver, cu the kidneys, it shall he a lua away:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקטיר אתם הכהן המזבחה אשה ליהוה אשם הוא
verses.english: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar [for] an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it [is] a trespass offering.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a arde ei upon altarul [căci] an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL: it [este] a jertfă pentru vină.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל זכר בכהנים יאכלנו במקום קדוש יאכל קדש קדשים הוא
verses.english: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it [is] most holy.
verses.romanian: fiecare mascul în mijlocul the preoți să mănânce thereof: it shall fi eaten in locul sfânt: it [este] preasfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כחטאת כאשם תורה אחת להם הכהן אשר יכפר בו לו יהיה
verses.english: As the sin offering [is], so [is] the trespass offering: [there is] one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have [it].
verses.romanian: As the jertfă de păcat [este], so [este] the jertfă pentru vină: [acolo este] unu lege pentru ei: the preot că maketh ispășire therewith shall au [it].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והכהן המקריב את עלת איש עור העלה אשר יקריבו לכהן לו יהיה
verses.english: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, [even] the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.romanian: și the preot că offereth vreun om's ardere-de-tot, [even] the preot shall au to himself the piele of the ardere-de-tot care he sunt a adus.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל מנחה אשר תאפה בתנור וכל נעשה במרחשת ועל המחבת לכהן המקריב אתה לו תהיה
verses.english: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
verses.romanian: și toți the dar de mâncare că este baken in the oven, și toți că este dressed in the fryingpan, și in the pan, shall fi the preot's că offereth it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל מנחה בלולה בשמן וחרבה לכל בני אהרן תהיה איש כאחיו
verses.english: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one [as much] as another.
verses.romanian: și fiecare dar de mâncare, mingled cu oil, și dry, shall toți the fii of Aaron au, unu [as much] as another.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת תורת זבח השלמים אשר יקריבו ליהוה
verses.english: And this [is] the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which they shall offer unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și this [este] the lege of the jertfă of peace jertfe, care ei să a aduce unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם על תודה יקריבנו והקריב על זבח התודה חלות מצות בללות בשמן ורקיקי מצות משחים בשמן וסלת מרבכת חלות בללות בשמן
verses.english: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.romanian: dacă he a aduce it căci a thanksgiving, atunci el să a aduce cu the jertfă of thanksgiving azime mingled cu oil, și unleavened foi uns cu oil, și turte mingled cu oil, of făină fină, fried.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על חלת לחם חמץ יקריב קרבנו על זבח תודת שלמיו
verses.english: Besides the cakes, he shall offer [for] his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.romanian: Besides the turte, el să a aduce [căci] lui jertfă leavened bread cu the jertfă of thanksgiving of lui peace jertfe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב ממנו אחד מכל קרבן תרומה ליהוה לכהן הזרק את דם השלמים לו יהיה
verses.english: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation [for] an heave offering unto the LORD, [and] it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.romanian: și of it el să a aduce unu out of the whole oblation [căci] an dar ridicat unto DOMNUL, [și] it shall fi the preot's că sprinkleth the sânge of the peace jertfe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשר זבח תודת שלמיו ביום קרבנו יאכל לא יניח ממנו עד בקר
verses.english: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.romanian: și the flesh of the jertfă of lui peace jertfe căci thanksgiving shall fi eaten the same zi că it este a adus; el să nu leave vreun of it until the morning.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם נדר או נדבה זבח קרבנו ביום הקריבו את זבחו יאכל וממחרת והנותר ממנו יאכל
verses.english: But if the sacrifice of his offering [be] a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.romanian: dar dacă the jertfă of lui jertfă [fi] a vow, sau a voluntary jertfă, it shall fi eaten the same zi că he offereth lui jertfă: și on the morrow de asemenea the remainder of it shall fi eaten:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנותר מבשר הזבח ביום השלישי באש ישרף
verses.english: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.romanian: dar the remainder of the flesh of the jertfă on the third zi shall fi burnt cu foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם אכל יאכל מבשר זבח שלמיו ביום השלישי לא ירצה המקריב אתו לא יחשב לו פגול יהיה והנפש האכלת ממנו עונה תשא
verses.english: And if [any] of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.romanian: și dacă [vreun] of the flesh of the jertfă of lui peace jertfe fi eaten at toți on the third zi, it shall nu fi accepted, neither shall it fi imputed lui că offereth it: it shall fi an urâciune, și the soul că eateth of it shall bear lui nelegiuire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבשר אשר יגע בכל טמא לא יאכל באש ישרף הבשר כל טהור יאכל בשר
verses.english: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean [thing] shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.romanian: și the flesh că toucheth vreun necurat [thing] shall nu fi eaten; it shall fi burnt cu foc: as căci the flesh, toți că fi curat să mănânce thereof.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנפש אשר תאכל בשר מזבח השלמים אשר ליהוה וטמאתו עליו ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מעמיה
verses.english: But the soul that eateth [of] the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that [pertain] unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.romanian: dar the soul că eateth [of] the flesh of the jertfă of peace jertfe, că [pertain] unto DOMNUL, having lui necurăție upon lui, even că soul shall fi a tăia off din lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפש כי תגע בכל טמא בטמאת אדם או בבהמה טמאה או בכל שרץ טמא ואכל מבשר זבח השלמים אשר ליהוה ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מעמיה
verses.english: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean [thing, as] the uncleanness of man, or [any] unclean beast, or any creeper unclean [thing], and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which [pertain] unto the LORD, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.romanian: Moreover the soul că shall touch vreun necurat [thing, as] the necurăție of om, sau [vreun] necurat beast, sau vreun creeper necurat [thing], și eat of the flesh of the jertfă of peace jertfe, care [pertain] unto DOMNUL, even că soul shall fi a tăia off din lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל לאמר כל חלב שור וכשב ועז לא תאכלו
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, saying, voi să mănânce no manner of fat, of bou, sau of sheep, sau of țap.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחלב נבלה וחלב טרפה יעשה לכל המלאכה ואכל לא תאכלהו
verses.english: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.romanian: și the fat of the beast că dieth of itself, și the fat of că care este torn cu beasts, poate fi used in vreun other use: dar să in no wise eat of it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי כל אכל חלב מן הבהמה אשר יקריבו ממנה אשה ליהוה ונכרתה הנפש האכלת מעמיה
verses.english: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, even the soul that eateth [it] shall be cut off from his people.
verses.romanian: căci whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of care oameni a aduce an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL, even the soul că eateth [it] shall fi a tăia off din lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל דם לא תאכלו בכל מושבתיכם לעוף ולבהמה
verses.english: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, [whether it be] of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.romanian: Moreover voi să mănânce no manner of sânge, [whether it fi] of fowl sau of beast, in vreun of vostru dwellings.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הנפש אשר תאכל כל דם ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מעמיה
verses.english: Whatsoever soul [it be] that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.romanian: Whatsoever soul [it fi] că eateth vreun manner of sânge, even că soul shall fi a tăia off din lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל בני ישראל תדבר לאמר המקריב את זבח שלמיו ליהוה יביא את קרבנו ליהוה מזבח שלמיו
verses.english: And unto the children of Israel you shall speak, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.romanian: și unto the copii of Israel să a vorbi, saying, He că offereth the jertfă of lui peace jertfe unto DOMNUL shall a aduce lui oblation unto DOMNUL of the jertfă of lui peace jertfe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ידיו תביאנה את אשי יהוה את החלב על החזה יביאנו את החזה להניף אתו תנופה לפני יהוה
verses.english: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved [for] a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.romanian: lui own hands shall a aduce the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc, the fat cu the breast, it shall he a aduce, că the breast poate fi waved [căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקטיר הכהן את החלב המזבחה והיה החזה לאהרן ולבניו
verses.english: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a arde the fat upon altarul: dar the breast shall fi Aaron's și lui fii'.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת שוק הימין תתנו תרומה לכהן מזבחי שלמיכם
verses.english: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest [for] an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.romanian: și the right shoulder shall voi a da unto the preot [căci] an dar ridicat of the jertfe of vostru peace jertfe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המקריב את דם השלמים ואת החלב מבני אהרן לו תהיה שוק הימין למנה
verses.english: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for [his] part.
verses.romanian: He în mijlocul the fii of Aaron, că offereth the sânge of the peace jertfe, și the fat, shall au the right shoulder căci [lui] part.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי את חזה התנופה ואת שוק התרומה לקחתי מאת בני ישראל מזבחי שלמיהם ואתן אתם לאהרן הכהן ולבניו לחק עולם מאת בני ישראל
verses.english: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: căci the wave breast și the heave shoulder au I luat of the copii of Israel din off the jertfe of lor peace jertfe, și au dat ei lui Aaron the preot și unto lui fii by a decret veșnic din în mijlocul the copii of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת משחת אהרן ומשחת בניו מאשי יהוה ביום הקריבו אתם לכהן ליהוה
verses.english: This [is the portion] of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day [when] he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest's office;
verses.romanian: This [este the portion] of the ungere of Aaron, și of the ungere of lui fii, out of the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc, in the zi [când] he presented ei to a sluji unto DOMNUL in the preot's office;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר צוה יהוה לתת להם ביום משחו אתם מאת בני ישראל חק עולם לדרותם
verses.english: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, [by] a appointment for ever throughout their generations.
verses.romanian: care DOMNUL a poruncit to fi dat ei of the copii of Israel, in the zi că he uns ei, [by] a appointment veșnic în toate generațiile lor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת התורה לעלה ולמנחה ולחטאת ולאשם ולמלאים ולזבח השלמים
verses.english: This [is] the law of the burnt offering, and of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.romanian: This [este] the lege of the ardere-de-tot, și of the dar de mâncare, și of the jertfă de păcat, și of the jertfă pentru vină, și of the consecrations, și of the jertfă of the peace jertfe;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר צוה יהוה את משה בהר סיני ביום צותו את בני ישראל להקריב את קרבניהם ליהוה במדבר סיני
verses.english: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.romanian: care DOMNUL a poruncit Moise in mount Sinai, in the zi că he a poruncit the copii of Israel to a aduce lor oblations unto DOMNUL, in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קח את אהרן ואת בניו אתו ואת הבגדים ואת שמן המשחה ואת פר החטאת ואת שני האילים ואת סל המצות
verses.english: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.romanian: a lua Aaron și lui fii cu el, și the veșminte, și the ungere oil, și a vițel căci the jertfă de păcat, și doi berbeci, și a basket of pâine nedospită;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל העדה הקהל אל פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și gather tu toți obștea together unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש משה כאשר צוה יהוה אתו ותקהל העדה אל פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și Moise a făcut as DOMNUL a poruncit lui; și the assembly era gathered together unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל העדה זה הדבר אשר צוה יהוה לעשות
verses.english: And Moses said unto the congregation, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus unto obștea, This [este] the thing care DOMNUL a poruncit to fi done.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריב משה את אהרן ואת בניו וירחץ אתם במים
verses.english: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.romanian: și Moise a adus Aaron și lui fii, și spălat ei cu apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן עליו את הכיתנת ויחגר אתו באבניט וילבש אתו את המעיל ויתן עליו את האפוד ויחגר אתו בחשב האפוד ויאפד לו בו
