verses.english: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound [it] unto him therewith.
verses.romanian: și he a pune upon lui the veșmânt, și girded lui cu the girdle, și clothed lui cu the veșmânt, și a pune the efod upon lui, și he girded lui cu the curious girdle of the efod, și bound [it] lui therewith.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישם עליו את החשן ויתן על החשן את הארים ואת התמים
verses.english: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.romanian: și he a pune the pieptar upon lui: de asemenea he a pune in the pieptar the Urim și the Thummim.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישם את המצנפת על ראשו ויתן על המצנפת אל מול פניו את ציץ הזהב נזר הקדש כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, [even] upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și he a pune the mitră upon lui cap; de asemenea upon the mitră, [even] upon lui forefront, a făcut he a pune the golden plăcuță, the sfânt diademă; as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה את שמן המשחה וימשח את המשכן ואת כל אשר בו ויקדש אתם
verses.english: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that [was] therein, and sanctified them.
verses.romanian: și Moise a luat the ungere oil, și uns Cortul și toți că [era] therein, și sfințit ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויז ממנו על המזבח שבע פעמים וימשח את המזבח ואת כל כליו ואת הכיור ואת כנו לקדשם
verses.english: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.romanian: și he stropit thereof upon altarul de șapte ori, și uns altarul și toți lui vessels, both the laver și lui foot, to a sfinți ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצק משמן המשחה על ראש אהרן וימשח אתו לקדשו
verses.english: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.romanian: și he a turnat of the ungere oil upon Aaron's cap, și uns lui, to a sfinți lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריב משה את בני אהרן וילבשם כיתנות ויחגר אתם אבניטים ויחבש להם מגבעות כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Moise a adus Aaron's fii, și a pune coats upon ei, și girded ei cu girdles, și a pune bonnets upon ei; as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויגש את פר החטאת ויסמך אהרן ובניו את ידיהם על ראש פר החטאת
verses.english: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.romanian: și he a adus the vițel căci the jertfă de păcat: și Aaron și lui fii laid lor hands upon the cap of the vițel căci the jertfă de păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישחט ויקח משה את הדם ויתן על קרנות המזבח סביב באצבעו ויחטא את המזבח ואת הדם יצק אל יסוד המזבח ויקדשהו לכפר עליו
verses.english: And he slew [it]; and Moses took the blood, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.romanian: și he slew [it]; și Moise a luat the sânge, și a pune [it] upon the coarne of altarul round about cu lui finger, și curățit altarul, și a turnat the sânge at the bottom of altarul, și sfințit it, to a face împăcare upon it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח את כל החלב אשר על הקרב ואת יותרת הכבד ואת שתי הכליות ואת חלביהן ויקטר משה המזבחה
verses.english: And he took all the fat that [was] upon the inwards, and the caul [above] the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned [it] upon the altar.
verses.romanian: și he a luat toți the fat că [era] upon the inwards, și the caul [deasupra] the liver, și the doi kidneys, și lor fat, și Moise ars [it] upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הפר ואת עורו ואת בשרו ואת פרשו שרף באש מחוץ למחנה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: dar the vițel, și lui hide, lui flesh, și lui dung, he burnt cu foc fără the tabără; as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויגש את איל העלה ויסמכו אהרן ובניו את ידיהם על ראש האיל
verses.english: And he raised the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.romanian: și he raised the berbec căci the ardere-de-tot: și Aaron și lui fii laid lor hands upon the cap of the berbec.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישחט ויזרק משה את הדם על המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he killed [it]; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.romanian: și he a ucis [it]; și Moise stropit the sânge upon altarul round about.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת האיל נתח לנתחיו ויקטר משה את הראש ואת הנתחים ואת הפדר
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הקרב והכרעים רחץ במים ויקטר משה את כל האיל המזבחה עלה הוא לריח ניחח אשה הוא ליהוה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it [was] a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, [and] an offering made by fire unto the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și he spălat the inwards și the legs in apă; și Moise burnt the whole berbec upon altarul: it [era] a ardere-de-tot căci a aromă plăcută, [și] an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL; as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריב את איל השני איל המלאים ויסמכו אהרן ובניו את ידיהם על ראש האיל
verses.english: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.romanian: și he a adus the other berbec, the berbec of consecration: și Aaron și lui fii laid lor hands upon the cap of the berbec.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישחט ויקח משה מדמו ויתן על תנך אזן אהרן הימנית ועל בהון ידו הימנית ועל בהון רגלו הימנית
verses.english: And he slew [it]; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put [it] upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.romanian: și he slew [it]; și Moise a luat of the sânge of it, și a pune [it] upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, și upon the thumb of lui right hand, și upon the great toe of lui right foot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריב את בני אהרן ויתן משה מן הדם על תנך אזנם הימנית ועל בהון ידם הימנית ועל בהון רגלם הימנית ויזרק משה את הדם על המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.romanian: și he a adus Aaron's fii, și Moise a pune of the sânge upon the tip of lor right ear, și upon the thumbs of lor right hands, și upon the great toes of lor right feet: și Moise stropit the sânge upon altarul round about.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח את החלב את האליה ואת כל החלב אשר על הקרב ואת יותרת הכבד ואת שתי הכליות ואת חלביהן ואת שוק הימין
verses.english: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that [was] upon the inwards, and the caul [above] the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.romanian: și he a luat the fat, și the rump, și toți the fat că [era] upon the inwards, și the caul [deasupra] the liver, și the doi kidneys, și lor fat, și the right shoulder:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומסל המצות אשר לפני יהוה לקח חלת מצה אחת וחלת לחם שמן אחת ורקיק אחד וישם על החלבים ועל שוק הימין
verses.english: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that [was] before the LORD, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put [them] on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.romanian: și out of the basket of pâine nedospită, că [era] înainte DOMNUL, he a luat unu unleavened cake, și a cake of oiled bread, și unu wafer, și a pune [ei] on the fat, și upon the right shoulder:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן את הכל על כפי אהרן ועל כפי בניו וינף אתם תנופה לפני יהוה
verses.english: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them [for] a wave offering before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și he a pune toți upon Aaron's hands, și upon lui fii' hands, și waved ei [căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה אתם מעל כפיהם ויקטר המזבחה על העלה מלאים הם לריח ניחח אשה ליהוה
verses.english: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt [them] on the altar upon the burnt offering: they [were] consecrations for a sweet savour: it [is] an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și Moise a luat ei din off lor hands, și burnt [ei] on altarul upon the ardere-de-tot: they [erau] consecrations căci a aromă plăcută: it [este] an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה את החזה וינפהו תנופה לפני יהוה מאיל המלאים למשה היה למנה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Moses took the breast, and waved it [for] a wave offering before the LORD: [for] of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Moise a luat the breast, și waved it [căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL: [căci] of the berbec of consecration it era Moise' part; as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה משמן המשחה ומן הדם אשר על המזבח ויז על אהרן ועל בגדיו ועל בניו ועל בגדי בניו אתו ויקדש את אהרן ואת בגדיו ואת בניו ואת בגדי בניו אתו
verses.english: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which [was] upon the altar, and sprinkled [it] upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.romanian: și Moise a luat of the ungere oil, și of the sânge care [era] upon altarul, și stropit [it] upon Aaron, și upon lui veșminte, și upon lui fii, și upon lui fii' veșminte cu el; și sfințit Aaron, și lui veșminte, și lui fii, și lui fii' veșminte cu el.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל אהרן ואל בניו בשלו את הבשר פתח אהל מועד במקום הקדש ושם תאכלו אתו ואת הלחם אשר בסל המלאים כאשר צויתי לאמר אהרן ובניו יאכלהו
verses.english: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, in place holy: and there eat it with the bread that [is] in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus lui Aaron și to lui fii, bubă the flesh [at] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, in loc sfânt: și acolo eat it cu the bread că [este] in the basket of consecrations, as I a poruncit, saying, Aaron și lui fii să mănânce it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנותר בבשר ובלחם באש תשרפו
verses.english: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.romanian: și că care remaineth of the flesh și of the bread shall voi a arde cu foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומפתח אהל מועד לא תצאו שבעת ימים עד יום מלאת ימי מלאיכם כי שבעת ימים ימלא את ידיכם
verses.english: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation [in] seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.romanian: și să nu a merge out of the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii [in] șapte zile, until the zile of vostru consecration fi at an end: căci șapte zile shall he a consacra voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאשר עשה ביום הזה צוה יהוה לעשות לכפר עליכם
verses.english: As he hath done this day, [so] the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.romanian: As he sunt done this zi, [so] DOMNUL sunt a poruncit to a face, to a face an ispășire pentru voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופתח אהל מועד תשבו יומם ולילה שבעת ימים ושמרתם את משמרת יהוה ולא תמותו כי כן צויתי
verses.english: Therefore shall ye abide [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.romanian: de aceea shall voi abide [at] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii zi și night șapte zile, și a păzi the charge of DOMNUL, că voi die nu: căci so I am a poruncit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש אהרן ובניו את כל הדברים אשר צוה יהוה ביד משה
verses.english: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: So Aaron și lui fii a făcut toți things care DOMNUL a poruncit by the hand of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי ביום השמיני קרא משה לאהרן ולבניו ולזקני ישראל
verses.english: And it came to pass on the eighth day, [that] Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.romanian: și it a venit to pass on the eighth zi, [că] Moise a chemat Aaron și lui fii, și the elders of Israel;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אל אהרן קח לך עגל בן בקר לחטאת ואיל לעלה תמימם והקריב לפני יהוה
verses.english: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer [them] before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și he a spus lui Aaron, a lua te a young vițel căci a jertfă de păcat, și a berbec căci a ardere-de-tot, fără cusur, și a aduce [ei] înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל זקני ישראל תדבר לאמר קחו שעיר עזים לחטאת ועגל וכבש בני שנה תמימם לעלה
verses.english: And unto the elders of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, [both] of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
verses.romanian: și unto the elders of Israel să a vorbi, saying, a lua voi a kid of the țapi căci a jertfă de păcat; și a vițel și a miel, [both] of the primul an, fără cusur, căci a ardere-de-tot;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושור ואיל לשלמים לזבח לפני יהוה ומנחה בלולה בשמן כי היום יהוה נראה אליכם
verses.english: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.
verses.romanian: de asemenea a vițel și a berbec căci peace jertfe, to jertfă înainte DOMNUL; și a dar de mâncare mingled cu oil: căci to zi DOMNUL will appear vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקחו את אשר צוה משה אל פני אהל מועד ויקרבו כל העדה ויעמדו לפני יהוה
verses.english: And they brought [that] which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și they a adus [că] care Moise a poruncit înainte Cortul Întâlnirii: și toți obștea drew lângă și stood înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה זה הדבר אשר צוה יהוה תעשון ויראה אליכם כבוד יהוה
verses.english: And Moses said, This [is] the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus, This [este] the thing care DOMNUL a poruncit că voi should a face: și the glory of DOMNUL shall appear vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל אהרן קרב אל המזבח ועשה את חטאתך ואת עלתך וכפר בעדך ובעד העם ועשה את קרבן העם וכפר בעדם כאשר צוה יהוה
verses.english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus lui Aaron, a merge unto altarul, și a aduce tău jertfă de păcat, și tău ardere-de-tot, și a face an ispășire căci thyself, și căci the people: și a aduce the jertfă of the people, și a face an ispășire pentru ei; as DOMNUL a poruncit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרב אהרן אל המזבח וישחט את עגל החטאת אשר לו
verses.english: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which [was] for himself.
verses.romanian: Aaron de aceea a mers unto altarul, și slew the vițel of the jertfă de păcat, care [era] căci himself.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריבו בני אהרן את הדם אליו ויטבל אצבעו בדם ויתן על קרנות המזבח ואת הדם יצק אל יסוד המזבח
verses.english: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
verses.romanian: și the fii of Aaron a adus the sânge lui: și he dipped lui finger in the sânge, și a pune [it] upon the coarne of altarul, și a turnat out the sânge at the bottom of altarul:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת החלב ואת הכליות ואת היותרת מן הכבד מן החטאת הקטיר המזבחה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: dar the fat, și the kidneys, și the caul deasupra the liver of the jertfă de păcat, he burnt upon altarul; as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הבשר ואת העור שרף באש מחוץ למחנה
verses.english: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.romanian: și the flesh și the hide he burnt cu foc fără the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישחט את העלה וימציאו בני אהרן אליו את הדם ויזרקהו על המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
verses.romanian: și he slew the ardere-de-tot; și Aaron's fii presented lui the sânge, care he stropit round about upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת העלה המציאו אליו לנתחיה ואת הראש ויקטר המזבחה
verses.english: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt [them] upon the altar.
verses.romanian: și they presented the ardere-de-tot lui, cu the pieces thereof, și the cap: și he burnt [ei] upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירחץ את הקרב ואת הכרעים ויקטר על העלה המזבחה
verses.english: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt [them] upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.romanian: și he a făcut a spăla the inwards și the legs, și burnt [ei] upon the ardere-de-tot on altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריב את קרבן העם ויקח את שעיר החטאת אשר לעם וישחטהו ויחטאהו כראישון
verses.english: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which [was] the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.romanian: și he a adus the people's jertfă, și a luat the țap, care [era] the jertfă de păcat căci the people, și slew it, și a adus it căci păcat, as the first.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרב את העלה ויעשה כמשפט
verses.english: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.romanian: și he a adus the ardere-de-tot, și a adus it după the manner.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרב את המנחה וימלא כפיו ממנה ויקטר על המזבח מלבד עלת הבקר
verses.english: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handfuls thereof, and burnt [it] upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.romanian: și he a adus the dar de mâncare, și a luat an handfuls thereof, și burnt [it] upon altarul, beside the ardere-de-tot of the morning.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישחט את השור ואת האיל זבח השלמים אשר לעם וימציאו בני אהרן את הדם אליו ויזרקהו על המזבח סביב
verses.english: He slew also the bullock and the ram [for] a sacrifice of peace offerings, which [was] for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about
verses.romanian: He slew de asemenea the vițel și the berbec [căci] a jertfă of peace jertfe, care [era] căci the people: și Aaron's fii presented lui the sânge, care he stropit upon altarul round about

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת החלבים מן השור ומן האיל האליה והמכסה והכליות ויותרת הכבד
verses.english: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth [the inwards], and the kidneys, and the caul [above] the liver:
verses.romanian: și the fat of the vițel și of the berbec, the rump, și că care covereth [the inwards], și the kidneys, și the caul [deasupra] the liver:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישם את החלבים על החזות ויקטר החלבים המזבחה
verses.english: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.romanian: și they a pune the fat upon the breasts, și he burnt the fat upon altarul:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת החזות ואת שוק הימין הניף אהרן תנופה לפני יהוה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved [for] a wave offering before the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și the breasts și the right shoulder Aaron waved [căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL; as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישא אהרן את ידו על העם ויברכם וירד מעשות החטאת והעלה והשלמים
verses.english: And Aaron lifted up his hand over the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.romanian: și Aaron lifted up lui hand peste the people, și blessed ei, și a venit down din jertfă of the jertfă de păcat, și the ardere-de-tot, și peace jertfe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא משה ואהרן אל אהל מועד ויצאו ויברכו את העם וירא כבוד יהוה אל כל העם
verses.english: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.
verses.romanian: și Moise și Aaron a mers into Cortul Întâlnirii, și a venit out, și blessed the people: și the glory of DOMNUL appeared unto toți the people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותצא אש מלפני יהוה ותאכל על המזבח את העלה ואת החלבים ויראו כל העם וירנו ויפלו על פניהם
verses.english: And there came a fire out from before the LORD, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: [which] when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.romanian: și acolo a venit a foc out din înainte DOMNUL, și consumed upon altarul the ardere-de-tot și the fat: [care] când toți the people a văzut, they shouted, și fell on lor faces.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקחו בני אהרן נדב ואביהוא איש מחתתו ויתנו בהן אש וישמו עליהן קטרת ויקריבו לפני יהוה אש זרה אשר לא צוה אתם
verses.english: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not.
verses.romanian: și Nadab și Abihu, the fii of Aaron, a luat either al lor lui censer, și a pune foc therein, și a pune tămâie thereon, și a adus strange foc înainte DOMNUL, care he a poruncit ei nu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותצא אש מלפני יהוה ותאכל אתם וימתו לפני יהוה
verses.english: And there went out fire from the LORD, and devoured them, and they died before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și acolo a mers out foc din DOMNUL, și devoured ei, și they died înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל אהרן הוא אשר דבר יהוה לאמר בקריבי אקדש ועל פני כל העם אכבד וידם אהרן
verses.english: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This [is it] that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.romanian: atunci Moise a spus lui Aaron, This [este it] că DOMNUL a vorbit, saying, voi fi sfințit in ei că a veni nigh mine, și înainte toți the people voi fi glorified. și Aaron held lui peace.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא משה אל מישאל ואל אליצפן בני עזיאל דד אהרן ויאמר אליהם קרבו שאו את אחיכם מאת פני הקדש אל מחוץ למחנה
verses.english: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.romanian: și Moise a chemat Mishael și Elzaphan, the fii of Uzziel the unchi of Aaron, și a spus lor, a veni lângă, carry vostru brethren din înainte Sanctuarul out of the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרבו וישאו אתם בכיתנותם אל מחוץ למחנה כאשר דבר משה
verses.english: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
verses.romanian: So they a mers lângă, și carried ei in lor coats out of the tabără; as Moise had a spus.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל אהרן ואל אלעזר ואל איתמר בניו ראשיכם לא תפרעו ובגדיכם לא תפרמו ולא תמותו ועל כל העדה יקצף ואחיכם כל בית ישראל יבכו את השרפה אשר שרף יהוה
verses.english: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus lui Aaron, și unto Eleazar și unto Ithamar, lui fii, Uncover nu vostru heads, neither rend vostru clothes; lest voi die, și lest wrath a veni upon toți the people: dar let vostru brethren, the whole casă of Israel, bewail the burning care DOMNUL sunt kindled.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומפתח אהל מועד לא תצאו פן תמותו כי שמן משחת יהוה עליכם ויעשו כדבר משה
verses.english: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD [is] upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.romanian: și să nu a merge out din the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, lest voi die: căci the ungere oil of DOMNUL [este] upon voi. și they a făcut după the word of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יין ושכר אל תשתה אתה ובניך אתך בבאכם אל אהל מועד ולא תמותו חקת עולם לדרתיכם
verses.english: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.romanian: a face nu drink wine nor strong drink, tu, nor tău fii cu tine, când voi a merge into Cortul Întâlnirii, lest voi die: [it shall fi] a decret veșnic în toate generațiile voastre:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולהבדיל בין הקדש ובין החל ובין הטמא ובין הטהור
verses.english: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
verses.romanian: și că voi poate a pune difference between sfânt și unholy, și between necurat și curat;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולהורות את בני ישראל את כל החקים אשר דבר יהוה אליהם ביד משה
verses.english: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: și că voi poate a învăța the copii of Israel toți the decrete care DOMNUL sunt spoken lor by the hand of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל אהרן ואל אלעזר ואל איתמר בניו הנותרים קחו את המנחה הנותרת מאשי יהוה ואכלוה מצות אצל המזבח כי קדש קדשים היא
verses.english: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it [is] most holy:
verses.romanian: și Moise a vorbit lui Aaron, și unto Eleazar și unto Ithamar, lui fii că erau left, a lua the dar de mâncare că remaineth of the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc, și eat it fără leaven beside altarul: căci it [este] preasfânt:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלתם אתה במקום קדוש כי חקך וחק בניך היא מאשי יהוה כי כן צויתי
verses.english: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it [is] thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.romanian: și voi să mănânce it in locul sfânt, pentru că it [este] tău due, și tău fii' due, of the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc: căci so I am a poruncit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת חזה התנופה ואת שוק התרומה תאכלו במקום טהור אתה ובניך ובנתיך אתך כי חקך וחק בניך נתנו מזבחי שלמי בני ישראל
verses.english: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for [they be] thy due, and thy sons' due, [which] are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și the wave breast și heave shoulder shall voi eat in a curat loc; tu, și tău fii, și tău fiice cu tine: căci [they fi] tău due, și tău fii' due, [care] sunt dat out of the jertfe of peace jertfe of the copii of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שוק התרומה וחזה התנופה על אשי החלבים יביאו להניף תנופה לפני יהוה והיה לך ולבניך ולבנתיך אתך לחק עולם כאשר צוה יהוה
verses.english: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave [it for] a wave offering before the LORD; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.
verses.romanian: The heave shoulder și the wave breast shall they a aduce cu the jertfe a făcut by foc of the fat, to wave [it căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL; și it shall fi thine, și tău fii' și tău fiice cu tine, by a decret veșnic; as DOMNUL sunt a poruncit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת שעיר החטאת דרש דרש משה והנה שרוף ויקצף על אלעזר ועל איתמר בני אהרן הנותרים לאמר
verses.english: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron [which were] left [alive], saying
verses.romanian: și Moise diligently sought the țap of the jertfă de păcat, și, iată, it era burnt: și he era angry cu Eleazar și Ithamar, the fii of Aaron [care erau] left [alive], saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מדוע לא אכלתם את החטאת במקום הקדש כי קדש קדשים היא ואתה נתן לכם לשאת את עון העדה לכפר עליהם לפני יהוה
verses.english: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it [is] most holy, and [God] hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD?
verses.romanian: de aceea au voi nu eaten the jertfă de păcat in locul sfânt, seeing it [este] preasfânt, și [Dumnezeu] sunt dat it voi to bear the nelegiuire of obștea, to a face ispășire pentru ei înainte DOMNUL?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הן לא הובא את דמה אל הקדש פנימה אכל תאכלו אתה בקדש כאשר צויתי
verses.english: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy [place]: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy [place], as I commanded.
verses.romanian: iată, the sânge of it era nu a adus in în the sfânt [loc]: voi should într-adevăr au eaten it in the sfânt [loc], as I a poruncit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר אהרן אל משה הן היום הקריבו את חטאתם ואת עלתם לפני יהוה ותקראנה אתי כאלה ואכלתי חטאת היום הייטב בעיני יהוה
verses.english: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD; and such things have befallen me: and [if] I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD?
verses.romanian: și Aaron a spus unto Moise, iată, this zi au they a adus lor jertfă de păcat și lor ardere-de-tot înainte DOMNUL; și such things au befallen mine: și [dacă] I had eaten the jertfă de păcat to zi, should it au been accepted in the sight of DOMNUL?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע משה וייטב בעיניו
verses.english: And when Moses heard [that], he was content.
verses.romanian: și când Moise a auzit [că], he era content.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר אליהם
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise și to Aaron, saying lor

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דברו אל בני ישראל לאמר זאת החיה אשר תאכלו מכל הבהמה אשר על הארץ
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These [are] the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that [are] on the earth.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, saying, These [sunt] the beasts care voi să mănânce în mijlocul toți the beasts că [sunt] on the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל מפריסת פרסה ושסעת שסע שתי פרסות מעלות גרה בבהמה אתה תאכלו
verses.english: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted in pairs, [and] cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
verses.romanian: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, și este clovenfooted in pairs, [și] cheweth the cud, în mijlocul the beasts, că shall voi eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך את זה לא תאכלו ממעלי הגרה וממפריסי הפרסה את הגמל כי מעלי גרה הוא ופרסה איננו מפריס טמא הוא לכם
verses.english: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: [as] the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he [is] unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: Nevertheless these shall voi nu eat al lor că chew the cud, sau al lor că divide the hoof: [as] the camel, pentru că he cheweth the cud, dar divideth nu the hoof; he [este] necurat vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת השפן כי מעלי גרה הוא ופרסה לא הפריס טמא הוא לכם
verses.english: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he [is] unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: și the coney, pentru că he cheweth the cud, dar divideth nu the hoof; he [este] necurat vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הארנבת כי מעלת גרה היא ופרסה לא הפריסה טמאה היא לכם
verses.english: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he [is] unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: și the hare, pentru că he cheweth the cud, dar divideth nu the hoof; he [este] necurat vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת החזיר כי מפריס פרסה הוא ושסע שסע פרסה והוא גרה לא יגור טמא הוא לכם
verses.english: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he [is] unclean to you.
verses.romanian: și the swine, though he divide the hoof, și fi clovenfooted, yet he cheweth nu the cud; he [este] necurat to voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבשרם לא תאכלו ובנבלתם לא תגעו טמאים הם לכם
verses.english: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they [are] unclean to you.
verses.romanian: Of lor flesh shall voi nu eat, și lor carcase shall voi nu touch; they [sunt] necurat to voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת זה תאכלו מכל אשר במים כל אשר לו סנפיר וקשקשת במים בימים ובנחלים אתם תאכלו
verses.english: And these shall ye eat of all that [are] in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
verses.romanian: și these shall voi eat of toți că [sunt] in the ape: whatsoever sunt fins și scales in the ape, in the seas, și in the rivers, ei shall voi eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר אין לו סנפיר וקשקשת במים בימים ובנחלים מכל שרץ המים ומכל נפש החיה אשר במים שקץ הם לכם
verses.english: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas yea in seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which [is] in the waters, they [shall be] an abomination unto you:
verses.romanian: și toți că au nu fins și scales in the seas yea in seas, și in the rivers, of toți că move in the ape, și of vreun living thing care [este] in the ape, they [shall fi] an urâciune vouă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושקץ יהיו לכם מבשרם לא תאכלו ואת נבלתם תשקצו
verses.english: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
verses.romanian: ei să fi even an urâciune vouă; voi să nu mănânce of lor flesh, dar să au lor carcases in urâciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר אין לו סנפיר וקשקשת במים שקץ הוא לכם
verses.english: And whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that [shall be] an abomination unto you.
verses.romanian: și whatsoever sunt no fins nor scales in the ape, că [shall fi] an urâciune vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת אלה תשקצו מן העוף לא תאכלו שקץ הם את הנשר ואת הפרס ואת העזניה
verses.english: And these [are they which] ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; you shall not eat, they [are] an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the osprey
verses.romanian: și these [sunt they care] să au in urâciune în mijlocul the fowls; voi să nu mănânce, they [sunt] an urâciune: the eagle, și the ossifrage, și the osprey

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הדאה ואת האיה למינה
verses.english: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
verses.romanian: și the vulture, și the kite după soiul lui;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל ערב למינו
verses.english: And every raven after his kind;
verses.romanian: și fiecare raven după soiul lui;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת בת היענה ואת התחמוס ואת השחף למינו ואת הנץ
verses.english: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckoo after his kind, and the hawk after his kind
verses.romanian: și the owl, și the night hawk, și the cuckoo după soiul lui, și the hawk după soiul lui

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הכוס ואת השלך ואת הינשוף
verses.english: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl
verses.romanian: și the little owl, și the cormorant, și the great owl

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת התנשמת ואת הקאת ואת הרחמה
verses.english: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle
verses.romanian: și the swan, și the pelican, și the gier eagle

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת החסידה והאנפה למינה ואת הדגיפת ואת העטלף
verses.english: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.romanian: și the stork, și the heron după ei kind, și the lapwing, și the bat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל שרץ העוף ההלך על ארבע שקץ הוא לכם
verses.english: And all fowls that creep, going upon [all] four, [shall be] an abomination unto you.
verses.romanian: și toți fowls că creep, going upon [toți] patru, [shall fi] an urâciune vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך את זה תאכלו מכל שרץ העוף ההלך על ארבע אשר לו כרעים ממעל לרגליו לנתר בהם על הארץ
verses.english: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon [all] four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
verses.romanian: Yet these poate voi eat of fiecare flying creeping thing că goeth upon [toți] patru, care au legs deasupra lor feet, to leap withal upon the pământ;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את אלה מהם תאכלו את הארבה למינהו ואת הסלעם למינהו ואת החרגל למינה ואת החגב למינהו
verses.english: [Even] these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
verses.romanian: [Even] these al lor voi poate eat; the locust după soiul lui, și the pleșuv locust după soiul lui, și the beetle după soiul lui, și the grasshopper după soiul lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל שרץ העוף אשר לו ארבע רגלים שקץ הוא לכם
verses.english: But all [other] flying creeping things, which have four feet, [shall be] an abomination unto you.
verses.romanian: dar toți [other] flying creeping things, care au patru feet, [shall fi] an urâciune vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולאלה תטמאו כל הנגע בנבלתם יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și căci these să fi necurat: whosoever toucheth the carcase al lor shall fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הנשא מנבלתם יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whosoever beareth [ought] of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, wash in waters, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whosoever beareth [ought] of the carcase al lor shall a spăla lui clothes, a spăla in ape, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לכל הבהמה אשר היא מפריסת פרסה ושסעה איננה שסע וגרה איננה מעלה טמאים הם לכם כל הנגע בהם יטמא
verses.english: [The carcases] of every beast which divideth the hoof, and [is] not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, [are] unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: [The carcases] of fiecare beast care divideth the hoof, și [este] nu clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, [sunt] necurat vouă: fiecare unu că toucheth ei shall fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל ההלך על כפיו בכל החיה ההלכת על ארבע טמאים הם לכם כל הנגע בנבלתם יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on [all] four, those [are] unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whatsoever goeth upon lui paws, în mijlocul toți manner of beasts că a merge on [toți] patru, those [sunt] necurat vouă: whoso toucheth lor carcase shall fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנשא מנבלתם יכבס בגדיו וטמא עד הערב טמאים הם לכם
verses.english: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they [are] unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: și he că beareth the carcase al lor shall a spăla lui clothes, și fi necurat until the even: they [sunt] necurat vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה לכם הטמא בשרץ השרץ על הארץ החלד והעכבור והצב למינו
verses.english: These also [shall be] unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind
verses.romanian: These de asemenea [shall fi] necurat vouă în mijlocul the creeping things că creep upon the pământ; the weasel, și the mouse, și the tortoise după soiul lui

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאנקה והכח והלאטה והמט והתנשמת
verses.english: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
verses.romanian: și the ferret, și the chameleon, și the lizard, și the snail, și the mole.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה הטמאים לכם מכל השרץ כל הנגע בהם במותם יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: These [are] unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] necurat to voi în mijlocul toți că creep: whosoever doth touch ei, când they fi dead, shall fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר יפל עליו מהם במותם יטמא מכל כלי עץ או בגד או עור או שק כל כלי אשר יעשה מלאכה בהם במים יבוא וטמא עד הערב וטהר
verses.english: And upon whatsoever [any] of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether [it be] any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel [it be], wherein [any] work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
verses.romanian: și upon whatsoever [vreun] al lor, când they sunt dead, doth fall, it shall fi necurat; whether [it fi] vreun vessel of lemn, sau raiment, sau piele, sau sack, whatsoever vessel [it fi], wherein [vreun] lucrare este done, it trebuie fi a pune into apă, și it shall fi necurat until the even; so it shall fi curățit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל כלי חרש אשר יפל מהם אל תוכו כל אשר בתוכו יטמא ואתו תשברו
verses.english: And every earthen vessel, whereinto [any] of them falleth, whatsoever [is] in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
verses.romanian: și fiecare earthen vessel, whereinto [vreun] al lor falleth, whatsoever [este] in it shall fi necurat; și să break it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מכל האכל אשר יאכל אשר יבוא עליו מים יטמא וכל משקה אשר ישתה בכל כלי יטמא
verses.english: Of all meat which may be eaten, [that] on which [such] water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every [such] vessel shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: Of toți carne care poate fi eaten, [că] on care [such] apă cometh shall fi necurat: și toți drink că poate fi drunk in fiecare [such] vessel shall fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר יפל מנבלתם עליו יטמא תנור וכרים יתצו טמאים הם וטמאים יהיו לכם
verses.english: And every [thing] whereupon [any part] of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; [whether it be] oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: [for] they [are] unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: și fiecare [thing] whereupon [vreun part] of lor carcase falleth shall fi necurat; [whether it fi] oven, sau ranges căci pots, ei să fi broken down: [căci] they [sunt] necurat, și shall fi necurat vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך מעין מים ובור מקוה מים יהיה טהור ונגע בנבלתם יטמא
verses.english: Nevertheless a fountain of waters or pit, [wherein there is] plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: Nevertheless a fountain of ape sau pit, [wherein acolo este] plenty of apă, shall fi curat: dar că care toucheth lor carcase shall fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יפל מנבלתם על זרע זרע אשר יזרע טהור הוא
verses.english: And if [any part] of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it [shall be] clean.
verses.romanian: și dacă [vreun part] of lor carcase fall upon vreun sowing sămânță care este to fi sown, it [shall fi] curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יתן מים על הזרע ונפל מנבלתם עליו טמא הוא לכם
verses.english: But if [any] water be put upon the seed, and [any part] of their carcase fall thereon, it [shall be] unclean unto you.
verses.romanian: dar dacă [vreun] apă fi a pune upon the sămânță, și [vreun part] of lor carcase fall thereon, it [shall fi] necurat vouă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי ימות מן הבהמה אשר היא לכם לאכלה הנגע בנבלתה יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și dacă vreun beast, of care voi poate eat, die; he că toucheth the carcase thereof shall fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאכל מנבלתה יכבס בגדיו וטמא עד הערב והנשא את נבלתה יכבס בגדיו וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și he că eateth of the carcase of it shall a spăla lui clothes, și fi necurat until the even: he de asemenea că beareth the carcase of it shall a spăla lui clothes, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל השרץ השרץ על הארץ שקץ הוא לא יאכל
verses.english: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth [shall be] an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.romanian: și fiecare creeping thing că creepeth upon the pământ [shall fi] an urâciune; it shall nu fi eaten.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ההלך על גחון וכל ההלך על ארבע עד כל מרבה רגלים לכל השרץ השרץ על הארץ לא תאכלום כי שקץ הם
verses.english: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon [all] four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they [are] an abomination.
verses.romanian: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, și whatsoever goeth upon [toți] patru, sau whatsoever sunt more feet în mijlocul toți creeping things că creep upon the pământ, ei voi să nu mănânce; căci they [sunt] an urâciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תשקצו את נפשתיכם בכל השרץ השרץ ולא תטמאו בהם ונטמאתם בם
verses.english: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.romanian: să nu a face yourselves abominable cu vreun creeping thing că creepeth, neither shall voi a face yourselves necurat cu ei, că voi should fi pângărit thereby.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אני יהוה אלהיכם והתקדשתם והייתם קדישים כי קדוש אני ולא תטמאו את נפשתיכם בכל השרץ הרמש על הארץ
verses.english: For I [am] the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I [am] holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.romanian: căci I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu: să de aceea a sfinți yourselves, și să fi sfânt; căci I [am] sfânt: neither shall voi a pângări yourselves cu vreun manner of creeping thing că creepeth upon the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אני יהוה אלהיכם המעלה אתכם מארץ מצרים להיות לכם לאלהים והייתם קדישים כי קדוש אני
verses.english: For I [am] the LORD God that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I [am] holy.
verses.romanian: căci I [am] DOMNUL Dumnezeu că bringeth voi up out of the țară of Egypt, to fi vostru Dumnezeu: să de aceea fi sfânt, căci I [am] sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת תורת הבהמה והעוף וכל הנפש החיה הרמשת במים לכל הנפש השרצת על הארץ
verses.english: This [is] the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
verses.romanian: This [este] the lege of the beasts, și of the fowl, și of fiecare living creature că moveth in the ape, of fiecare creature că creepeth upon the pământ:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: להבדיל בין הטמא ובין הטהור ובין החיה הנאכלת ובין החיה אשר לא תאכל
verses.english: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
verses.romanian: To a face a difference between the necurat și the curat, și between the beast că poate fi eaten și the beast că poate nu fi eaten.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל לאמר אשה כי תזרע וילדה זכר וטמאה שבעת ימים כימי נדת דותה תטמא
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, saying, dacă a femeie au conceived sămânță, și born a om copil: atunci ea să fi necurat șapte zile; după the zile of the separation căci ei infirmity shall she fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השמיני ימול את בשר ערלתו
verses.english: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.romanian: și in the eighth zi the flesh of lui foreskin shall fi circumcised.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושלשים יום ושלשת ימים תשב בדם טהרה בכל קדש לא תגע ואל המקדש לא תבוא עד מלאת ימי טהרה
verses.english: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.romanian: și ea să atunci continue in the sânge of ei purifying trei și treizeci zile; ea să touch no hallowed thing, nor a veni into Sanctuarul, until the zile of ei purifying fi fulfilled.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם נקבה תלד וטמאה שבועים כנדתה וששים יום וששת ימים תשב על דמי טהרה
verses.english: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
verses.romanian: dar dacă she bear a maid copil, atunci ea să fi necurat doi weeks, as in ei separation: și ea să continue in the sânge of ei purifying threescore și șase zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובמלאת ימי טהרה לבן או לבת תביא כבש בן שנתו לעלה או בן יונה או תר לחטאת אל פתח אהל מועד אל הכהן
verses.english: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
verses.romanian: și când the zile of ei purifying sunt fulfilled, căci a fiu, sau căci a fiică, ea să a aduce a miel of the primul an căci a ardere-de-tot, și a young pigeon, sau a turtledove, căci a jertfă de păcat, unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, unto the preot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריבו לפני יהוה וכפר עליה הכהן וטהרה ממקור דמיה זאת תורת הילדת לזכר ולנקבה
verses.english: The Priest who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This [is] the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
verses.romanian: The preot care shall a aduce it înainte DOMNUL, și a face an ispășire căci ei; și ea să fi curățit din the scurgere of ei sânge. This [este] the lege căci ei că sunt born a mascul sau a femelă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא תמצא ידה די שה ולקחה שתי תרים או שני בני יונה אחד לחטאת ואחד לעלה וכפר עליה הכהן וטהרה
verses.english: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.romanian: și dacă she fi nu able to a aduce a miel, atunci ea să a aduce doi turtles, sau doi young pigeons; the unu căci the jertfă de păcat, și the other căci a ardere-de-tot: și the preot shall a face an ispășire căci ei, și ea să fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise și Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אדם כי יהיה בעור בשרו שאת או ספחת או בהרת והיה בעור בשרו לנגע צרעת והובא אל אהרן הכהן או אל אחד מבניו הכהנים
verses.english: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh [like] the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.romanian: când a om shall au in the piele of lui flesh a rising, a pecingine, sau bright pată, și it fi in the piele of lui flesh [like] the plagă of lepră; atunci el să fi a adus lui Aaron the preot, sau unto unu of lui fii the preoți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן את הנגע בעור הבשר ושער בנגע הפך לבן ומראה הנגע עמק מעור בשרו נגע צרעת הוא וראה הכהן וטמא אתו
verses.english: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and [when] the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight [be] deeper than the skin of his flesh, it [is] a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall look on the plagă in the piele of the flesh: și [când] the păr in the plagă este s-a întors white, și the plagă in sight [fi] deeper than the piele of lui flesh, it [este] a plagă of lepră: și the preot shall look on lui, și a declara lui necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בהרת לבנה היא בעור בשרו ועמק אין מראה מן העור ושערה לא הפך לבן והסגיר הכהן את הנגע שבעת ימים
verses.english: If the bright spot [be] white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight [be] not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague seven days:
verses.romanian: dacă the bright pată [fi] white in the piele of lui flesh, și in sight [fi] nu deeper than the piele, și the păr thereof fi nu s-a întors white; atunci the preot shall a închide [lui că sunt] the plagă șapte zile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן ביום השביעי והנה הנגע עמד בעיניו לא פשה הנגע בעור והסגירו הכהן שבעת ימים שנית
verses.english: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, [if] the plague in his sight be at a stay, [and] the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall look on lui the a șaptea zi: și, iată, [dacă] the plagă in lui sight fi at a a rămâne, [și] the plagă spread nu in the piele; atunci the preot shall închis lui up șapte zile more:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן ביום השביעי שנית והנה כהה הנגע לא פשה הנגע בעור וטהרו הכהן המספחת היא וכבס בגדיו וטהר
verses.english: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, [if] the plague [be] somewhat dark, [and] the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it [is but] a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall look on lui again the a șaptea zi: și, iată, [dacă] the plagă [fi] somewhat dark, [și] the plagă spread nu in the piele, the preot shall a declara lui curat: it [este dar] a pecingine: și el să a spăla lui clothes, și fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם פשה תפשה המספחת בעור אחרי הראתו אל הכהן לטהרתו ונראה שנית אל הכהן
verses.english: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:
verses.romanian: dar dacă the pecingine spread much abroad in the piele, după că he sunt been seen of the preot căci lui cleansing, el să fi seen of the preot again:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן והנה פשתה המספחת בעור וטמאו הכהן צרעת היא
verses.english: And [if] the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a leprosy.
verses.romanian: și [dacă] the preot a vedea că, iată, the pecingine spreadeth in the piele, atunci the preot shall a declara lui necurat: it [este] a lepră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונגע צרעת כי תהיה באדם והובא אל הכהן
verses.english: And when the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.romanian: și când the plagă of lepră este in a om, atunci el să fi a adus unto the preot;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן והנה שאת לבנה בעור והיא הפך שער לבן ומחית בשר חי בשאת
verses.english: And the priest shall see [him]: and, behold, [if] the rising [be] white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and [there be] quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a vedea [lui]: și, iată, [dacă] the rising [fi] white in the piele, și it au s-a întors the păr white, și [acolo fi] quick carne vie in the rising;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צרעת נושנת היא בעור בשרו וטמאו הכהן לא יסגירנו כי טמא הוא
verses.english: It [is] an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he [is] unclean.
verses.romanian: It [este] an old lepră in the piele of lui flesh, și the preot shall a declara lui necurat, și shall nu închis lui up: căci he [este] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם פרח תפרח הצרעת בעור וכסתה הצרעת את כל עור הנגע מראשו עד רגליו לכל מראה עיני הכהן
verses.english: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of [him that hath] the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.romanian: și dacă a lepră break out abroad in the piele, și the lepră a acoperi toți the piele of [lui că sunt] the plagă din lui cap even to lui foot, wheresoever the preot looketh;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן והנה כסתה הצרעת את כל בשרו וטהר את הנגע כלו הפך לבן טהור הוא
verses.english: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, [if] the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: it is all turned white: he [is] clean.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall consider: și, iată, [dacă] the lepră au covered toți lui flesh, el să a declara [lui] curat [că sunt] the plagă: it este toți s-a întors white: he [este] curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום הראות בו בשר חי יטמא
verses.english: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: dar când carne vie appeareth in lui, el să fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן את הבשר החי וטמאו הבשר החי טמא הוא צרעת היא
verses.english: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: [for] the raw flesh [is] unclean: it [is] a leprosy.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a vedea the carne vie, și a declara lui to fi necurat: [căci] the carne vie [este] necurat: it [este] a lepră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או כי ישוב הבשר החי ונהפך ללבן ובא אל הכהן
verses.english: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.romanian: sau dacă the carne vie a se întoarce again, și fi changed unto white, el să a veni unto the preot;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן והנה נהפך הנגע ללבן וטהר הכהן את הנגע טהור הוא
verses.english: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, [if] the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce [him] clean [that hath] the plague: he [is] clean.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a vedea lui: și, iată, [dacă] the plagă fi s-a întors into white; atunci the preot shall a declara [lui] curat [că sunt] the plagă: he [este] curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשר כי יהיה בו שחין ונרפא
verses.english: The flesh also, in which, [even] in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed
verses.romanian: The flesh de asemenea, in care, [even] in the piele thereof, era a bubă, și este healed

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה במקום השחין שאת לבנה או בהרת לבנה אדמדמת ונראה אל הכהן
verses.english: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.romanian: și in the loc of the bubă acolo fi a white rising, sau a bright pată, white, și somewhat reddish, și it fi shewed to the preot;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן והנה מראהו שפל מן העור ושערו הפך לבן וטמאו הכהן נגע צרעת היא בשחין פרחה
verses.english: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it [be] in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.romanian: și dacă, când the preot seeth it, iată, it [fi] in sight lower than the piele, și the păr thereof fi s-a întors white; the preot shall a declara lui necurat: it [este] a plagă of lepră broken out of the bubă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם יראה הכהן והנה אין בה שער לבן ושפלה איננה מן העור והיא כהה והסגירו הכהן שבעת ימים
verses.english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, [there be] no white hairs therein, and [if] it [be] not lower than the skin, but [be] somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.romanian: dar dacă the preot look on it, și, iată, [acolo fi] no white hairs therein, și [dacă] it [fi] nu lower than the piele, dar [fi] somewhat dark; atunci the preot shall închis lui up șapte zile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם פשה תפשה בעור וטמא הכהן אתו נגע הוא
verses.english: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a plague.
verses.romanian: și dacă it spread much abroad in the piele, atunci the preot shall a declara lui necurat: it [este] a plagă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם תחתיה תעמד הבהרת לא פשתה צרבת השחין היא וטהרו הכהן
verses.english: But if the bright spot stay in his place, [and] spread not, it [is] a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.romanian: dar dacă the bright pată a rămâne in lui loc, [și] spread nu, it [este] a burning bubă; și the preot shall a declara lui curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או בשר כי יהיה בעורו מכות אש והיתה מחית המכוה בהרת לבנה אדמדמת או לבנה
verses.english: Or if there be [any] flesh, in the skin whereof [there is] a hot burning, and the quick [flesh] that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.romanian: sau dacă acolo fi [vreun] flesh, in the piele whereof [acolo este] a hot burning, și the quick [flesh] că burneth au a white bright pată, somewhat reddish, sau white;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה אתה הכהן והנה הפך שער לבן בבהרת ומראה עמק מן העור צרעת היא במכוה פרחה וטמא אתו הכהן נגע צרעת היא
verses.english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, [if] the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it [be in] sight deeper than the skin; it [is] a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] the plague of leprosy.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall look upon it: și, iată, [dacă] the păr in the bright pată fi s-a întors white, și it [fi in] sight deeper than the piele; it [este] a lepră broken out of the burning: de aceea the preot shall a declara lui necurat: it [este] the plagă of lepră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם יראה הכהן והנה אין בבהרת שער לבן ושפלה איננה מן העור והיא כהה והסגירו הכהן שבעת ימים
verses.english: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, [there be] no white hair in the bright spot, and it [be] no lower than the [other] skin, but [be] somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.romanian: dar dacă the preot look on it, și, iată, [acolo fi] no white păr in the bright pată, și it [fi] no lower than the [other] piele, dar [fi] somewhat dark; atunci the preot shall închis lui up șapte zile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן ביום השביעי אם פשה תפשה בעור וטמא אתו הכהן נגע צרעת היא
verses.english: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: [and] if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] the plague of leprosy.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall look upon lui the a șaptea zi: [și] dacă it fi spread much abroad in the piele, atunci the preot shall a declara lui necurat: it [este] the plagă of lepră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם תחתיה תעמד הבהרת לא פשתה בעור והיא כהה שאת המכוה היא וטהרו הכהן כי צרבת המכוה היא
verses.english: And if the bright spot stay in his place, [and] spread not in the skin, but it [be] somewhat dark; it [is] a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it [is] an inflammation of the burning.
verses.romanian: și dacă the bright pată a rămâne in lui loc, [și] spread nu in the piele, dar it [fi] somewhat dark; it [este] a rising of the burning, și the preot shall a declara lui curat: căci it [este] an inflammation of the burning.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש או אשה כי יהיה בו נגע בראש או בזקן
verses.english: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.romanian: dacă a om sau femeie au a plagă upon the cap sau the barbă;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן את הנגע והנה מראהו עמק מן העור ובו שער צהב דק וטמא הכהן אתו נתק הוא צרעת הראש או הזקן היא
verses.english: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it [be] in sight deeper than the skin; [and there be] in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it [is] a dry scall, [even] a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall a vedea the plagă: și, iată, dacă it [fi] in sight deeper than the piele; [și acolo fi] in it a yellow thin păr; atunci the preot shall a declara lui necurat: it [este] a dry scall, [even] a lepră upon the cap sau barbă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או כי יראה הכהן את נגע הנתק והנה אין מראהו עמק מן העור ושער שחר אין בו והסגיר הכהן את נגע הנתק שבעת ימים
verses.english: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it [be] not in sight deeper than the skin, and [that there is] no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.romanian: și dacă the preot look on the plagă of the scall, și, iată, it [fi] nu in sight deeper than the piele, și [că acolo este] no black păr in it; atunci the preot shall a închide [lui că sunt] the plagă of the scall șapte zile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן את הנתק ביום השביעי והנה לא פשה הנתק ולא היה בו שער צהב ומראה הנתק אין עמק מן העור
verses.english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, [if] the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall [be] not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.romanian: și in the a șaptea zi the preot shall look on the scall: și, iată, [dacă] the scall spread nu, și acolo fi in it no yellow păr, și the scall [fi] nu in sight deeper than the piele;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והתגלח ואת הנתק לא יגלח והסגיר הכהן את הנתק שבעת ימים שנית
verses.english: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up [him that hath] the scall seven days more:
verses.romanian: el să fi shaven, dar the scall shall he nu shave; și the preot shall a închide [lui că sunt] the scall șapte zile more:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן את הנתק ביום השביעי והנה לא פשה הנתק בעור ומראהו איננו עמק מן העור וטהרו הכהן וכבס בגדיו וטהר
verses.english: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, [if] the scall be not spread in the skin, nor [be] in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.romanian: și in the a șaptea zi the preot shall look on the scall: și, iată, [dacă] the scall fi nu spread in the piele, nor [fi] in sight deeper than the piele; atunci the preot shall a declara lui curat: și el să a spăla lui clothes, și fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם פשה יפשה הנתק בעור אחרי טהרתו
verses.english: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.romanian: dar dacă the scall spread much in the piele după lui cleansing;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן והנה פשה הנתק בעור לא יבקר הכהן לשער הצהב טמא הוא
verses.english: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he [is] unclean.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall look on lui: și, iată, dacă the scall fi spread in the piele, the preot shall nu seek căci yellow păr; he [este] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בעיניו עמד הנתק ושער שחר צמח בו נרפא הנתק טהור הוא וטהרו הכהן
verses.english: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and [that] there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he [is] clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.romanian: dar dacă the scall fi in lui sight at a a rămâne, și [că] acolo este black păr grown up therein; the scall este healed, he [este] curat: și the preot shall a declara lui curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש או אשה כי יהיה בעור בשרם בהרות בהרות לבנות
verses.english: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, [even] white bright spots;
verses.romanian: dacă a om de asemenea sau a femeie au in the piele of lor flesh bright pete, [even] white bright pete;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן והנה בעור בשרם בהרות כהות לבנות בחק הוא פרח בעור טהור הוא
verses.english: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, [if] the bright spots in the skin of their flesh [be] darkish white; it [is] a freckled spot [that] groweth in the skin; he [is] clean.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall look: și, iată, [dacă] the bright pete in the piele of lor flesh [fi] darkish white; it [este] a freckled pată [că] groweth in the piele; he [este] curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי ימרט ראשו קרח הוא טהור הוא
verses.english: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he [is] bald; [yet is] he clean.
verses.romanian: și the om al cărui păr este fallen off lui cap, he [este] pleșuv; [yet este] he curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מפאת פניו ימרט ראשו גבח הוא טהור הוא
verses.english: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he [is] forehead bald: [yet is] he clean.
verses.romanian: și he că sunt lui păr fallen off din the part of lui cap toward lui face, he [este] forehead pleșuv: [yet este] he curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או כי יהיה בקרחתו או בגבחתו נגע לבן אדמדם צרעת פרחת היא בקרחתו או בגבחתו
verses.english: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it [is] a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.romanian: și dacă acolo fi in the pleșuv cap, sau pleșuv forehead, a white reddish rană; it [este] a lepră sprung up in lui pleșuv cap, sau lui pleșuv forehead.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה אתה הכהן והנה שאת הנגע לבנה אדמדמת בקרחתו או בגבחתו כמראה צרעת עור בשר
verses.english: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, [if] the rising of the sore [be] white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall look upon it: și, iată, [dacă] the rising of the rană [fi] white reddish in lui pleșuv cap, sau in lui pleșuv forehead, as the lepră appeareth in the piele of the flesh;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש צרוע הוא טמא הוא טמא יטמאנו הכהן בראשו נגעו
verses.english: He is a leprous man, he [is] unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague [is] in his head.
verses.romanian: He este a leprous om, he [este] necurat: the preot shall a declara lui utterly necurat; lui plagă [este] in lui cap.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והצרוע אשר בו הנגע בגדיו יהיו פרומים וראשו יהיה פרוע ועל שפם יעטא וטמא טמא יקרא
verses.english: And the leper in whom the plague [is], his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.romanian: și the leper in pe care the plagă [este], lui clothes shall fi rent, și lui cap bare, și el să a pune a acoperământ upon lui upper lip, și shall cry, necurat, necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ימי אשר הנגע בו יטמא טמא הוא בדד ישב מחוץ למחנה מושבו
verses.english: All the days wherein the plague [shall be] in him he shall be defiled; he [is] unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp [shall] his habitation [be].
verses.romanian: toți the zile wherein the plagă [shall fi] in lui el să fi pângărit; he [este] necurat: el să a locui alone; fără the tabără [shall] lui habitation [fi].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבגד כי יהיה בו נגע צרעת בבגד צמר או בבגד פשתים
verses.english: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, [whether it be] a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.romanian: The veșmânt de asemenea că the plagă of lepră este in, [whether it fi] a woollen veșmânt, sau a in veșmânt;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או בשתי או בערב לפשתים ולצמר או בעור או בכל מלאכת עור
verses.english: Whether [it be] in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.romanian: Whether [it fi] in the warp, sau woof; of in, sau of woollen; whether in a piele, sau in vreun thing a făcut of piele;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה הנגע ירקרק או אדמדם בבגד או בעור או בשתי או בערב או בכל כלי עור נגע צרעת הוא והראה את הכהן
verses.english: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it [is] a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.romanian: și dacă the plagă fi greenish sau reddish in the veșmânt, sau in the piele, either in the warp, sau in the woof, sau in vreun thing of piele; it [este] a plagă of lepră, și shall fi shewed unto the preot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן את הנגע והסגיר את הנגע שבעת ימים
verses.english: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up [it that hath] the plague seven days:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall look upon the plagă, și a închide [it că sunt] the plagă șapte zile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה את הנגע ביום השביעי כי פשה הנגע בבגד או בשתי או בערב או בעור לכל אשר יעשה העור למלאכה צרעת ממראת הנגע טמא הוא
verses.english: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, [or] in any work that is made of skin; the plague [is] a fretting leprosy; it [is] unclean.
verses.romanian: și el să look on the plagă on the a șaptea zi: dacă the plagă fi spread in the veșmânt, either in the warp, sau in the woof, sau in a piele, [sau] in vreun lucrare că este a făcut of piele; the plagă [este] a fretting lepră; it [este] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושרף את הבגד או את השתי או את הערב בצמר או בפשתים או את כל כלי העור אשר יהיה בו הנגע כי צרעת ממראת היא באש תשרף
verses.english: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it [is] a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.romanian: el să de aceea a arde că veșmânt, whether warp sau woof, in woollen sau in in, sau vreun thing of piele, wherein the plagă este: căci it [este] a fretting lepră; it shall fi burnt in the foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם יראה הכהן והנה לא פשה הנגע בבגד או בשתי או בערב או בכל כלי עור
verses.english: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.romanian: și dacă the preot shall look, și, iată, the plagă fi nu spread in the veșmânt, either in the warp, sau in the woof, sau in vreun thing of piele;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצוה הכהן וכבסו את אשר בו הנגע והסגירו שבעת ימים שנית
verses.english: Then the priest shall command that they wash [the thing] wherein the plague [is], and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall a porunci că they a spăla [the thing] wherein the plagă [este], și el să închis it up șapte zile more:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן אחרי הכבס את הנגע והנה לא הפך הנגע את עיניו והנגע לא פשה טמא הוא באש תשרפנו פחתת היא בקרחתו או בגבחתו
verses.english: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, [if] the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it [is] unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it [is] fret inward, [whether] it [be] bare within or without.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall look on the plagă, după că it este spălat: și, iată, [dacă] the plagă au nu changed lui colour, și the plagă fi nu spread; it [este] necurat; să a arde it in the foc; it [este] fret inward, [whether] it [fi] bare în sau fără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם ראה הכהן והנה כהה הנגע אחרי הכבסו אתו וקרעו אתו מן הבגד או מן העור או מן השתי או מן הערב
verses.english: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague [be] somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.romanian: și dacă the preot look, și, iată, the plagă [fi] somewhat dark după the washing of it; atunci el să rend it out of the veșmânt, sau out of the piele, sau out of the warp, sau out of the woof:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם תראה עוד בבגד או בשתי או בערב או בכל כלי עור פרחת היא באש תשרפנו את אשר בו הנגע
verses.english: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it [is] a spreading [plague]: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague [is] with fire.
verses.romanian: și dacă it appear still in the veșmânt, either in the warp, sau in the woof, sau in vreun thing of piele; it [este] a spreading [plagă]: să a arde că wherein the plagă [este] cu foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבגד או השתי או הערב או כל כלי העור אשר תכבס וסר מהם הנגע וכבס שנית וטהר
verses.english: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin [it be], which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.romanian: și the veșmânt, either warp, sau woof, sau whatsoever thing of piele [it fi], care să a spăla, dacă the plagă fi a plecat de la ei, atunci it shall fi spălat the second time, și shall fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת תורת נגע הצרעת בגד הצמר או הפשתים או השתי או הערב או כל כלי העור לטהרו או לטמאו
verses.english: This [is] the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
