verses.romanian: This [este] the lege of the plagă of lepră in a veșmânt of woollen sau in, either in the warp, sau woof, sau vreun thing of skins, to a declara it curat, sau to a declara it necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת תהיה תורת המצרע ביום טהרתו והובא אל הכהן
verses.english: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.romanian: This shall fi the lege of the leper in the zi of lui cleansing: el să fi a adus unto the preot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא הכהן אל מחוץ למחנה וראה הכהן והנה נרפא נגע הצרעת מן הצרוע
verses.english: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, [if] the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a merge forth out of the tabără; și the preot shall look, și, iată, [dacă] the plagă of lepră fi healed in the leper;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצוה הכהן ולקחו למטהר שתי צפורים חיות טהרות ועץ ארז ושני תולעת ואזוב
verses.english: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive [and] clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.romanian: atunci shall the preot a porunci to a lua pentru el că este to fi curățit doi birds alive [și] curat, și cedar lemn, și scarlet, și hyssop:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצוה הכהן ושחטו את הצפור האחת אל כלי חרש על מים חיים
verses.english: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a porunci că unu of the birds fi a ucis in an earthen vessel peste running apă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הצפור החיה יקח אתה ואת עץ הארז ואת שני התולעת ואת האזוב וטבל אתם ואת הצפור החיה בדם הצפור השחוטה על מים החיים
verses.english: And as for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird [that was] killed over the running water:
verses.romanian: și as căci the living bird, el să a lua it, și the cedar lemn, și the scarlet, și the hyssop, și shall dip ei și the living bird in the sânge of the bird [că era] a ucis peste the running apă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והזה על המטהר מן הצרעת שבע פעמים וטהרו ושלח את הצפור החיה על פני השדה
verses.english: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
verses.romanian: și el să a stropi upon lui că este to fi curățit din the lepră de șapte ori, și shall a declara lui curat, și shall let the living bird loose into the open câmp.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכבס המטהר את בגדיו וגלח את כל שערו ורחץ במים וטהר ואחר יבוא אל המחנה וישב מחוץ לאהלו שבעת ימים
verses.english: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
verses.romanian: și he că este to fi curățit shall a spăla lui clothes, și shave off toți lui păr, și a spăla himself in apă, că he poate fi curat: și după că el să a veni into the tabără, și shall tarry abroad out of lui tent șapte zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה ביום השביעי יגלח את כל שערו את ראשו ואת זקנו ואת גבות עיניו ואת כל שערו יגלח וכבס את בגדיו ורחץ את בשרו במים וטהר
verses.english: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.romanian: dar it shall fi on the a șaptea zi, că el să shave toți lui păr off lui cap și lui barbă și lui eyebrows, even toți lui păr el să shave off: și el să a spăla lui clothes, de asemenea el să a spăla lui flesh in apă, și el să fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השמיני יקח שני כבשים תמימם בני שנה וכבשה אחת בת שנתה תמימה ושלשה עשרנים סלת מנחה בלולה בשמן ולג שמן אחד
verses.english: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish of one year, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour [for] a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.romanian: și on the eighth zi el să a lua doi he miei fără cusur of unu an, și unu ewe miel of the primul an fără cusur, și trei tenth deals of făină fină [căci] a dar de mâncare, mingled cu oil, și unu log of oil.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעמיד הכהן המטהר את האיש המטהר ואתם לפני יהוה פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And the priest that maketh [him] clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD, [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.romanian: și the preot că maketh [lui] curat shall present the om că este to fi a făcut curat, și those things, înainte DOMNUL, [at] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן את הכבש האחד והקריב אתו לאשם ואת לג השמן והניף אתם תנופה לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them [for] a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua unu he miel, și a aduce lui căci a jertfă pentru vină, și the log of oil, și wave ei [căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושחט את הכבש במקום אשר ישחטו את החטאת ואת העלה במקום הקדש כי כחטאת כאשם הוא לכהן קדש קדשים הוא
verses.english: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering [is] the priest's, [so is] the trespass offering: it [is] most holy:
verses.romanian: și el să slay the miel in the loc where el să a ucide the jertfă de păcat și the ardere-de-tot, in locul sfânt: căci as the jertfă de păcat [este] the preot's, [so este] the jertfă pentru vină: it [este] preasfânt:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן מדם האשם ונתן על תנך אזן המטהר הימנית ועל בהון ידו הימנית ועל בהון רגלו הימנית
verses.english: And the priest shall take [some] of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put [it] upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua [some] of the sânge of the jertfă pentru vină, și the preot shall a pune [it] upon the tip of the right ear al lui că este to fi curățit, și upon the thumb of lui right hand, și upon the great toe of lui right foot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן מלג השמן ויצק על כף הכהן השמאלית
verses.english: And the priest shall take [some] of the log of oil, and pour [it] into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua [some] of the log of oil, și a turna [it] into the palm of lui own left hand:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וטבל הכהן את אצבעו הימנית מן השמן אשר על כפו השמאלית והזה מן השמן שבע פעמים לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that [is] in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall dip lui right finger in the oil că [este] in lui left hand, și shall a stropi of the oil cu lui finger de șapte ori înainte DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומיתר השמן אשר על כפו יתן הכהן על תנך אזן המטהר הימנית ועל בהון ידו הימנית ועל בהון רגלו הימנית על דם האשם
verses.english: And of the rest of the oil that [is] in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.romanian: și of the odihnă of the oil că [este] in lui hand shall the preot a pune upon the tip of the right ear al lui că este to fi curățit, și upon the thumb of lui right hand, și upon the great toe of lui right foot, upon the sânge of the jertfă pentru vină:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנותר בשמן אשר על כף הכהן יתן על ראש המטהר וכפר עליו הכהן לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the remnant of the oil that [is] in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the remnant of the oil că [este] in the preot's hand el să a turna upon the cap al lui că este to fi curățit: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה הכהן את החטאת וכפר על המטהר מטמאתו ואחר ישחט את העלה
verses.english: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a aduce the jertfă de păcat, și a face an ispășire pentru el că este to fi curățit din lui necurăție; și afterward el să a ucide the ardere-de-tot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעלה הכהן את העלה ואת המנחה המזבחה לפני יהוה וכפר עליו הכהן וטהר
verses.english: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar before faces of the LORD: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a aduce the ardere-de-tot și the dar de mâncare upon altarul înainte faces of DOMNUL: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el, și el să fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם דל הוא ואין ידו משגת ולקח כבש אחד אשם לתנופה לכפר עליו ועשרון סלת אחד בלול בשמן למנחה ולג שמן
verses.english: And if he [be] poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb [for] a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
verses.romanian: și dacă he [fi] sărac, și nu poate get so much; atunci el să a lua unu miel [căci] a jertfă pentru vină to fi waved, to a face an ispășire pentru el, și unu tenth deal of făină fină mingled cu oil căci a dar de mâncare, și a log of oil;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושתי תרים או שני בני יונה אשר תשיג ידו והיה אחד חטאת ואחד עלה
verses.english: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.romanian: și doi turtledoves, sau doi young pigeons, such as he este able to get; și the unu shall fi a jertfă de păcat, și the other a ardere-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא אתם ביום השמיני לטהרתו אל הכהן אל פתח אהל מועד לפני יהוה
verses.english: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce ei on the eighth zi căci lui cleansing unto the preot, unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן את כבש האשם ואת לג השמן והניף אתם תנופה לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them [for] a wave offering before the LORD:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a lua the miel of the jertfă pentru vină, și the log of oil, și the preot shall wave ei [căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושחט את כבש האשם ולקח הכהן מדם האשם ונתן על תנך אזן המטהר הימנית ועל בהון ידו הימנית ועל בהון רגלו הימנית
verses.english: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take [some] of the blood of the trespass offering, and put [it] upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.romanian: și el să a ucide the miel of the jertfă pentru vină, și the preot shall a lua [some] of the sânge of the jertfă pentru vină, și a pune [it] upon the tip of the right ear al lui că este to fi curățit, și upon the thumb of lui right hand, și upon the great toe of lui right foot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומן השמן יצק הכהן על כף הכהן השמאלית
verses.english: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a turna of the oil into the palm of lui own left hand:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והזה הכהן באצבעו הימנית מן השמן אשר על כפו השמאלית שבע פעמים לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger [some] of the oil that [is] in his left hand seven times before the LORD:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a stropi cu lui right finger [some] of the oil că [este] in lui left hand de șapte ori înainte DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן הכהן מן השמן אשר על כפו על תנך אזן המטהר הימנית ועל בהון ידו הימנית ועל בהון רגלו הימנית על מקום דם האשם
verses.english: And the priest shall put of the oil that [is] in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a pune of the oil că [este] in lui hand upon the tip of the right ear al lui că este to fi curățit, și upon the thumb of lui right hand, și upon the great toe of lui right foot, upon the loc of the sânge of the jertfă pentru vină:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנותר בשמן אשר על כף הכהן יתן על ראש המטהר לכפר עליו לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the rest of the oil that [is] in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the odihnă of the oil că [este] in the preot's hand el să a pune upon the cap al lui că este to fi curățit, to a face an ispășire pentru el înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה את האחד מן התרים או מבני היונה מאשר תשיג ידו
verses.english: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce the unu of the turtledoves, sau of the young pigeons, such as he poate get;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את אשר תשיג ידו את האחד חטאת ואת האחד עלה על המנחה וכפר על המטהר לפני יהוה
verses.english: [Even] such as he is able to get, the one [for] a sin offering, and the other [for] a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD.
verses.romanian: [Even] such as he este able to get, the unu [căci] a jertfă de păcat, și the other [căci] a ardere-de-tot, cu the dar de mâncare: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el că este to fi curățit înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת תורת אשר בו נגע צרעת אשר לא תשיג ידו בטהרתו
verses.english: This [is] the law [of him] in whom [is] the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get [that which pertaineth] to his cleansing.
verses.romanian: This [este] the lege [al lui] in pe care [este] the plagă of lepră, al cărui hand este nu able to get [că care pertaineth] to lui cleansing.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise și lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תבאו אל ארץ כנען אשר אני נתן לכם לאחזה ונתתי נגע צרעת בבית ארץ אחזתכם
verses.english: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.romanian: când voi fi a veni into the țară of Canaan, care I a da to voi căci a stăpânire, și I a pune the plagă of lepră in a casă of the țară of vostru stăpânire;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובא אשר לו הבית והגיד לכהן לאמר כנגע נראה לי בבית
verses.english: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me [there is] as it were a plague in the house:
verses.romanian: și he că owneth the casă shall a veni și tell the preot, saying, It seemeth to mine [acolo este] as it erau a plagă in the casă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצוה הכהן ופנו את הבית בטרם יבוא הכהן לראות את הנגע ולא יטמא כל אשר בבית ואחרי כן יבוא הכהן לראות את הבית
verses.english: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go [into it] to see the plague, that all that [is] in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall a porunci că they empty the casă, înainte the preot a merge [into it] to a vedea the plagă, că toți că [este] in the casă fi nu a făcut necurat: și afterward the preot shall a merge in to a vedea the casă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראה הכהן את הנגע והנה הנגע בקירות הבית שקעררות ירקרקות או אדמדמות ומראהן שפל מן הקיר
verses.english: And the priest shall look on the plague, and, behold, [if] the plague [be] in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight [are] lower than the wall;
verses.romanian: și the preot shall look on the plagă, și, iată, [dacă] the plagă [fi] in the ziduri of the casă cu hollow strakes, greenish sau reddish, care in sight [sunt] lower than the zid;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא הכהן מן הבית אל פתח הבית והסגיר את הבית שבעת ימים
verses.english: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall a merge out of the casă to the ușă of the casă, și a închide the casă șapte zile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושב הכהן ביום השביעי וראה והנה פשה הנגע בקירות הבית
verses.english: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, [if] the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a veni again the a șaptea zi, și shall look: și, iată, [dacă] the plagă fi spread in the ziduri of the casă;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצוה הכהן וחלצו את האבנים אשר בהן הנגע והשליכו אתהן אל מחוץ לעיר אל מקום טמא
verses.english: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague [is], and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall a porunci că they a lua away the pietre in care the plagă [este], și ei să cast ei into an necurat loc fără the city:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הבית יקצעו מבית סביב ושפכו את העפר אשר הקיצו אל מחוץ לעיר אל מקום טמא
verses.english: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
verses.romanian: și el să cause the casă to fi scraped în round about, și ei să a turna out the dust că they scrape off fără the city into an necurat loc:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחו אבנים אחרות והביאו אל תחת האבנים ועפר אחר יקחו וטחו את הבית
verses.english: And they shall take other stones, and put [them] in the place of those stones; and he shall take other mortar, and shall plaster the house.
verses.romanian: și ei să a lua other pietre, și a pune [ei] in the loc of those pietre; și el să a lua other mortar, și shall tencuială the casă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם ישוב הנגע ופרח בבית אחרי חלצו את האבנים ואחרי הקצות את הבית ואחרי הטח
verses.english: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plastered;
verses.romanian: și dacă the plagă a veni again, și break out in the casă, după că he sunt luat away the pietre, și după he sunt scraped the casă, și după it este plastered;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובא הכהן וראה והנה פרח הנגע בבית צרעת ממראת בבית טמא הוא
verses.english: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, [if] the plague be blooming in the house, it [is] a fretting leprosy in the house: it [is] unclean.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall a veni și look, și, iată, [dacă] the plagă fi blooming in the casă, it [este] a fretting lepră in the casă: it [este] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתצו את הבית את אבניו ואת עציו ואת כל עפר הבית והוציאו אל מחוץ לעיר אל מקום טמא
verses.english: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the mortar of the house; and he shall carry [them] forth out of the city into an unclean place.
verses.romanian: și el să break down the casă, the pietre of it, și the timber thereof, și toți the mortar of the casă; și el să carry [ei] forth out of the city into an necurat loc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבא אל הבית כל ימי הסגיר אתו יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: Moreover he că goeth into the casă toți the în timp ce că it este a închide shall fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשכב בבית יכבס בגדיו והאכל בבית יכבס בגדיו
verses.english: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.romanian: și he că lieth in the casă shall a spăla lui clothes; și he că eateth in the casă shall a spăla lui clothes.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בא יבוא הכהן וראה והנה לא פרח הנגע בבית אחרי הטח את הבית וטהר הכהן את הבית כי נרפא הנגע
verses.english: And if the priest shall come in, and look [upon it], and, behold, the plague hath not blooming in the house, after the house was plastered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.romanian: și dacă the preot shall a veni in, și look [upon it], și, iată, the plagă sunt nu blooming in the casă, după the casă era plastered: atunci the preot shall a declara the casă curat, pentru că the plagă este healed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחו לחטא את הבית שתי צפורים ועץ ארז ושני תולעת ואזוב
verses.english: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.romanian: și el să a lua to a curăți the casă doi birds, și cedar lemn, și scarlet, și hyssop:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושחט את הצפור האחת אל כלי חרש על מים חיים
verses.english: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.romanian: și el să a ucide the unu of the birds in an earthen vessel peste running apă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח את עץ הארז ואת שני התולעת ואת האזוב ואת הצפור החיה וטבל אתם בדם הצפור השחוטה ובמים החיים והזה על הבית שבע פעמים
verses.english: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
verses.romanian: și el să a lua the cedar lemn, și the hyssop, și the scarlet, și the living bird, și dip ei in the sânge of the înjunghiat bird, și in the running apă, și a stropi the casă de șapte ori:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחטא את הבית בדם הצפור ובמים החיים ובצפור החיה ובעץ הארז ובשני התולעת ובאזוב
verses.english: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
verses.romanian: și el să a curăți the casă cu the sânge of the bird, și cu the running apă, și cu the living bird, și cu the cedar lemn, și cu the hyssop, și cu the scarlet:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושלח את הצפור החיה אל מחוץ לעיר על פני השדה וכפר על הבית וטהר
verses.english: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
verses.romanian: dar el să let a merge the living bird out of the city into the open câmpuri, și a face an ispășire căci the casă: și it shall fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת התורה לכל נגע הצרעת ולנתק
verses.english: This [is] the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall
verses.romanian: This [este] the lege căci toți manner of plagă of lepră, și scall

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולצרעת הבגד ולבית
verses.english: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house
verses.romanian: și căci the lepră of a veșmânt, și of a casă

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולשאת ולספחת ולבהרת
verses.english: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
verses.romanian: și căci a rising, și căci a pecingine, și căci a bright pată:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: להורות ביום הטמא וביום הטהור זאת תורת הצרעת
verses.english: To teach when [it is] unclean, and when [it is] clean: this [is] the law of leprosy.
verses.romanian: To a învăța când [it este] necurat, și când [it este] curat: this [este] the lege of lepră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise și to Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דברו אל בני ישראל ואמרתם אליהם איש איש כי יהיה זב מבשרו זובו טמא הוא
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, [because of] his issue he [is] unclean.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, când vreun om sunt a running scurgere out of lui flesh, [pentru că of] lui scurgere he [este] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת תהיה טמאתו בזובו רר בשרו את זובו או חתום בשרו מזובו טמא הוא כל ימי זב בשרו או החתים בשרו מזובו טמאתו היא
verses.english: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, unclean he in all days of his issue or if his flesh stops running with issue, it [is] his uncleanness.
verses.romanian: și this shall fi lui necurăție in lui scurgere: whether lui flesh run cu lui scurgere, sau lui flesh fi stopped din lui scurgere, necurat he in toți zile of lui scurgere sau dacă lui flesh stops running cu scurgere, it [este] lui necurăție.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל המשכב אשר ישכב עליו הזב יטמא וכל הכלי אשר ישב עליו יטמא
verses.english: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: fiecare bed, whereon he lieth că sunt the scurgere, este necurat: și fiecare thing, whereon he sitteth, shall fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר יגע במשכבו יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whosoever toucheth lui bed shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והישב על הכלי אשר ישב עליו הזב יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And he that sitteth on [any] thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și he că sitteth on [vreun] thing whereon he sat că sunt the scurgere shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנגע בבשר הזב יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și he că toucheth the flesh al lui că sunt the scurgere shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי ירק הזב בטהור יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și dacă he că sunt the scurgere spit upon lui că este curat; atunci el să a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל המרכב אשר ירכב עליו הזב יטמא
verses.english: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: și ce saddle soever he rideth upon că sunt the scurgere shall fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הנגע בכל אשר יהיה תחתיו יטמא עד הערב והנושא אתם יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth [any of] those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whosoever toucheth vreun thing că era sub lui shall fi necurat until the even: și he că beareth [vreun of] those things shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר יגע בו הזב וידו לא שטף במים יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hand in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whomsoever he toucheth că sunt the scurgere, și sunt nu rinsed lui hand in apă, el să a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכלי חרש אשר יגע בו הזב ישבר וכל כלי עץ ישטף במים
verses.english: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.romanian: și the vessel of pământ, că he toucheth care sunt the scurgere, shall fi broken: și fiecare vessel of lemn shall fi rinsed in apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יטהר הזב מזובו וספר לו שבעת ימים לטהרתו וכבס בגדיו ורחץ את בשרו במים חיים וטהר
verses.english: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.romanian: și când he că sunt an scurgere este curățit of lui scurgere; atunci el să number to himself șapte zile căci lui cleansing, și a spăla lui clothes, și bathe lui flesh in running apă, și shall fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השמיני יקח לו שתי תרים או שני בני יונה ובא לפני יהוה אל פתח אהל מועד ונתנם אל הכהן
verses.english: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.romanian: și on the eighth zi el să a lua to lui doi turtledoves, sau doi young pigeons, și a veni înainte DOMNUL unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, și a da ei unto the preot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה אתם הכהן אחד חטאת ואחד עלה וכפר עליו הכהן לפני יהוה מזובו
verses.english: And the priest shall offer them, the one [for] a sin offering, and the other [for] a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a aduce ei, the unu [căci] a jertfă de păcat, și the other [căci] a ardere-de-tot; și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el înainte DOMNUL căci lui scurgere.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי תצא ממנו שכבת זרע ורחץ במים את כל בשרו וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și dacă vreun om's sămânță of copulation a merge out de la el, atunci el să a spăla toți lui flesh in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל בגד וכל עור אשר יהיה עליו שכבת זרע וכבס במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și fiecare veșmânt, și fiecare piele, whereon este the sămânță of copulation, shall fi spălat cu apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשה אשר ישכב אישה אתה שכבת זרע ורחצו במים וטמאו עד הערב
verses.english: The woman also with whom man shall lie [with] seed of copulation, they shall [both] bathe [themselves] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: The femeie de asemenea cu pe care om shall minciună [cu] sămânță of copulation, ei să [both] bathe [themselves] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשה כי תהיה זבה דם יהיה זובה בבשרה שבעת ימים תהיה בנדתה כל הנגע בה יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And if a woman have an issue, [and] her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și dacă a femeie au an scurgere, [și] ei scurgere in ei flesh fi sânge, ea să fi a pune apart șapte zile: whosoever toucheth ei shall fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר תשכב עליו בנדתה יטמא וכל אשר תשב עליו יטמא
verses.english: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: și fiecare thing că she lieth upon in ei separation shall fi necurat: fiecare thing de asemenea că she sitteth upon shall fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הנגע במשכבה יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whosoever toucheth ei bed shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הנגע בכל הכלי אשר תשב עליו יכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whosoever toucheth vreun thing că she sat upon shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם על המשכבה היא או על הכלי אשר היא ישבת עליו בנגעו בו יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And if it [be] on [her] bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și dacă it [fi] on [ei] bed, sau on vreun thing whereon she sitteth, când he toucheth it, el să fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם שכב ישכב אישה אתה ותהי נדתה עליו יטמא שבעת ימים וכל המשכב אשר ישכב עליו יטמא
verses.english: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.romanian: și dacă vreun om minciună cu ei at toți, și ei flowers fi upon lui, el să fi necurat șapte zile; și toți the bed whereon he lieth shall fi necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשה כי יזוב זוב דמה ימים רבים בלא עת נדתה או כי תזוב על נדתה כל ימי זוב טמאתה כימי נדתה תהיה טמאה היא
verses.english: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she [shall be] unclean.
verses.romanian: și dacă a femeie au an scurgere of ei sânge many zile out of the time of ei separation, sau dacă it run beyond the time of ei separation; toți the zile of the scurgere of ei necurăție shall fi as the zile of ei separation: she [shall fi] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל המשכב אשר תשכב עליו כל ימי זובה כמשכב נדתה יהיה לה וכל הכלי אשר תשב עליו טמא יהיה כטמאת נדתה
verses.english: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.romanian: fiecare bed whereon she lieth toți the zile of ei scurgere shall fi ei as the bed of ei separation: și whatsoever she sitteth upon shall fi necurat, as the necurăție of ei separation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הנגע בם יטמא וכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe [himself] in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și whosoever toucheth those things shall fi necurat, și shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe [himself] in apă, și fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם טהרה מזובה וספרה לה שבעת ימים ואחר תטהר
verses.english: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.romanian: dar dacă she fi curățit of ei scurgere, atunci ea să number to herself șapte zile, și după că ea să fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השמיני תקח לה שתי תרים או שני בני יונה והביאה אתם אל הכהן אל פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și on the eighth zi ea să a lua ei doi turtles, sau doi young pigeons, și a aduce ei unto the preot, to the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה הכהן את האחד חטאת ואת האחד עלה וכפר עליה הכהן לפני יהוה מזוב טמאתה
verses.english: And the priest shall offer the one [for] a sin offering, and the other [for] a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a aduce the unu [căci] a jertfă de păcat, și the other [căci] a ardere-de-tot; și the preot shall a face an ispășire căci ei înainte DOMNUL căci the scurgere of ei necurăție.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והזהרתם את בני ישראל מטמאתם ולא ימותו בטמאתם בטמאם את משכני אשר בתוכם
verses.english: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that [is] among them.
verses.romanian: astfel shall voi a despărți the copii of Israel din lor necurăție; că they die nu in lor necurăție, când they a pângări meu tabernacle că [este] în mijlocul ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת תורת הזב ואשר תצא ממנו שכבת זרע לטמאה בה
verses.english: This [is] the law of him that hath an issue, and [of him] whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.romanian: This [este] the lege al lui că sunt an scurgere, și [al lui] al cărui sămânță goeth de la el, și este pângărit therewith;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והדוה בנדתה והזב את זובו לזכר ולנקבה ולאיש אשר ישכב עם טמאה
verses.english: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.romanian: și of ei că este sick of ei flowers, și al lui că sunt an scurgere, of the om, și of the femeie, și al lui că lieth cu ei că este necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה אחרי מות שני בני אהרן בקרבתם לפני יהוה וימתו
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise după the death of the doi fii of Aaron, când they a adus înainte DOMNUL, și died;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה דבר אל אהרן אחיך ואל יבוא בכל עת אל הקדש מבית לפרכת אל פני הכפרת אשר על הארון ולא ימות כי בענן אראה אל הכפרת
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy [place] within the veil before the mercy seat, which [is] upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a spus unto Moise, a vorbi lui Aaron tău frate, că he a veni nu at toți times into the sfânt [loc] în the văl înainte the capacul ispășirii, care [este] upon the ark; că he die nu: căci voi appear in the cloud upon the capacul ispășirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בזאת יבוא אהרן אל הקדש בפר בן בקר לחטאת ואיל לעלה
verses.english: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy [place]: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.romanian: astfel shall Aaron a veni into the sfânt [loc]: cu a young vițel căci a jertfă de păcat, și a berbec căci a ardere-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכיתנת בד קדש ילבש ומכנסי בד יהיו על בשרו ובאבניט בד יחגר ובמצנפת בד יצנף בגדי קדש הם ורחץ במים את כל בשרו ולבשם
verses.english: And he shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these [are] holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and [so] put them on.
verses.romanian: și el să a pune on the sfânt in veșmânt, și el să au the in izmene upon lui flesh, și shall fi girded cu a in girdle, și cu the in mitră shall he fi attired: these [sunt] sfânt veșminte; de aceea shall he a spăla lui flesh in apă, și [so] a pune ei on.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומאת עדת בני ישראל יקח שני שעירי עזים לחטאת ואיל אחד לעלה
verses.english: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua of obștea of the copii of Israel doi kids of the țapi căci a jertfă de păcat, și unu berbec căci a ardere-de-tot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב אהרן את פר החטאת אשר לו וכפר בעדו ובעד ביתו
verses.english: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which [is] for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.romanian: și Aaron shall a aduce lui vițel of the jertfă de păcat, care [este] căci himself, și a face an ispășire căci himself, și căci lui casă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח את שני השעירים והעמיד אתם לפני יהוה פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua the doi țapi, și present ei înainte DOMNUL [at] the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן אהרן על שני השעירים גורלות גורל אחד ליהוה וגורל אחד לעזזאל
verses.english: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.romanian: și Aaron shall cast lots upon the doi țapi; unu lot căci DOMNUL, și the other lot căci the scapegoat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב אהרן את השעיר אשר עלה עליו הגורל ליהוה ועשהו חטאת
verses.english: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD's lot fell, and offer him [for] a sin offering.
verses.romanian: și Aaron shall a aduce the țap upon care DOMNUL's lot fell, și a aduce lui [căci] a jertfă de păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשעיר אשר עלה עליו הגורל לעזזאל יעמיד חי לפני יהוה לכפר עליו לשלח אתו לעזזאל המדברה
verses.english: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, [and] to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.romanian: dar the țap, on care the lot fell to fi the scapegoat, shall fi presented alive înainte DOMNUL, to a face an ispășire cu el, [și] to let lui a merge căci a scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב אהרן את פר החטאת אשר לו וכפר בעדו ובעד ביתו ושחט את פר החטאת אשר לו
verses.english: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which [is] for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which [is] for himself:
verses.romanian: și Aaron shall a aduce the vițel of the jertfă de păcat, care [este] căci himself, și shall a face an ispășire căci himself, și căci lui casă, și shall a ucide the vițel of the jertfă de păcat care [este] căci himself:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח מלוא המחתה גחלי אש מעל המזבח מלפני יהוה ומלוא חפניו קטרת סמים דקה והביא מבית לפרכת
verses.english: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring [it] within the veil:
verses.romanian: și el să a lua a censer full of burning coals of foc din off altarul înainte DOMNUL, și lui hands full of sweet tămâie beaten small, și a aduce [it] în the văl:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתן את הקטרת על האש לפני יהוה וכסה ענן הקטרת את הכפרת אשר על העדות ולא ימות
verses.english: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that [is] upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.romanian: și el să a pune the tămâie upon the foc înainte DOMNUL, că the cloud of the tămâie poate a acoperi the capacul ispășirii că [este] upon the mărturie, că he die nu:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח מדם הפר והזה באצבעו אל פני הכפרת קדמה ולפני הכפרת יזה שבע פעמים מן הדם באצבעו
verses.english: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle [it] with his finger to the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua of the sânge of the vițel, și a stropi [it] cu lui finger to the capacul ispășirii eastward; și înainte the capacul ispășirii shall he a stropi of the sânge cu lui finger de șapte ori.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושחט את שעיר החטאת אשר לעם והביא את דמו אל מבית לפרכת ועשה את דמו כאשר עשה לדם הפר והזה אתו על הכפרת ולפני הכפרת
verses.english: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that [is] for the people, and bring his blood within the veil, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.romanian: atunci shall he a ucide the țap of the jertfă de păcat, că [este] căci the people, și a aduce lui sânge în the văl, și a face cu că sânge as he a făcut cu the sânge of the vițel, și a stropi it upon the capacul ispășirii, și înainte the capacul ispășirii:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכפר על הקדש מטמאת בני ישראל ומפשעיהם לכל חטאתם וכן יעשה לאהל מועד השכן אתם בתוך טמאתם
verses.english: And he shall make an atonement for the holy [place], because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.romanian: și el să a face an ispășire căci the sfânt [loc], pentru că of the necurăție of the copii of Israel, și pentru că of lor fărădelegi in toți lor păcate: și so shall he a face căci Cortul Întâlnirii, că remaineth în mijlocul ei in the midst of lor necurăție.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אדם לא יהיה באהל מועד בבאו לכפר בקדש עד צאתו וכפר בעדו ובעד ביתו ובעד כל קהל ישראל
verses.english: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy [place], until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.romanian: și acolo shall fi no om in Cortul Întâlnirii când he goeth in to a face an ispășire in the sfânt [loc], until he a veni out, și au a făcut an ispășire căci himself, și căci lui household, și căci toți obștea of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא אל המזבח אשר לפני יהוה וכפר עליו ולקח מדם הפר ומדם השעיר ונתן על קרנות המזבח סביב
verses.english: And he shall go out unto the altar that [is] before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put [it] upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.romanian: și el să a merge out unto altarul că [este] înainte DOMNUL, și a face an ispășire căci it; și shall a lua of the sânge of the vițel, și of the sânge of the țap, și a pune [it] upon the coarne of altarul round about.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והזה עליו מן הדם באצבעו שבע פעמים וטהרו וקדשו מטמאת בני ישראל
verses.english: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și el să a stropi of the sânge upon it cu lui finger de șapte ori, și a curăți it, și hallow it din the necurăție of the copii of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכלה מכפר את הקדש ואת אהל מועד ואת המזבח והקריב את השעיר החי
verses.english: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy [place], and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.romanian: și când he sunt a făcut an end of reconciling the sfânt [loc], și Cortul Întâlnirii, și altarul, el să a aduce the live țap:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסמך אהרן את שתי ידיו על ראש השעיר החי והתודה עליו את כל עונות בני ישראל ואת כל פשעיהם לכל חטאתם ונתן אתם על ראש השעיר ושלח ביד איש עתי המדברה
verses.english: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send [him] away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.romanian: și Aaron shall lay both lui hands upon the cap of the live țap, și confess peste lui toți the nelegiuiri of the copii of Israel, și toți lor fărădelegi in toți lor păcate, putting ei upon the cap of the țap, și shall send [lui] away by the hand of a fit om into the wilderness:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשא השעיר עליו את כל עונתם אל ארץ גזרה ושלח את השעיר במדבר
verses.english: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.romanian: și the țap shall bear upon lui toți lor nelegiuiri unto a țară nu inhabited: și el să let a merge the țap in the wilderness.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובא אהרן אל אהל מועד ופשט את בגדי הבד אשר לבש בבאו אל הקדש והניחם שם
verses.english: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy [place], and shall leave them there:
verses.romanian: și Aaron shall a veni into Cortul Întâlnirii, și shall a pune off the in veșminte, care he a pune on când he a mers into the sfânt [loc], și shall leave ei acolo:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ורחץ את בשרו במים במקום קדוש ולבש בגדיו ויצא ועשה את עלתו ואת עלת העם וכפר בעדו ובעד העם
verses.english: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.romanian: și el să a spăla lui flesh cu apă in locul sfânt, și a pune on lui veșminte, și a veni forth, și a aduce lui ardere-de-tot, și the ardere-de-tot of the people, și a face an ispășire căci himself, și căci the people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת חלב החטאת יקטיר המזבחה
verses.english: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.romanian: și the fat of the jertfă de păcat shall he a arde upon altarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והמשלח את השעיר לעזזאל יכבס בגדיו ורחץ את בשרו במים ואחרי כן יבוא אל המחנה
verses.english: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.romanian: și he că let a merge the țap căci the scapegoat shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe lui flesh in apă, și afterward a veni into the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת פר החטאת ואת שעיר החטאת אשר הובא את דמם לכפר בקדש יוצא אל מחוץ למחנה ושרף באש את עורתם ואת בשרם ואת פרשם
verses.english: And the bullock [for] the sin offering, and the goat [for] the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy [place], shall [one] carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.romanian: și the vițel [căci] the jertfă de păcat, și the țap [căci] the jertfă de păcat, al cărui sânge era a adus in to a face ispășire in the sfânt [loc], shall [unu] carry forth fără the tabără; și ei să a arde in the foc lor skins, și lor flesh, și lor dung.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשרף אתם יכבס בגדיו ורחץ את בשרו במים ואחרי כן יבוא אל המחנה
verses.english: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.romanian: și he că burneth ei shall a spăla lui clothes, și bathe lui flesh in apă, și afterward el să a veni into the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה לכם לחקות עולם בחדש השביעי בעשור לחדש תענו את נפשתיכם וכל מלאכה לא תעשו האזרח והגר הגר בתוככם
verses.english: And [this] shall be a statute for ever unto you: [that] in the seventh month, on the tenth [day] of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, [whether it be] one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.romanian: și [this] shall fi a decret veșnic vouă: [că] in the luna a șaptea, on the tenth [zi] of the lună, să a mâhni vostru souls, și a face no lucrare at toți, [whether it fi] unu of vostru own country, sau a străin că sojourneth în mijlocul voi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי ביום הזה יכפר עליכם לטהר אתכם מכל חטאתיכם לפני יהוה תטהרו
verses.english: For on that day shall [the priest] make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, [that] ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD.
verses.romanian: căci on că zi shall [the preot] a face an ispășire pentru voi, to a curăți voi, [că] voi poate fi curat din toți vostru păcate înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שבת שבתון הוא לכם ועניתם את נפשתיכם חקות עולם
verses.english: It [shall be] a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.romanian: It [shall fi] a Șabat of odihnă vouă, și să a mâhni vostru souls, by a decret veșnic.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יכפר הכהן אשר ימשח אתו ואשר ימלא את ידו לכהן תחת אביו ולבש את בגדי הבד בגדי הקדש
verses.english: The priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, [even] the holy garments:
verses.romanian: The preot, pe care el să a unge, și pe care el să a consacra to a sluji in the preot's office in lui tată's stead, shall a face the ispășire, și shall a pune on the in clothes, [even] the sfânt veșminte:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכפר את מקדש הקדש ואת אהל מועד ואת המזבח יכפר על הכהנים ועל כל עם הקהל יכפר
verses.english: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și el să a face an ispășire căci the sfânt sanctuary, și el să a face an ispășire căci Cortul Întâlnirii, și căci altarul, el să a face an ispășire căci the preoți, și căci toți the people of obștea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה זאת לכם לחקות עולם לכפר על בני ישראל מכל חטאתם אחת בשנה ויעש כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și this shall fi an everlasting decret vouă, to a face an ispășire căci the copii of Israel căci toți lor păcate once a an. și he a făcut as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל אהרן ואל בניו ואל כל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם זה הדבר אשר צוה יהוה לאמר
verses.english: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This [is] the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Aaron, și unto lui fii, și unto toți the copii of Israel, și a spune lor; This [este] the thing care DOMNUL sunt a poruncit, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש איש מבית ישראל אשר ישחט שור או כשב או עז במחנה או אשר ישחט מחוץ למחנה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל פתח אהל מועד לא הביאו לעשות אתו עלה או שלמים ליהוה לרצונכם לריח ניחח וישחטהו בחוץ ואל פתח אהל מועד לא הביאו להקריבו קרבן ליהוה לפני משכן יהוה דם יחשב לאיש ההוא דם שפך ונכרת האיש ההוא מקרב עמיו
verses.english: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer burnt offering or peace offering to the LORD for the delightful fragrance, and he is slaying it outside of the entrance of the tent of appointment and not he brought it to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.romanian: și bringeth it nu unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, to a aduce ardere-de-tot sau jertfă de pace to DOMNUL căci the delightful fragrance, și he este slaying it în afara of the entrance of the tent of appointment și nu he a adus it to a aduce an jertfă unto DOMNUL înainte Cortul of DOMNUL; sânge shall fi imputed unto că om; he sunt shed sânge; și că om shall fi a tăia off din în mijlocul lui people:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למען אשר יביאו בני ישראל את זבחיהם אשר הם זבחים על פני השדה והבאום ליהוה אל פתח אהל מועד אל הכהן וזבחו זבחי שלמים ליהוה אתם
verses.english: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them [for] peace offerings unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: To the end că the copii of Israel poate a aduce lor jertfe, care they a aduce in the open câmp, even că they poate a aduce ei unto DOMNUL, unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, unto the preot, și a aduce ei [căci] peace jertfe unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזרק הכהן את הדם על מזבח יהוה אשר פתח אהל מועד והקטיר החלב לריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD that is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a stropi the sânge upon altarul of DOMNUL că este at the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, și a arde the fat căci a aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יזבחו עוד את זבחיהם לשערים אשר הם זנים אחריהם חקות עולם תהיה זאת להם לדרותם
verses.english: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.romanian: și ei să no more a aduce lor jertfe unto devils, după pe care they au gone a whoring. This shall fi a decret veșnic lor în toate generațiile lor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואליהם תאמר איש איש מבית ישראל ומן הגר אשר יגור בתוכם אשר יעשה עלה או זבח
verses.english: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man [there be] of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that does a burnt offering or sacrifice
verses.romanian: și să a spune lor, Whatsoever om [acolo fi] of the casă of Israel, sau of the străini care sojourn în mijlocul voi, că does a ardere-de-tot sau jertfă

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל פתח אהל מועד לא יביאנו לעשות אתו ליהוה ונכרת האיש ההוא מעמיו
verses.english: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.romanian: și bringeth it nu unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, to a aduce it unto DOMNUL; even că om shall fi a tăia off din în mijlocul lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש איש מבית ישראל ומן הגר אשר יגור בתוכם אשר יאכל כל דם ונתתי את פני בנפש האכלת את הדם והכרתי אתה מקרב עמה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי נפש הבשר בדם הוא ואני נתתיו לכם על המזבח לכפר על נפשתיכם כי הדם הוא בנפש יכפר
verses.english: For the life of the flesh [is] in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it [is] the blood [that] maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.romanian: căci the life of the flesh [este] in the sânge: și I au dat it to voi upon altarul to a face an ispășire căci vostru souls: căci it [este] the sânge [că] maketh an ispășire căci the soul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על כן אמרתי לבני ישראל כל נפש מכם לא תאכל דם והגר הגר בתוככם לא יאכל דם
verses.english: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.romanian: de aceea I a spus unto the copii of Israel, No soul al vostru să mănânce sânge, neither shall vreun străin că sojourneth în mijlocul voi eat sânge.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש איש מבית ישראל ומן הגר הגר בתוככם אשר יצוד ציד חיה או עוף אשר יאכל ושפך את דמו וכסהו בעפר
verses.english: And whatsoever man [there be] of the houses of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.romanian: și whatsoever om [acolo fi] of the case of Israel, sau of the străini că sojourn în mijlocul voi, care hunteth și catcheth vreun beast sau fowl că poate fi eaten; el să even a turna out the sânge thereof, și a acoperi it cu dust.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי נפש כל בשר דמו בנפשו הוא ואמר לבני ישראל דם כל בשר לא תאכלו כי נפש כל בשר דמו הוא כל אכלו יכרת
verses.english: For [it is] the life of all flesh; the blood of it [is] for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh [is] the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.romanian: căci [it este] the life of toți flesh; the sânge of it [este] căci the life thereof: de aceea I a spus unto the copii of Israel, voi să mănânce the sânge of no manner of flesh: căci the life of toți flesh [este] the sânge thereof: whosoever eateth it shall fi a tăia off.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הנפש אשר תאכל נבלה וטרפה באזרח ובגר וכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא יכבס ובשרו לא ירחץ ונשא עונו
verses.english: But if he wash [them] not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.romanian: dar dacă he a spăla [ei] nu, nor bathe lui flesh; atunci el să bear lui nelegiuire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, I am DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כמעשה ארץ מצרים אשר ישבתם בה לא תעשו וכמעשה ארץ כנען אשר אני מביא אתכם שמה לא תעשו ובחקתיהם לא תלכו
verses.english: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.romanian: după the doings of the țară of Egypt, wherein voi a locuit, shall voi nu a face: și după the doings of the țară of Canaan, whither I a aduce voi, shall voi nu a face: neither shall voi a umbla in lor rânduieli.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את משפטי תעשו ואת חקותי תשמרו ללכת בהם אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: să a face meu judecăți, și a păzi mine rânduieli, to a umbla therein: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את חקותי ואת משפטי אשר יעשה אתם האדם וחיה בהם אני יהוה
verses.english: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să de aceea a păzi meu decrete, și meu judecăți: care dacă a om a face, el să live in ei: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש איש אל כל שאר בשרו לא תקרבו לגלות ערוה אני יהוה
verses.english: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover [their] nakedness: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: niciun al vostru shall approach to vreun că este lângă of rudă to lui, to uncover [lor] goliciune: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אביך וערות אמך לא תגלה אמך היא לא תגלה ערותה
verses.english: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she [is] thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.romanian: The goliciune of tău tată, sau the goliciune of tău mamă, shalt tu nu uncover: she [este] tău mamă; să nu uncover ei goliciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אשת אביך לא תגלה ערות אביך היא
verses.english: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it [is] thy father's nakedness.
verses.romanian: The goliciune of tău tată's wife shalt tu nu uncover: it [este] tău tată's goliciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אחותך בת אביך או בת אמך מולדת בית או מולדת חוץ לא תגלה ערותה
verses.english: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, [whether she be] born at home, or born abroad, [even] her nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.romanian: The goliciune of tău soră, the fiică of tău tată, sau fiică of tău mamă, [whether she fi] born at home, sau born abroad, [even] ei goliciune să nu uncover.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות בת בנך או בת בתך לא תגלה ערותן כי ערותך הנה
verses.english: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, [even] their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs [is] thine own nakedness.
verses.romanian: The goliciune of tău fiu's fiică, sau of tău fiică's fiică, [even] lor goliciune să nu uncover: căci theirs [este] thine own goliciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות בת אשת אביך מולדת אביך אחותך היא לא תגלה ערותה
verses.english: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she [is] thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.romanian: The goliciune of tău tată's wife's fiică, begotten of tău tată, she [este] tău soră, să nu uncover ei goliciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אחות אביך לא תגלה שאר אביך היא
verses.english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she [is] thy father's near kinswoman.
verses.romanian: să nu uncover the goliciune of tău tată's soră: she [este] tău tată's lângă kinswoman.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אחות אמך לא תגלה שאר אמך היא
verses.english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she [is] thy mother's near kinswoman.
verses.romanian: să nu uncover the goliciune of tău mamă's soră: căci she [este] tău mamă's lângă kinswoman.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אחי אביך לא תגלה ואל אשתו לא תקרב דדתך היא
verses.english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, and thou shalt not approach to his wife: she [is] thine aunt.
verses.romanian: să nu uncover the goliciune of tău tată's frate, și să nu approach to lui wife: she [este] thine mătușă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות כלתך לא תגלה אשת בנך היא לא תגלה ערותה
verses.english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she [is] thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.romanian: să nu uncover the goliciune of tău fiică-in-lege: she [este] tău fiu's wife; să nu uncover ei goliciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אשת אחיך לא תגלה ערות אחיך היא
verses.english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it [is] thy brother's nakedness.
verses.romanian: să nu uncover the goliciune of tău frate's wife: it [este] tău frate's goliciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אשה ובתה לא תגלה את בת בנה ואת בת בתה לא תקח לגלות ערותה שארה הנה זמה היא
verses.english: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; [for] they [are] her near kinswomen: it [is] wickedness.
verses.romanian: să nu uncover the goliciune of a femeie și ei fiică, neither shalt tu a lua ei fiu's fiică, sau ei fiică's fiică, to uncover ei goliciune; [căci] they [sunt] ei lângă kinswomen: it [este] răutate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשה על אחותה לא תקח לצרר לגלות ערותה עליה בחייה
verses.english: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex [her], to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life [time].
verses.romanian: Neither shalt tu a lua a wife to ei soră, to vex [ei], to uncover ei goliciune, beside the other in ei life [time].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל אשה בנדת טמאתה לא תקרב לגלות ערותה
verses.english: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.romanian: de asemenea să nu approach unto a femeie to uncover ei goliciune, as long as she este a pune apart căci ei necurăție.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל אשת עמיתך לא תתן שכבתך לזרע לטמאה בה
verses.english: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.romanian: Moreover să nu minciună carnally cu tău neighbour's wife, to a pângări thyself cu ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומזרעך לא תתן להעביד למלך ולא תחלל את שם אלהיך אני יהוה
verses.english: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through [the fire] to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: și să nu let vreun of tău sămânță pass prin [the foc] to Molech, neither shalt tu a profana the name of tău Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת זכר לא תשכב משכבי אשה תועבה היא
verses.english: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it [is] abomination.
verses.romanian: să nu minciună cu mankind, as cu womankind: it [este] urâciune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובכל בהמה לא תתן שכבתך לטמאה בה ואשה לא תעמד לפני בהמה לרבעה תבל הוא
verses.english: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it [is] confusion.
verses.romanian: Neither shalt tu minciună cu vreun beast to a pângări thyself therewith: neither shall vreun femeie stand înainte a beast to minciună down thereto: it [este] confusion.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תטמאו בכל אלה כי בכל אלה נטמאו הגוים אשר אני משלח מפניכם
verses.english: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.romanian: a pângări nu voi yourselves in vreun of these things: căci in toți these the nations sunt pângărit care I cast out înainte voi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותטמא הארץ ואפקד עונה עליה ותקיא הארץ את ישביה
verses.english: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.romanian: și the țară este pângărit: de aceea I a face visit the nelegiuire thereof upon it, și the țară itself vomiteth out ei inhabitants.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את חקותי ואת משפטי ולא תעשו מכל התועבות האלה האזרח והגר הגר בתוככם
verses.english: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit [any] of these abominations; [neither] any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.romanian: să de aceea a păzi meu decrete și meu judecăți, și shall nu commit [vreun] of these urâciuni; [neither] vreun of vostru own nation, nor vreun străin că sojourneth în mijlocul voi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי את כל התועבות האלה עשו אנשי הארץ אשר לפניכם ותטמא הארץ
verses.english: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which [were] before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.romanian: (căci toți these urâciuni au the oameni of the țară done, care [erau] înainte voi, și the țară este pângărit;)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תקיא הארץ אתכם בטמאכם אתה כאשר קאה את הגוי אשר לפניכם
verses.english: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that [were] before you.
verses.romanian: că the țară spue nu voi out de asemenea, când voi a pângări it, as it spued out the nations că [erau] înainte voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי כל אשר יעשה מכל התועבות האלה ונכרתו הנפשות העשות מקרב עמם
verses.english: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit [them] shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.romanian: căci whosoever shall commit vreun of these urâciuni, even the souls că commit [ei] shall fi a tăia off din în mijlocul lor people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את משמרתי לבלתי עשות מחקות התועבות אשר נעשו לפניכם ולא תטמאו בהן כי אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that [ye] commit not [any one] of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: de aceea shall voi a păzi mine rânduială, că [voi] commit nu [vreun unu] of these abominable customs, care erau committed înainte voi, și că voi a pângări nu yourselves therein: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל כל עדת בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם קדישים תהיו כי קדוש אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God [am] holy.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto toți obștea of the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, să fi sfânt: căci I DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu [am] sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש אמו ואביו תיראו ואת שבתתי תשמרו אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: să a se teme fiecare om lui mamă, și lui tată, și a păzi meu șabaturi: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תפנו אל האלילים ואלהי מסכה לא תעשו לכם אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: a se întoarce voi nu unto idols, nor a face to yourselves molten gods: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תזבחו זבח שלמים ליהוה לרצונכם תזבחהו
verses.english: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.romanian: și dacă voi a aduce a jertfă of peace jertfe unto DOMNUL, să a aduce it at vostru own will.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום זבחכם יאכל וממחרת והנותר עד יום השלישי באש ישרף
verses.english: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.romanian: It shall fi eaten the same zi voi a aduce it, și on the morrow: și dacă ought remain until the third zi, it shall fi burnt in the foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם אכל יאכל ביום השלישי פגול הוא לא ירצה
verses.english: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it [is] abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.romanian: și dacă it fi eaten at toți on the third zi, it [este] abominable; it shall nu fi accepted.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלו עונו ישא כי את קדש יהוה חלל ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מעמיה
verses.english: Therefore [every one] that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.romanian: de aceea [fiecare unu] că eateth it shall bear lui nelegiuire, pentru că he sunt profanat the hallowed thing of DOMNUL: și că soul shall fi a tăia off din în mijlocul lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובקצירכם את קציר ארצכם לא תכלה פאת שדך לקצר ולקט קצירך לא תלקט
verses.english: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.romanian: și când voi reap the seceriș of vostru țară, să nu wholly reap the corners of tău câmp, neither shalt tu gather the gleanings of tău seceriș.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכרמך לא תעולל ופרט כרמך לא תלקט לעני ולגר תעזב אתם אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather [every] grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: și să nu glean tău vineyard, neither shalt tu gather [fiecare] grape of tău vineyard; să leave ei căci the sărac și străin: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תגנבו ולא תכחשו ולא תשקרו איש בעמיתו
verses.english: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.romanian: să nu a fura, neither deal falsely, neither minciună unu to another.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תשבעו בשמי לשקר וחללת את שם אלהיך אני יהוה
verses.english: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: și să nu a jura by meu name falsely, neither shalt tu a profana the name of tău Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשק את רעך ולא תגזל לא תלין פעלת שכיר אתך עד בקר
verses.english: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob [him]: and the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.romanian: să nu defraud tău neighbour, neither rob [lui]: și the wages al lui că este hired shall nu abide cu tine toți night until the morning.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תקלל חרש ולפני עור לא תתן מכשול ויראת מאלהיך אני יהוה
verses.english: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să nu a blestema the deaf, nor a pune a stumblingblock înainte the blind, dar shalt a se teme tău Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשה עול במשפט לא תשא פני דל ולא תהדר פני גדול בצדק תשפט את עמיתך
verses.english: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: [but] in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.romanian: să a face no unrighteousness in judecată: să nu respect the person of the sărac, nor honour the person of the mighty: [dar] in righteousness shalt tu a judeca tău neighbour.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תלך רכיל בעמך ולא תעמד על דם רעך אני יהוה
verses.english: Thou shalt not go up and down [as] a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să nu a merge up și down [as] a talebearer în mijlocul tău people: neither shalt tu stand împotriva the sânge of tău neighbour: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תשנא את אחיך בלבבך הוכיח תוכיח את עמיתך ולא תשא עליו חטא
verses.english: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.romanian: să nu hate tău frate in thine heart: să in vreun wise rebuke tău neighbour, și nu suffer păcat upon lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תקום ולא תהטר את בני עמך ואהבת לרעך כמוך אני יהוה
verses.english: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să nu avenge, nor bear vreun grudge împotriva the copii of tău people, dar să a iubi tău neighbour ca pe tine însuți: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את חקותי תשמרו בהמתך לא תרביע כלאים ושדך לא תזרע כלאים ובגד כלאים שעטניז לא יעלה עליך
