verses.english: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: and thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.romanian: să a păzi meu decrete. să nu let tău cattle gender cu a diverse kind: și să nu sow tău câmp cu mingled sămânță: neither shall a veșmânt mingled of in și woollen a veni upon te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי ישכב את אשה שכבת זרע והיא שפחה נחרפת לאיש והפדה לא נפדתה או חפשי לא נתן לה בקרת תהיה לו לא יומת כי לא חפשה
verses.english: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that [is] a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.romanian: și whosoever lieth carnally cu a femeie, că [este] a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, și nu at toți răscumpărat, nor libertate dat ei; ea să fi scourged; ei să nu fi a pune to death, pentru că she era nu free.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא את אשמו ליהוה אל פתח אהל מועד איל אשם
verses.english: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, [even] a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.romanian: și el să a aduce lui jertfă pentru vină unto DOMNUL, unto the ușă of Cortul Întâlnirii, [even] a berbec căci a jertfă pentru vină.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכפר עליו הכהן באיל האשם לפני יהוה על חטאתו אשר חטא ונסלח לו מחטאתו אשר חטא
verses.english: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall a face an ispășire pentru el cu the berbec of the jertfă pentru vină înainte DOMNUL căci lui păcat care he sunt done: și the păcat care he sunt done îi va fi iertat lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תבאו אל הארץ ונטעתם כל עץ מאכל וערלתם את ערלתו את פריו שלש שנים יהיה לכם ערלים לא יאכל
verses.english: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.romanian: și când să a veni into the țară, și shall au planted toți manner of copaci căci food, atunci să count the rod thereof as uncircumcised: trei ani shall it fi as uncircumcised vouă: it shall nu fi eaten of.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשנה הרביעית יהיו כל פריו קדש חללים ליהוה
verses.english: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD [withal].
verses.romanian: dar in the al patrulea an toți the rod thereof shall fi sfânt to praise DOMNUL [withal].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשנה החמישית תאכלו את פריו להסיף לכם תבואתו אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: și in the al cincilea an shall voi eat of the rod thereof, că it poate yield vouă the rod thereof: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תאכלו על הדם ולא תנחשו ולא תעננו
verses.english: Ye shall not eat [any thing] with the blood: and neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.romanian: voi să nu mănânce [vreun thing] cu the sânge: și neither shall voi use enchantment, nor a păzi times.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תקיפו את פאת ראשכם ולא תשחיתו את פאת זקנכם
verses.english: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.romanian: să nu round the corners of vostru heads, neither shalt tu mar the corners of tău barbă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושרטה לנפש לא תתנו בבשרכם וכתבת קעקע לא תתנו בכם אני יהוה
verses.english: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să nu a face vreun cuttings in vostru flesh căci the dead, nor print vreun marks upon voi: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תחלל את בתך להזנותה ולא תזנה הארץ ומלאה הארץ זמה
verses.english: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.romanian: a face nu prostitute tău fiică, to cause ei to fi a desfrânată; lest the țară fall to desfrânare, și the țară become full of răutate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את שבתתי תשמרו ומקדשי תיראו אני יהוה
verses.english: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să a păzi meu șabaturi, și reverence meu sanctuary: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תפנו אל האובות ואל הידעונים אל תבקשו לטמאה בהם אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: Regard nu ei că au familiar spirits, neither seek după wizards, to fi pângărit de ei: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מפני שיבה תקום והדרת פני זקן ויראת מאלהיך אני יהוה
verses.english: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să rise up înainte the hoary cap, și honour the face of the old om, și a se teme tău Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יגור אתכם גר בארצכם לא תונו אתו
verses.english: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.romanian: și dacă a străin sojourn cu tine in vostru țară, să nu vex lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאזרח מכם יהיה לכם הגר הגר אתכם ואהבת לו כמוך כי גרים הייתם בארץ מצרים אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: [But] the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: [dar] the străin că dwelleth cu voi shall fi vouă as unu born în mijlocul voi, și să a iubi lui ca pe tine însuți; căci voi erau străini in the țară of Egypt: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשו עול במשפט במדה במשקול ובמשורה
verses.english: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.romanian: să a face no unrighteousness in judecată, in meteyard, in weight, sau in measure.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מאזני צדק אבני צדק איפת צדק והין צדק יהיה לכם אני יהוה אלהיכם אשר הוצאתי אתכם מארץ מצרים
verses.english: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.romanian: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, și a just hin, shall voi au: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu, care a adus voi out of the țară of Egypt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את כל חקותי ואת כל משפטי ועשיתם אתם אני יהוה
verses.english: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: de aceea shall voi a păzi toți meu decrete, și toți meu judecăți, și a face ei: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל בני ישראל תדבר איש איש מבית ישראל ומן הגר הגר בישראל אשר יתן מזרעו למלך מות יומת עם הארץ ירגמהו באבן
verses.english: Again, thou shalt say to the houses of Israel, Whosoever [he be] of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth [any] of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.romanian: Again, să a spune to the case of Israel, Whosoever [he fi] of the copii of Israel, sau of the străini că sojourn in Israel, că giveth [vreun] of lui sămânță unto Molech; el să negresit fi a pune to death: the people of the țară shall piatră lui cu pietre.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואני אתן את פני באיש ההוא והכרתי אתו מקרב עמו כי מזרעו נתן למלך למען טמא את מקדשי וחלל את שם קדשי
verses.english: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto king, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.romanian: și voi a așeza meu face împotriva că om, și will a tăia lui off din în mijlocul lui people; pentru că he sunt dat of lui sămânță unto king, to a pângări meu sanctuary, și to a profana meu sfânt name.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם העלם יעלמו עם הארץ את עיניהם מן האיש ההוא בתתו מזרעו למלך לבלתי המית אתו
verses.english: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto king, and kill him not:
verses.romanian: și dacă the people of the țară a face vreun căi hide lor eyes din the om, când he giveth of lui sămânță unto king, și a ucide lui nu:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמתי אני את פני באיש ההוא ובמשפחתו והכרתי אתו ואת כל הזנים אחריו לזנות אחרי המלך מקרב עמם
verses.english: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.romanian: atunci voi a așeza meu face împotriva că om, și împotriva lui family, și will a tăia lui off, și toți că a merge a whoring după lui, to commit desfrânare cu Molech, din în mijlocul lor people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנפש אשר תפנה אל האובות ואל הידעונים לזנות אחריהם ונתתי את פני בנפש ההיא והכרתי אתה מקרב עמה
verses.english: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.romanian: și the soul că turneth după such as au familiar spirits, și după wizards, to a merge a whoring după ei, voi even a așeza meu face împotriva că soul, și will a tăia lui off din în mijlocul lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והייתם קדישים כי קדוש אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: a sfinți yourselves de aceea, și fi voi sfânt: căci I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את כל חקותי ועשיתם אתם אני יהוה מקדשכם
verses.english: And ye shall keep all my statutes, and do them: I [am] the LORD which sanctify you.
verses.romanian: și să a păzi toți meu decrete, și a face ei: I [am] DOMNUL care a sfinți voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי איש איש אשר יקלל את אביו ואת אמו מות יומת אביו ואמו קלל דמו בו
verses.english: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood [shall be] upon him.
verses.romanian: căci fiecare unu că curseth lui tată sau lui mamă shall fi negresit a pune to death: he sunt blestemat lui tată sau lui mamă; lui sânge [shall fi] upon lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר ינאף את אשת איש אשר ינאף את אשת רעהו מות יומת הנאף והנאפת
verses.english: And the man that committeth adultery with [another] man's wife, [even he] that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.romanian: și the om că committeth adultery cu [another] om's wife, [even he] că committeth adultery cu lui neighbour's wife, the adulterer și the adulteress shall negresit fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר ישכב את אשת אביו ערות אביו גלה מות יומתו שניהם דמיהם בם
verses.english: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood [shall be] upon them.
verses.romanian: și the om că lieth cu lui tată's wife sunt uncovered lui tată's goliciune: both al lor shall negresit fi a pune to death; lor sânge [shall fi] upon ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר ישכב את כלתו מות יומתו שניהם תבל עשו דמיהם בם
verses.english: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood [shall be] upon them.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om minciună cu lui fiică-in-lege, both al lor shall negresit fi a pune to death: they au wrought confusion; lor sânge [shall fi] upon ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר ישכב את זכר משכבי אשה תועבה עשו מות יומתו שניהם דמיהם בם
verses.english: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood [shall be] upon them.
verses.romanian: dacă a om de asemenea minciună cu mankind, as he lieth cu a femeie, both al lor au committed an urâciune: ei să negresit fi a pune to death; lor sânge [shall fi] upon ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר יקח את אשה ואת אמה זמה היא באש ישרפו אתו ואתהן ולא תהיה זמה בתוככם
verses.english: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it [is] wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om a lua a wife și ei mamă, it [este] răutate: ei să fi burnt cu foc, both he și they; că acolo fi no răutate în mijlocul voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר יתן שכבתו בבהמה מות יומת ואת הבהמה תהרגו
verses.english: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om minciună cu a beast, el să negresit fi a pune to death: și să slay the beast.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשה אשר תקרב אל כל בהמה לרבעה אתה והרגת את האשה ואת הבהמה מות יומתו דמיהם בם
verses.english: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood [shall be] upon them.
verses.romanian: și dacă a femeie approach unto vreun beast, și minciună down thereto, să a ucide the femeie, și the beast: ei să negresit fi a pune to death; lor sânge [shall fi] upon ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר יקח את אחותו בת אביו או בת אמו וראה את ערותה והיא תראה את ערותו חסד הוא ונכרתו לעיני בני עמם ערות אחותו גלה עונו ישא
verses.english: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it [is] a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om shall a lua lui soră, lui tată's fiică, sau lui mamă's fiică, și a vedea ei goliciune, și she a vedea lui goliciune; it [este] a rău thing; și ei să fi a tăia off in the sight of lor people: he sunt uncovered lui soră's goliciune; el să bear lui nelegiuire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר ישכב את אשה דוה וגלה את ערותה את מקור הערוה והיא גלתה את מקור דמיה ונכרתו שניהם מקרב עמם
verses.english: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om shall minciună cu a femeie having ei sickness, și shall uncover ei goliciune; he sunt discovered ei fountain, și she sunt uncovered the fountain of ei sânge: și both al lor shall fi a tăia off din în mijlocul lor people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ערות אחות אביך ואחות אמך לא תגלה כי את שאר הערוה עונם ישאו
verses.english: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister, nor of thy mother's sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.romanian: și să nu uncover the goliciune of tău tată's soră, nor of tău mamă's soră: căci he uncovereth lui lângă rudă: ei să bear lor nelegiuire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר ישכב את דדתו את ערות דדו גלה חטאם ישאו עררים יומתו
verses.english: And if a man shall lie with his uncle's wife, he hath uncovered his uncle's nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om shall minciună cu lui unchi's wife, he sunt uncovered lui unchi's goliciune: ei să bear lor păcat; ei să die childless.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש אשר יקח את אשת אחיו נדה היא ערות אחיו גלה עררים יהיו
verses.english: And if a man shall take his brother's wife, it [is] an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om shall a lua lui frate's wife, it [este] an necurat thing: he sunt uncovered lui frate's goliciune; ei să fi childless.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את כל חקותי ואת כל משפטי ועשיתם אתם ולא תקיא הארץ אתכם אשר אני מביא אתכם שמה לשבת בה
verses.english: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
verses.romanian: să de aceea a păzi toți meu decrete, și toți meu judecăți, și a face ei: că the țară, whither I a aduce voi to a locui therein, spue voi nu out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תלכו בחקות הגוים אשר אני משלח מפניכם כי את כל אלה עשו ואקץ בם
verses.english: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.romanian: și să nu a umbla in the manners of the nation, care I cast out înainte voi: căci they committed toți these things, și de aceea I abhorred ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמר לכם אתם תירשו את אדמתם ואני אתננה לכם לרשת אתה ארץ זבת חלב ודבש אני יהוה אלהיכם אשר הבדלתי אתכם מן העמים
verses.english: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I [am] the LORD your God, which have separated you from [other] people.
verses.romanian: dar I au a spus vouă, să a moșteni lor țară, și voi a da it vouă to a stăpâni it, a țară că floweth cu milk și honey: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu, care au despărțit voi din [other] people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבדלתם בין הבהמה הטהרה לטמאה ובין העוף הטמא לטהור ולא תשקצו את נפשתיכם בבהמה ובעוף ובכל אשר תרמש האדמה אשר הבדלתי לכם לטמאה
verses.english: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.romanian: să de aceea a pune difference between curat beasts și necurat, și between necurat fowls și curat: și să nu a face vostru souls abominable by beast, sau by fowl, sau by vreun manner of living thing că creepeth on the ground, care I au despărțit de la voi as necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והייתם לי קדישים כי אני יהוה ואבדיל אתכם מן העמים להיות לי
verses.english: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD [am] holy, and have severed you from [other] people, that ye should be mine.
verses.romanian: și să fi sfânt mie: căci I DOMNUL [am] sfânt, și au severed voi din [other] people, că voi should fi mine.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש או אשה אשר יהיה בהם אוב או ידעוני מות יומתו באבנים תרגמום דמיהם בם
verses.english: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood [shall be] upon them.
verses.romanian: A om de asemenea sau femeie că sunt a familiar spirit, sau că este a wizard, shall negresit fi a pune to death: ei să piatră ei cu pietre: lor sânge [shall fi] upon ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה אמר אל הכהנים בני אהרן ואמרת אליהם לנפש לא יטמא בעמו
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a spus unto Moise, a vorbi unto the preoți the fii of Aaron, și a spune lor, acolo shall niciun fi pângărit căci the dead în mijlocul lui people:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם לשארו הקרוב אליו לאביו ולאמו לבנו ולבתו לאחיו
verses.english: But for his kin, that is near unto him, [that is], for his father, and for his mother, for his son, and for his daughter, for his brother
verses.romanian: dar căci lui rudă, că este lângă lui, [că este], căci lui tată, și căci lui mamă, căci lui fiu, și căci lui fiică, căci lui frate

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולאחותו הבתולה הקרובה אליו אשר לא היתה לאיש לה יטמא
verses.english: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
verses.romanian: și căci lui soră a virgin, că este nigh lui, care sunt had no husband; căci ei poate he fi pângărit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יטמא בעל בעמו להחלו
verses.english: [But] he shall not defile himself, [being] a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.romanian: [dar] el să nu a pângări himself, [being] a chief om în mijlocul lui people, to a profana himself.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יקרחו קרחה בראשם ופאת זקנם לא יגלחו ובבשרם לא ישרטו שרטה
verses.english: And they shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.romanian: și ei să nu a face baldness upon lor cap, neither shall they shave off the corner of lor barbă, nor a face vreun cuttings in lor flesh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קדישים יהיו לאלהיהם ולא יחללו את שם אלהיהם כי את אשי יהוה לחם אלהיהם הם מקרבים והיו קדישים
verses.english: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, [and] the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
verses.romanian: ei să fi sfânt unto lor Dumnezeu, și nu a profana the name of lor Dumnezeu: căci the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc, [și] the bread of lor Dumnezeu, they a face a aduce: de aceea ei să fi sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשה זונה וחללה לא יקחו ואשה גרושה מאישה לא יקחו כי קדוש הוא לאלהיו
verses.english: They shall not take a wife [that is] a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he [is] holy unto his God.
verses.romanian: ei să nu a lua a wife [că este] a desfrânată, sau a profana; neither shall they a lua a femeie a pune away din ei husband: căci he [este] sfânt unto lui Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקדשתו כי את לחם אלהיך הוא מקריב קדוש יהיה לך כי קדוש אני יהוה מקדשם
verses.english: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD, which sanctify you, [am] holy.
verses.romanian: să a sfinți lui de aceea; căci he offereth the bread of tău Dumnezeu: el să fi sfânt ție: căci I DOMNUL, care a sfinți voi, [am] sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובת איש כהן כי תחל לזנות את אביה היא מחללת באש תשרף
verses.english: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.romanian: și the fiică of vreun preot, dacă she a profana herself by playing the desfrânată, she profaneth ei tată: ea să fi burnt cu foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והכהן הגדול מאחיו אשר יוצק על ראשו שמן המשחה ומלא ידו ללבש את הבגדים את ראשו לא יפרע ובגדיו לא יפרם
verses.english: And [he that is] the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
verses.romanian: și [he că este] the high preot în mijlocul lui brethren, upon al cărui cap the ungere oil era a turnat, și că este consacrat to a pune on the veșminte, să nu descopere lui cap, nor rend lui clothes;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל כל נפשות מת לא יבוא לאביו ולאמו לא יטמא
verses.english: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.romanian: Neither shall he a merge in to vreun dead body, nor a pângări himself căci lui tată, sau căci lui mamă;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומן המקדש לא יצא ולא יחלל את מקדש אלהיו כי נזר שמן משחת אלהיו עליו אני יהוה
verses.english: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God [is] upon him: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: Neither shall he a merge out of Sanctuarul, nor a profana Sanctuarul of lui Dumnezeu; căci the diademă of the ungere oil of lui Dumnezeu [este] upon lui: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והוא אשה בבתוליה יקח
verses.english: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.romanian: și el să a lua a wife in ei virginity.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלמנה וגרושה וחללה וזונה את אלה לא יקח כי אם בתולה מעמו יקח אשה
verses.english: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or a harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
verses.romanian: A văduvă, sau a divorced femeie, sau a profana, sau a harlot, these shall he nu a lua: dar el să a lua a virgin of lui own people to wife.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יחלל זרעו בעמו כי אני יהוה מקדשו
verses.english: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.
verses.romanian: Neither shall he a profana lui sămânță în mijlocul lui people: căci I DOMNUL a face a sfinți lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל אהרן לאמר איש מזרעך לדרותם אשר יהיה בו מום לא יקרב להגיש לחם אלהיו
verses.english: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever [he be] of thy seed in their generations that hath [any] blemish, let him not approach to the bread of his God.
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Aaron, saying, Whosoever [he fi] of tău sămânță in lor generations că sunt [vreun] cusur, let lui nu approach to the bread of lui Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי כל איש אשר יהיה בו מום לא יקרב איש עור או פסח או חרום או שרוע
verses.english: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous
verses.romanian: căci whatsoever om he fi că sunt a cusur, he să nu se apropie: a blind om, sau a lame, sau he că sunt a flat nose, sau vreun thing superfluous

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או איש אשר יהיה בו שבר רגל או שבר יד
verses.english: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded
verses.romanian: sau a om că este brokenfooted, sau brokenhanded

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או גבן או דק או תבלל בעיניו או גרב או ילפת או מרוח אשך
verses.english: Or crookbacked, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eyes, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;
verses.romanian: sau crookbacked, sau a dwarf, sau că sunt a cusur in lui eyes, sau fi scurvy, sau scabbed, sau sunt lui pietre broken;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל איש אשר בו מום מזרע אהרן הכהן לא יגיש את אשי יהוה מום בו לא יגש להקריב
verses.english: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.
verses.romanian: No om că sunt a cusur of the sămânță of Aaron the preot shall a veni nigh to a aduce the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc: he sunt a cusur; el să nu a veni nigh to a aduce the bread of lui Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לחם אלהיו מקדשי הקדשים ומן הקדשים יאכל
verses.english: He shall eat the bread of his God, [both] of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.romanian: He să mănânce the bread of lui Dumnezeu, [both] of the preasfânt, și of the sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך אל הפרכת לא יבוא ואל המזבח לא יגש כי מום בו ולא יחלל את מקדשי כי אני יהוה מקדשם
verses.english: Only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.romanian: numai el să nu a merge in unto the văl, nor a veni nigh unto altarul, pentru că he sunt a cusur; că he a profana nu meu sanctuaries: căci I DOMNUL a face a sfinți ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל אהרן ואל בניו ואל כל בני ישראל
verses.english: And Moses told [it] unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moise told [it] lui Aaron, și to lui fii, și unto toți the copii of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל אהרן ואל בניו וינזרו מקדשי בני ישראל ולא יחללו את שם קדשי אשר הם מקדישים לי אני יהוה
verses.english: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name [in those things] which they hallow unto me: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Aaron și to lui fii, că they a despărți themselves din the lucrurile sfinte of the copii of Israel, și că they a profana nu meu sfânt name [in those things] care they hallow mie: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אמר אליהם לדרתיכם כל איש אשר יקרב מכל זרעכם אל הקדשים אשר יקדישו בני ישראל ליהוה וטמאתו עליו ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מלפני אני יהוה
verses.english: Say unto them, Whosoever [he be] of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: a spune lor, Whosoever [he fi] of toți vostru sămânță în mijlocul vostru generations, că goeth unto the lucrurile sfinte, care the copii of Israel hallow unto DOMNUL, having lui necurăție upon lui, că soul shall fi a tăia off din meu presence: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש איש מזרע אהרן והוא צרוע או זב בקדשים לא יאכל עד אשר יטהר והנגע בכל טמא נפש או איש אשר תצא ממנו שכבת זרע
verses.english: What man soever of the seed of Aaron [is] a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing [that is] unclean [by] the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;
verses.romanian: ce om soever of the sămânță of Aaron [este] a leper, sau sunt a running scurgere; he să nu mănânce of the lucrurile sfinte, until he fi curat. și whoso toucheth vreun thing [că este] necurat [by] the dead, sau a om al cărui sămânță goeth de la el;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או איש אשר יגע בכל שרץ טמא אשר יטמא לו או באדם אשר יטמא לו לכל טמאתו
verses.english: Or whosoever toucheth any unclean creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;
verses.romanian: sau whosoever toucheth vreun necurat creeping thing, whereby he poate fi a făcut necurat, sau a om of pe care he poate a lua necurăție, whatsoever necurăție he sunt;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נפש אשר תגע בו וטמא עד הערב ולא יאכל מן הקדשים כי אם רחץ בשרו במים
verses.english: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
verses.romanian: The soul care sunt touched vreun such shall fi necurat until even, și să nu mănânce of the lucrurile sfinte, unless he a spăla lui flesh cu apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובא השמש וטהר ואחר יאכל מן הקדשים כי לחמו הוא
verses.english: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it [is] his food.
verses.romanian: și când the soare este down, el să fi curat, și shall afterward eat of the lucrurile sfinte; pentru că it [este] lui food.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נבלה וטרפה לא יאכלו לטמאה בה אני יהוה
verses.english: That which dieth of itself, or is torn [with beasts], he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: că care dieth of itself, sau este torn [cu beasts], he să nu mănânce to a pângări himself therewith: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרו את משמרתי ולא ישאו עליו חטא ומתו בו כי יחללהו אני יהוה מקדשם
verses.english: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.romanian: ei să de aceea a păzi mine rânduială, lest they bear păcat căci it, și die de aceea, dacă they a profana it: I DOMNUL a face a sfinți ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל זר לא יאכל קדש תושב כהן ושכיר לא יאכל קדש
verses.english: There shall no stranger eat [of] the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat [of] the holy thing.
verses.romanian: acolo shall no străin eat [of] the sfânt thing: a străin care locuiește of the preot, sau an hired slujitor, să nu mănânce [of] the sfânt thing.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכהן כי יקנה נפש קנין כספו הוא יאכל בו וילידי ביתו הם יאכלו בלחמו
verses.english: But if the priest buy [any] soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
verses.romanian: dar dacă the preot a cumpăra [vreun] soul cu lui money, he să mănânce of it, și he că este born in lui casă: they să mănânce of lui carne.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובת כהן כי תהיה לאיש זר היא בתרומת הקדשים לא תאכל
verses.english: If the priest's daughter also be [married] unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
verses.romanian: dacă the preot's fiică de asemenea fi [married] unto a străin, she poate nu eat of an jertfă of the lucrurile sfinte.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובת כהן כי תהיה אלמנה וגרושה וזרע אין לה ושבה אל בית אביה כנעריה מלחם אביה תאכל וכל זר לא יאכל בו
verses.english: But if the priest's daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father's house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father's meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
verses.romanian: dar dacă the preot's fiică fi a văduvă, sau divorced, și au no copil, și este s-a întors ei tată's casă, as in ei youth, she să mănânce of ei tată's carne: dar acolo shall no străin eat thereof.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי יאכל קדש בשגגה ויסף חמישתו עליו ונתן לכהן את הקדש
verses.english: And if a man eat [of] the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth [part] thereof unto it, and shall give [it] unto the priest with the holy thing.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om eat [of] the sfânt thing unwittingly, atunci el să a pune the fifth [part] thereof unto it, și shall a da [it] unto the preot cu the sfânt thing.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יחללו את קדשי בני ישראל אשר ירימו ליהוה
verses.english: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD;
verses.romanian: și ei să nu a profana the lucrurile sfinte of the copii of Israel, care they a aduce unto DOMNUL;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשיאו אתם עון אשמה באכלם את קדשיהם כי אני יהוה מקדשם
verses.english: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.
verses.romanian: sau suffer ei to bear the nelegiuire of trespass, când they eat lor lucrurile sfinte: căci I DOMNUL a face a sfinți ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל אהרן ואל בניו ואל כל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם איש איש מבית ישראל ומן הגר הגר בישראל אשר יקריב קרבנו לכל נדריהם ולכל נדבתם אשר יקריבו ליהוה לעלה
verses.english: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever [he be] of the house of Israel, or of the stranger, stranger in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Aaron, și to lui fii, și unto toți the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, Whatsoever [he fi] of the casă of Israel, sau of the străin, străin in Israel, că will a aduce lui oblation căci toți lui vows, și căci toți lui freewill jertfe, care ei vor a aduce unto DOMNUL căci a ardere-de-tot;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לרצונכם תמים זכר בבקר או בכשבים או בעזים
verses.english: [Ye shall offer] at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.romanian: [să a aduce] at vostru own will a mascul fără cusur, of the beeves, of the sheep, sau of the țapi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל אשר בו מום לא תקריבו כי לא לרצון יהיה לכם
verses.english: [But] whatsoever hath a blemish, [that] shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.romanian: [dar] whatsoever sunt a cusur, [că] shall voi nu a aduce: căci it shall nu fi acceptable pentru voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי יקריב זבח שלמים ליהוה לפלא נדר או נדבה בבקר או בצאן תמים יהיה לרצון וכל מום לא יהיה בו
verses.english: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish [his] vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no kind of blemish therein.
verses.romanian: și whosoever offereth a jertfă of peace jertfe unto DOMNUL to accomplish [lui] vow, sau a freewill jertfă in beeves sau sheep, it shall fi perfect to fi accepted; acolo shall fi no kind of cusur therein.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עורת או שבור או חרוץ או יבלת או גרב או ילפת לא תקריבו אלה ליהוה ואשה לא תתנו מהם על המזבח ליהוה
verses.english: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: Blind, sau broken, sau maimed, sau having a wen, sau scurvy, sau scabbed, să nu a aduce these unto DOMNUL, nor a face an jertfă by foc al lor upon altarul unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושור ושה שרוע וקלוט נדבה תעשו אתו ולנדר לא ירצה
verses.english: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer [for] a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.romanian: Either a vițel sau a miel că sunt vreun thing superfluous sau lacking in lui parts, că mayest tu a aduce [căci] a freewill jertfă; dar căci a vow it shall nu fi accepted.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומעוך וכתות ונתוק וכרות לא תקריבו ליהוה ובארצכם לא תעשו
verses.english: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make [any offering thereof] in your land.
verses.romanian: să nu a aduce unto DOMNUL că care este bruised, sau crushed, sau broken, sau a tăia; neither shall voi a face [vreun jertfă thereof] in vostru țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומיד בן נכר לא תקריבו את לחם אלהיכם מכל אלה כי משחיתים בהם מום בם לא ירצו לכם
verses.english: Neither from a stranger's hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption [is] in them, [and] blemishes [be] in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.romanian: Neither din a străin's hand shall voi a aduce the bread of vostru Dumnezeu of vreun of these; pentru că lor corruption [este] in ei, [și] blemishes [fi] in ei: ei să nu fi accepted pentru voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שור או כשב או עז כי יולד והיה שבעת ימים תחת אמו ומיום השמיני והלאה ירצה לקרבן אשה ליהוה
verses.english: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: când a vițel, sau a sheep, sau a țap, este a adus forth, atunci it shall fi șapte zile sub the dam; și din the eighth zi și thenceforth it shall fi accepted căci an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושור ושה אתו ואת בנו לא תשחטו ביום אחד
verses.english: And [whether it be] cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
verses.romanian: și [whether it fi] cow sau ewe, să nu a ucide it și ei young both in unu zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תזבחו זבח תודה ליהוה לרצונכם תזבחהו
verses.english: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD, offer [it] at your own will.
verses.romanian: și când voi will a aduce a jertfă of thanksgiving unto DOMNUL, a aduce [it] at vostru own will.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום ההוא יאכל לא תותירו ממנו עד בקר אני יהוה
verses.english: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: On the same zi it shall fi eaten up; să leave niciun of it until the morrow: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את מצותי ועשיתם אתם
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תחללו את שם קדשי ונקדשתי בתוך בני ישראל אני יהוה מקדשם
verses.english: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I [am] the LORD which hallow you
verses.romanian: Neither shall voi a profana meu sfânt name; dar voi fi hallowed în mijlocul the copii of Israel: I [am] DOMNUL care hallow voi

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המוצא אתכם מארץ מצרים להיות לכם לאלהים אני יהוה
verses.english: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: că a adus voi out of the țară of Egypt, to fi vostru Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם מועדי יהוה אשר תקראו אתם מקראי קדש אלה הם מועדי
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, [Concerning] the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim [to be] holy convocations, [even] these [are] my feasts.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, [Concerning] the feasts of DOMNUL, care să a proclama [to fi] sfânt convocations, [even] these [sunt] meu feasts.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ששת ימים יעשה מלאכה וביום השביעי שבת שבתון מקרא קדש כל מלאכה לא תעשו שבת היא ליהוה בכל מושבתיכם
verses.english: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day [is] the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work [therein]: it [is] the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.
verses.romanian: șase zile shall lucrare fi done: dar the a șaptea zi [este] the Șabat of odihnă, an sfânt convocation; să a face no lucrare [therein]: it [este] the Șabat of DOMNUL in toți vostru dwellings.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה מועדי יהוה מקראי קדש אשר תקראו אתם במועדם
verses.english: And these [are] the feasts of the LORD, [even] holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] the feasts of DOMNUL, [even] sfânt convocations, care să a proclama in lor seasons.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בחדש הראישון בארבעה עשר יום לחדש בין הערבים פסח ליהוה
verses.english: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even [is] the LORD's passover.
verses.romanian: In the fourteenth zi of the luna întâi at even [este] DOMNUL's Paștele.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובחמשה עשר יום לחדש הזה חג המצות ליהוה שבעת ימים מצות תאכלו
verses.english: And on the fifteenth day of the same month [is] the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
verses.romanian: și on the a cincisprezecea zi of the same lună [este] the feast of pâine nedospită unto DOMNUL: șapte zile voi trebuie eat pâine nedospită.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום הראישון מקרא קדש יהיה לכם כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.
verses.romanian: In the prima zi să au an sfânt convocation: să a face no servile lucrare therein.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבתם אשה ליהוה שבעת ימים וביום השביעי מקרא קדש כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: and in the seventh day [is] an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work [therein].
verses.romanian: dar să a aduce an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL șapte zile: și in the a șaptea zi [este] an sfânt convocation: să a face no servile lucrare [therein].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם כי תבאו אל הארץ אשר אני נתן לכם וקצרתם את קצירה והבאתם את העמר ראשית קצירכם אל הכהן
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, când voi fi a veni into the țară care I a da vouă, și shall reap the seceriș thereof, atunci să a aduce a sheaf of the pârga of vostru seceriș unto the preot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והניף את העמר לפני יהוה לרצונכם ממחרת השבת יניפנו הכהן
verses.english: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.romanian: și el să wave the sheaf înainte DOMNUL, to fi accepted pentru voi: on the morrow după the Șabat the preot shall wave it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשיתם ביום הנפכם את העמר כבש תמים בן שנתו לעלה ליהוה
verses.english: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și să a aduce că zi când voi wave the sheaf an he miel fără cusur of the primul an căci a ardere-de-tot unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתו שני עשרנים סלת בלולה בשמן אשה ליהוה ריח ניחח ונסכו יין רביעית ההין
verses.english: And the meat offering thereof [shall be] two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD [for] a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof [shall be] of wine, the fourth [part] of an hin.
verses.romanian: și the dar de mâncare thereof [shall fi] doi tenth deals of făină fină mingled cu oil, an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL [căci] a aromă plăcută: și the jertfă de băutură thereof [shall fi] of wine, the fourth [part] of an hin.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולחם וקלי וכרמל לא תאכלו עד עצם היום הזה עד הבאכם את קרבן אלהיכם חקת עולם לדרתיכם בכל מושבתיכם
verses.english: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.romanian: și voi să mănânce neither bread, nor parched grâu, nor green ears, until the selfsame zi că voi au a adus an jertfă unto vostru Dumnezeu: [it shall fi] a decret veșnic în toate generațiile voastre in toți vostru dwellings.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וספרתם לכם ממחרת השבת מיום הבאכם את עמר התנופה שבע שבתות תמימות תהיינה
verses.english: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.romanian: și să count vouă din the morrow după the Șabat, din the zi că voi a adus the sheaf of the dar legănat; șapte șabaturi shall fi complete:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עד ממחרת השבת השביעית תספרו חמשים יום והקרבתם מנחה חדשה ליהוה
verses.english: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: Even unto the morrow după the seventh Șabat shall voi number cincizeci zile; și să a aduce a new dar de mâncare unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ממושבתיכם תביאו לחם תנופה שתים חלות שני עשרנים סלת תהינה חמץ תאפינה בכורים ליהוה
verses.english: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; [they are] the firstfruits unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: să a aduce out of vostru habitations doi wave loaves of doi tenth deals: ei să fi of făină fină; ei să fi baken cu leaven; [they sunt] the pârga unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבתם על הלחם שבעה כבשים תמימם בני שנה ופר בן בקר אחד ואילים שנים תמימם יהיו עלה ליהוה ומנחתם ונסכיהם אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams flawless: they shall be [for] a burnt offering unto the LORD, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, [even] an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și să a aduce cu the bread șapte miei fără cusur of the primul an, și unu young vițel, și doi berbeci flawless: ei să fi [căci] a ardere-de-tot unto DOMNUL, cu lor dar de mâncare, și lor drink jertfe, [even] an jertfă mistuită de foc, of aromă plăcută unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשיתם שעיר עזים אחד לחטאת ושני כבשים בני שנה לזבח השלמים
verses.english: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.romanian: atunci să jertfă unu kid of the țapi căci a jertfă de păcat, și doi miei of the primul an căci a jertfă of peace jertfe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והניף הכהן אתם על לחם הבכורים תנופה לפני יהוה על שני הכבשים קדש יהיו ליהוה לכהן
verses.english: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits [for] a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall wave ei cu the bread of the pârga [căci] a dar legănat înainte DOMNUL, cu the doi miei: ei să fi sfânt to DOMNUL căci the preot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקראתם בעצם היום הזה מקרא קדש יהיה לכם כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו חקות עולם בכל מושבתיכם לדרתיכם
verses.english: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, [that] it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work [therein: it shall be] a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.romanian: și să a proclama on the selfsame zi, [că] it poate fi an sfânt convocation vouă: să a face no servile lucrare [therein: it shall fi] a decret veșnic in toți vostru dwellings în toate generațiile voastre.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובקצירכם את קציר ארצכם לא תכלה פאת שדך לקצר ולקט קצירך לא תלקט לעני ולגר תעזב אתם אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: și când voi reap the seceriș of vostru țară, să nu a face curat riddance of the corners of tău câmp când tu reapest, neither shalt tu gather vreun gleaning of tău seceriș: să leave ei unto the sărac, și to the străin: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל לאמר בחדש השביעי באחד לחדש יהיה לכם שבתון זכרון תרועה מקרא קדש
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first [day] of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, saying, In the luna a șaptea, in the first [zi] of the lună, shall voi au a Șabat, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an sfânt convocation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו והקרבתם אשה ליהוה
verses.english: Ye shall do no servile work [therein]: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: să a face no servile lucrare [therein]: dar să a aduce an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך בעשור לחדש השביעי הזה יום כפורים הוא מקרא קדש יהיה לכם ועניתם את נפשתיכם והקרבתם אשה ליהוה
verses.english: Also on the tenth [day] of this seventh month [there shall be] a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: de asemenea on the tenth [zi] of this luna a șaptea [acolo shall fi] a zi of ispășire: it shall fi an sfânt convocation vouă; și să a mâhni vostru souls, și a aduce an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל מלאכה לא תעשו בעצם היום הזה כי יום כפורים הוא לכפר עליכם לפני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it [is] a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: și să a face no lucrare in că same zi: căci it [este] a zi of ispășire, to a face an ispășire pentru voi înainte DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי כל הנפש אשר לא תענה בעצם היום הזה ונכרתה מעמיה
verses.english: For whatsoever soul [it be] that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.romanian: căci whatsoever soul [it fi] că shall nu fi mâhnit in că same zi, el să fi a tăia off din în mijlocul lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הנפש אשר תעשה כל מלאכה בעצם היום הזה ואבדתי את הנפש ההיא מקרב עמיה
verses.english: And whatsoever soul [it be] that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.romanian: și whatsoever soul [it fi] că doeth vreun lucrare in că same zi, the same soul will I destroy din în mijlocul lui people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל מלאכה לא תעשו חקות עולם לדרתיכם בכל מושבתיכם
verses.english: And ye shall do no manner of work: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.romanian: și să a face no manner of lucrare: [it shall fi] a decret veșnic în toate generațiile voastre in toți vostru dwellings.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שבת שבתון הוא לכם ועניתם את נפשתיכם בתשעה לחדש בערב מערב עד ערב תשביתו שבתכם
verses.english: It [shall be] unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth [day] of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
verses.romanian: It [shall fi] vouă a Șabat of odihnă, și să a mâhni vostru souls: in the ninth [zi] of the lună at even, din even unto even, shall voi celebrate vostru Șabat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל לאמר בחמשה עשר יום לחדש השביעי הזה חג הסכות שבעת ימים ליהוה
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month [shall be] the feast of tabernacles [for] seven days unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, saying, The a cincisprezecea zi of this luna a șaptea [shall fi] the Sărbătoarea Corturilor [căci] șapte zile unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום הראישון מקרא קדש כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: On the first day [shall be] an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work [therein].
verses.romanian: On the prima zi [shall fi] an sfânt convocation: să a face no servile lucrare [therein].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שבעת ימים תקריבו אשה ליהוה וביום השמיני מקרא קדש יהיה לכם והקרבתם אשה ליהוה עצרת היא וכל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD: it [is] a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work [therein].
verses.romanian: șapte zile să a aduce an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL: on the eighth zi shall fi an sfânt convocation vouă; și să a aduce an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL: it [este] a adunare solemnă; și să a face no servile lucrare [therein].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה מועדי יהוה אשר תקראו אתם מקראי קדש להקריב אשה ליהוה עלה ומנחה זבח ונסכים דבר יום ביומו
verses.english: These [are] the feasts of the LORD, which ye shall proclaim [to be] holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the feasts of DOMNUL, care să a proclama [to fi] sfânt convocations, to a aduce an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL, a ardere-de-tot, și a dar de mâncare, a jertfă, și drink jertfe, fiecare thing upon lui zi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מלבד שבתות יהוה ומלבד כל מתנתיכם ומלבד כל נדריכם ומלבד כל נדבתיכם אשר תתנו ליהוה
verses.english: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD, and beside all your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: Beside the șabaturi of DOMNUL, și beside toți vostru gifts, și beside toți vostru vows, și beside toți vostru freewill jertfe, care voi a da unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך בחמשה עשר יום לחדש השביעי באספכם את תבואת הארץ תחגו את חג יהוה שבעת ימים ביום הראישון שבתון וביום השמיני שבתון
verses.english: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day [shall be] a sabbath, and on the eighth day [shall be] a sabbath.
verses.romanian: de asemenea in the a cincisprezecea zi of the luna a șaptea, când voi au gathered in the rod of the țară, să a păzi a feast unto DOMNUL șapte zile: on the prima zi [shall fi] a Șabat, și on the eighth zi [shall fi] a Șabat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחתם לכם ביום הראישון פרי עץ הדר כפות תמרים וענפי עץ עבות וערבי נחל ושמחתם לפני יהוה אלהיכם שבעת ימים
verses.english: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
verses.romanian: și să a lua voi on the prima zi the boughs of goodly copaci, branches of palm copaci, și the boughs of thick copaci, și willows of the brook; și să a se bucura înainte DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu șapte zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחגתם אתו חג ליהוה שבעת ימים בשנה חקות עולם לדרתיכם בחדש השביעי תחגו אתו
verses.english: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. [It shall be] a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.romanian: și să a păzi it a feast unto DOMNUL șapte zile in the an. [It shall fi] a decret veșnic in vostru generations: să celebrate it in the luna a șaptea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בסכות תשבו שבעת ימים כל האזרח בישראל ישב בסכות
verses.english: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
verses.romanian: să a locui in booths șapte zile; toți că sunt Israelites born shall a locui in booths:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למען ידעו דרתיכם כי בסכות הושבתי את בני ישראל בהוצאי אתם מארץ מצרים אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: că vostru generations poate a cunoaște că I a făcut the copii of Israel to a locui in booths, când I a adus ei out of the țară of Egypt: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה את מועדי יהוה אל בני ישראל
verses.english: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD.
verses.romanian: și Moise a declarat unto the copii of Israel the feasts of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צוי את בני ישראל ויקחו אליך שמן זית זך כתית למאור להעלות נר תמיד
verses.english: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
verses.romanian: a porunci the copii of Israel, că they a aduce ție pure oil olive beaten căci the light, to cause the lamps to a arde continually.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מחוץ לפרכת העדות באהל מועד יערך אתו אהרן ובניו מערב עד בקר לפני יהוה תמיד חקות עולם לדרתיכם
verses.english: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron and sons of him order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: [it shall be] a statute for ever in your generations.
verses.romanian: fără the văl of the mărturie, in Cortul Întâlnirii, shall Aaron și fii al lui order it din the evening unto the morning înainte DOMNUL continually: [it shall fi] a decret veșnic in vostru generations.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על המנורה הטהרה יעריך את הנרות לפני יהוה עד בקר
verses.english: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD until morning.
verses.romanian: el să order the lamps upon the pure candlestick înainte DOMNUL until morning.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחת סלת ואפית אתה שתים עשרה חלות שני עשרנים יהיה החלה האחת
verses.english: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
verses.romanian: și să a lua făină fină, și bake doisprezece turte thereof: doi tenth deals shall fi in unu cake.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמת אתם שתי מערכות שש המערכת על השלחן הטהור לפני יהוה
verses.english: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și să a așeza ei in doi rows, șase on a row, upon the pure table înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתה על המערכת לבונה זכה והיתה ללחם לאזכרה אשה ליהוה
verses.english: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon [each] row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, [even] an offering made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și să a pune pure tămâie upon [fiecare] row, că it poate fi on the bread căci a memorial, [even] an jertfă mistuită de foc unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום השבת ביום השבת יערכנו לפני יהוה תמיד מאת בני ישראל ברית עולם
verses.english: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, [being taken] from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.
verses.romanian: fiecare Șabat el să a așeza it in order înainte DOMNUL continually, [being luat] din the copii of Israel by an everlasting legământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה לאהרן ולבניו ואכלוה במקום קדוש כי קדש קדשים היא לו מאשי יהוה חק עולם
verses.english: And it shall be Aaron's and his sons'; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it [is] most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.
verses.romanian: și it shall fi Aaron's și lui fii'; și they să mănânce it in locul sfânt: căci it [este] preasfânt lui of the jertfe of DOMNUL a făcut by foc by a perpetual decret.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא בן אשה ישראלית והוא בן איש מצרי בתוך בני ישראל וינצו במחנה בן הישראלית ואיש ישראלי
verses.english: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father [was] an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish [woman] and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;
verses.romanian: și the fiu of an Israelitish femeie, al cărui tată [era] an Egyptian, a mers out în mijlocul the copii of Israel: și this fiu of the Israelitish [femeie] și a om of Israel strove together in the tabără;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקב בן האשה הישראלית את השם ויקלל ויביאו אתו אל משה ושם אמו שלומית בת דברי למטה דן
verses.english: And the Israelitish woman's son blasphemed the name [of the LORD], and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother's name [was] Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
verses.romanian: și the Israelitish femeie's fiu a hulit the name [of DOMNUL], și blestemat. și they a adus lui unto Moise: (și lui mamă's name [era] Shelomith, the fiică of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויניחהו במשמר לפרש להם על פי יהוה
verses.english: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.
verses.romanian: și they a pune lui in ward, că the mind of DOMNUL might fi shewed ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הוציא את המקלל אל מחוץ למחנה וסמכו כל השמעים את ידיהם על ראשו ורגמו אתו כל העדה
verses.english: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard [him] lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.romanian: a aduce forth lui că sunt blestemat fără the tabără; și let toți că a auzit [lui] lay lor hands upon lui cap, și let toți obștea piatră lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל בני ישראל תדבר לאמר איש איש כי יקלל אלהיו ונשא חטאו
verses.english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
verses.romanian: și să a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth lui Dumnezeu shall bear lui păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונקב שם יהוה מות יומת רגם ירגמו בו כל העדה כגר כאזרח בנקבו השם יומת
verses.english: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD, he shall surely be put to death, [and] all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name [of the LORD], shall be put to death.
verses.romanian: și he că blasphemeth the name of DOMNUL, el să negresit fi a pune to death, [și] toți obștea shall certainly piatră lui: as well the străin, as he că este born in the țară, când he blasphemeth the name [of DOMNUL], shall fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי יכה כל נפש אדם מות יומת
verses.english: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.romanian: și he că killeth vreun om shall negresit fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומכה נפש בהמה ישלמנה נפש תחת נפש
verses.english: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.romanian: și he că killeth a beast shall a face it good; beast căci beast.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי יתן מום בעמיתו כאשר עשה כן יעשה לו
verses.english: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.romanian: și dacă a om cause a cusur in lui neighbour; as he sunt done, so shall it fi done to lui;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שבר תחת שבר עין תחת עין שן תחת שן כאשר יתן מום באדם כן ינתן בו
verses.english: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him [again].
verses.romanian: Breach căci breach, eye căci eye, tooth căci tooth: as he sunt caused a cusur in a om, so shall it fi done to lui [again].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומכה בהמה ישלמנה ומכה אדם יומת
verses.english: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.romanian: și he că killeth a beast, el să a reface it: și he că killeth a om, el să fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: משפט אחד יהיה לכם כגר כאזרח יהיה כי אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: să au unu manner of lege, as well căci the străin, as căci unu of vostru own country: căci I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל בני ישראל ויוציאו את המקלל אל מחוץ למחנה וירגמו אתו אבן ובני ישראל עשו כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Moise a vorbit to the copii of Israel, că they should a aduce forth lui că had blestemat out of the tabără, și piatră lui cu pietre. și the copii of Israel a făcut as DOMNUL a poruncit Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה בהר סיני לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise in mount Sinai, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם כי תבאו אל הארץ אשר אני נתן לכם ושבתה הארץ שבת ליהוה
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, când voi a veni into the țară care I a da voi, atunci shall the țară a păzi a Șabat unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שש שנים תזרע שדך ושש שנים תזמר כרמך ואספת את תבואתה
verses.english: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
verses.romanian: șase ani să sow tău câmp, și șase ani să prune tău vineyard, și gather in the rod thereof;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשנה השביעית שבת שבתון יהיה לארץ שבת ליהוה שדך לא תזרע וכרמך לא תזמר
verses.english: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
verses.romanian: dar in the al șaptelea an shall fi a Șabat of odihnă unto the țară, a Șabat căci DOMNUL: să neither sow tău câmp, nor prune tău vineyard.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת ספחי קציריך לא תקצר ואת ענבי נזיריך לא תבצר שנת שבתון יהיה לארץ
verses.english: And that which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: [for] it is a year of rest unto the land.
verses.romanian: și că care groweth of its own accord of tău seceriș să nu reap, neither gather the grapes of tău viță undressed: [căci] it este a an of odihnă unto the țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה שבת הארץ לכם לאכלה לך ולעבדיך ולאמתיך ולשכיריך ולתושביך הגרים עמך
verses.english: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee
verses.romanian: și the Șabat of the țară shall fi carne pentru voi; pentru tine, și căci tău slujitor, și căci tău maid, și căci tău hired slujitor, și căci tău străin că sojourneth cu tine

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולבהמתך ולחיה אשר בארצך תהיה כל תבואתה לאכל
verses.english: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that [are] in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
verses.romanian: și căci tău cattle, și căci the beast că [sunt] in tău țară, shall toți the rod thereof fi carne.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וספרת לך שבע שבתות שנים שבע שנים שבע פעמים והיו לך ימי שבע שבתות השנים תשע וארבעים שנה
verses.english: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.
verses.romanian: și să number șapte șabaturi of ani ție, de șapte ori șapte ani; și the space of the șapte șabaturi of ani shall fi ție patruzeci și nouă ani.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעברת שופר תרועה בחדש השביעי בעשור לחדש ביום הכפורים תעבירו שופר בכל ארצכם
verses.english: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth [day] of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
verses.romanian: atunci shalt tu cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth [zi] of the luna a șaptea, in the zi of ispășire shall voi a face the trumpet sound throughout toți vostru țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקדשתם את שנת החמשים שנה וקראתם דרור בארץ לכל ישביה יובל הוא תהיה לכם ושבתם איש אל אחזתו ואיש אל משפחתו תשובו
verses.english: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout [all] the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.
verses.romanian: și să hallow the al cincizecilea an, și a proclama libertate throughout [toți] the țară unto toți the inhabitants thereof: it shall fi a jubile vouă; și să a se întoarce fiecare om unto lui stăpânire, și să a se întoarce fiecare om unto lui family.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יובל הוא שנת החמשים שנה תהיה לכם לא תזרעו ולא תקצרו את ספחיה ולא תבצרו את נזיריה
verses.english: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather [the grapes] in it of thy vine undressed.
verses.romanian: A jubile shall că al cincizecilea an fi vouă: să nu sow, neither reap că care groweth of itself in it, nor gather [the grapes] in it of tău viță undressed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי יובל הוא קדש תהיה לכם מן השדה תאכלו את תבואתה
verses.english: For it [is] the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.romanian: căci it [este] the jubile; it shall fi sfânt vouă: voi să mănânce the rod thereof out of the câmp.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בשנת היובל הזאת תשובו איש אל אחזתו
verses.english: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.romanian: In the an of this jubile să a se întoarce fiecare om unto lui stăpânire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תמכר ממכר לעמיתך או קנה מיד עמיתך אל תונו איש את אחיו
verses.english: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest [ought] of thy neighbour's hand, ye shall not oppress one another:
verses.romanian: și dacă tu a vinde ought unto tău neighbour, sau buyest [ought] of tău neighbour's hand, să nu a asupri unu another:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: במספר שנים אחר היובל תקנה מאת עמיתך במספר שני תבואת ימכר לך
verses.english: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, [and] according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:
verses.romanian: după the number of ani după the jubile să a cumpăra of tău neighbour, [și] according unto the number of ani of the roade el să a vinde ție:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לפי רב השנים תרבה מקנתו ולפי מעט השנים תמעיט מקנתו כי מספר תבואת הוא מכר לך
verses.english: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for [according] to the number [of the years] of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.
verses.romanian: după the multitude of ani să rod the preț thereof, și după the fewness of ani să diminish the preț of it: căci [according] to the number [of the ani] of the roade doth he a vinde ție.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תונו איש את עמיתו ויראת מאלהיך כי אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: să nu de aceea a asupri unu another; dar să a se teme tău Dumnezeu: căci I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשיתם את חקותי ואת משפטי תשמרו ועשיתם אתם וישבתם על הארץ לבטח
verses.english: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.romanian: de aceea să a face meu decrete, și a păzi meu judecăți, și a face ei; și să a locui in the țară in safety.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנה הארץ פריה ואכלתם לשבע וישבתם לבטח עליה
verses.english: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.romanian: și the țară shall yield ei rod, și voi să mănânce vostru fill, și a locui therein in safety.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תאמרו מה נאכל בשנה השביעית הן לא נזרע ולא נאסף את תבואתינו
verses.english: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
verses.romanian: și dacă să a spune, ce shall we eat the al șaptelea an? iată, vom nu sow, nor gather in nostru rod:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצויתי את ברכתי לכם בשנה הששית ועשתה את תבואתה לשלש השנים
verses.english: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
verses.romanian: atunci voi a porunci meu binecuvântare upon voi in the al șaselea an, și it shall a aduce forth rod căci trei ani.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזרעתם את השנה השמינית ואכלתם מן התבואתה ישן עד השנה התשעית עד בא תבואתה תאכלו ישן
verses.english: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat [yet] of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat [of] the old [store].
verses.romanian: și să sow the eighth an, și eat [yet] of old rod until the ninth an; until ei roade a veni in voi să mănânce [of] the old [store].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והארץ לא תמכר לצמיתת כי לי הארץ כי גרים ותושבים אתם עמדי
verses.english: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land [is] mine; for ye [are] strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.romanian: The țară shall nu fi vândut veșnic: căci the țară [este] mine; căci voi [sunt] străini și străini care locuiesc cu mine.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובכל ארץ אחזתכם גאלה תתנו לארץ
verses.english: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.romanian: și in toți the țară of vostru stăpânire să grant a redemption căci the țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי ימך אחיך ומכר מאחזתו ובא גאלו הקרוב אליו וגאל את ממכר אחיו
verses.english: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away [some] of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
verses.romanian: și dacă tău frate fi waxen sărac, și sunt vândut away [some] of lui stăpânire, și dacă vreun of lui rudă a veni to a răscumpăra it, atunci shall he a răscumpăra că care lui frate vândut.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי לא יהיה לו גאל והשיגה ידו ומצא כדי גאלתו
verses.english: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
verses.romanian: și dacă the om au niciun to a răscumpăra it, și himself fi able to a răscumpăra it;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחשב את שני ממכרו והשיב את העדף לאיש אשר מכר לו ושב לאחזתו
verses.english: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
verses.romanian: atunci let lui count the ani of the sale thereof, și a reface the overplus unto the om to pe care he vândut it; că he poate a se întoarce unto lui stăpânire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא מצא ידו די השיב לו והיה ממכרו ביד הקנה אתו עד שנת היובל ויצא ביובל ושב לאחזתו
verses.english: But if he be not able to restore [it] to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.romanian: dar dacă he fi nu able to a reface [it] to lui, atunci că care este vândut shall remain in the hand al lui că sunt a cumpărat it until the an of jubile: și in the jubile it shall a merge out, și el să a se întoarce unto lui stăpânire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי ימכר בית מושב עיר חומה והיתה גאלתו עד תם שנת ממכרו ימים תהיה גאלתו
verses.english: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; [within] a full year may he redeem it.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om a vinde a dwelling casă in a walled city, atunci he poate a răscumpăra it în a whole an după it este vândut; [în] a full an poate he a răscumpăra it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא יגאל עד מלאת לו שנה תמימה וקם הבית אשר בעיר אשר לו חומה לצמיתת לקנה אתו לדרתיו לא יצא ביובל
