verses.english: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that [is] in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
verses.romanian: și dacă it fi nu răscumpărat în the space of a full an, atunci the casă că [este] in the walled city shall fi established veșnic to lui că a cumpărat it în toate generațiile lui: it shall nu a merge out in the jubile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובתי החצרים אשר אין להם חומה סביב על שדה הארץ יחשבו גאלה תהיה לו וביובל יצא
verses.english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
verses.romanian: dar the case of the villages care au no zid round about ei shall fi counted as the câmpuri of the country: they poate fi răscumpărat, și ei să a merge out in the jubile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וערי הלוים בתי ערי אחזתם גאלת עולם תהיה ללוים
verses.english: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, [and] the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.romanian: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, [și] the case of the cities of lor stăpânire, poate the Levites a răscumpăra at vreun time.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשר יגאל מן הלוים ויצא ממכר בית ועיר אחזתו ביובל כי בתי ערי הלוים היא אחזתם בתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in [the year of] jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites [are] their possession among the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om purchase of the Levites, atunci the casă că era vândut, și the city of lui stăpânire, shall a merge out in [the an of] jubile: căci the case of the cities of the Levites [sunt] lor stăpânire în mijlocul the copii of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושדה מגרש עריהם לא ימכרו כי אחזת עולם היא להם
verses.english: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it [is] their perpetual possession.
verses.romanian: dar the câmp of the suburbs of lor cities poate nu fi vândut; căci it [este] lor perpetual stăpânire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי ימך אחיך ומטה ידו עמך וחזקת בו גר ותושב וחי אחיך עמך
verses.english: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve brother of you: [yea, though he be] a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.
verses.romanian: și dacă tău frate fi waxen sărac, și fallen in decay cu tine; atunci să relieve frate al vostru: [yea, though he fi] a străin, sau a străin care locuiește; că he poate live cu tine.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תקח מאתו נשך ותרבית ויראת מאלהיך וחי אחיך עמך
verses.english: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.
verses.romanian: a lua tu no usury al lui, sau rod: dar a se teme tău Dumnezeu; că tău frate poate live cu tine.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את כספך לא תתן לו בנשך ובתרבית לא תתן אכלך
verses.english: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.
verses.romanian: să nu a da lui tău money upon usury, nor a împrumuta lui tău victuals căci rod.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אני יהוה אלהיכם אשר הוצאתי אתכם מארץ מצרים לתת לכם את ארץ כנען להיות לכם לאלהים
verses.english: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, [and] to be your God.
verses.romanian: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu, care a adus voi forth out of the țară of Egypt, to a da voi the țară of Canaan, [și] to fi vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי ימך אחיך עמך ונמכר לך לא תעבד בו עבדת עבד
verses.english: And if thy brother [that dwelleth] by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
verses.romanian: și dacă tău frate [că dwelleth] de tine fi waxen sărac, și fi vândut ție; să nu compel lui to a sluji as a bondservant:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כשכיר כתושב יהיה עמך עד שנת היובל יעבד עמך
verses.english: [But] as an hired servant, [and] as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, [and] shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:
verses.romanian: [dar] as an hired slujitor, [și] as a străin care locuiește, el să fi cu tine, [și] shall a sluji te unto the an of jubile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא מעמך הוא ובניו עמו ושב אל משפחתו ואל אחזת אבתיו ישוב
verses.english: And [then] shall he depart from thee, [both] he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.romanian: și [atunci] shall he a pleca de la tine, [both] he și lui copii cu el, și shall a se întoarce unto lui own family, și unto the stăpânire of lui fathers shall he a se întoarce.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי עבדיהם אשר הוצאתי אתם מארץ מצרים לא ימכרו ממכרת עבד
verses.english: For they [are] my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.romanian: căci they [sunt] meu slujitori, care I a adus forth out of the țară of Egypt: ei să nu fi vândut as bondmen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תרדה בו בפרך ויראת מאלהיך
verses.english: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.
verses.romanian: să nu rule peste lui cu rigour; dar shalt a se teme tău Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבדיך ואמתיך אשר יהיו לך מאת הגוים אשר סביבתיכם מהם תקנהו עבד ואמה
verses.english: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, [shall be] of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.romanian: Both tău bondmen, și tău bondmaids, care să au, [shall fi] of the heathen că sunt round about voi; al lor shall voi a cumpăra bondmen și bondmaids.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וגם מבני התושבים הגרים עמכם מהם תקנהו וממשפחתם אשר עמכם אשר הולדו בארצכם והיו לכם לאחזה
verses.english: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that [are] with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.romanian: Moreover of the copii of the străini că a face sojourn în mijlocul voi, al lor shall voi a cumpăra, și of lor families că [sunt] cu voi, care they begat in vostru țară: și ei să fi vostru stăpânire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והתנחלתם אתם לבניכם אחריכם לרשת אחזה לעולם בהם תעבידו ובאחיכם בני ישראל איש באחיו לא תרדה בו בפרך
verses.english: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit [them for] a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.
verses.romanian: și să a lua ei as an moștenire căci vostru copii după voi, to a moșteni [ei căci] a stăpânire; ei să fi vostru bondmen veșnic: dar peste vostru brethren the copii of Israel, să nu rule unu peste another cu rigour.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תשיג יד גר ותושב עמך ומך אחיך עמו ונמכר לגר ותושב עמך או לעקר משפחת גר
verses.english: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother [that dwelleth] by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger [or] and unto the sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger's family:
verses.romanian: și dacă a străin care locuiește sau străin wax rich de tine, și tău frate [că dwelleth] de el wax sărac, și a vinde himself unto the străin [sau] și unto the străin care locuiește de tine, sau to the stock of the străin's family:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אחרי נמכר גאלה תהיה לו אחד מאחיו יגאלנו
verses.english: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
verses.romanian: după că he este vândut he poate fi răscumpărat again; unu of lui brethren poate a răscumpăra lui:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או דדו או בן דדו יגאלנו או משאר בשרו ממשפחתו יגאלנו או השיגה ידו ונגאל
verses.english: Either his uncle, or his uncle's son, may redeem him, or [any] that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
verses.romanian: Either lui unchi, sau lui unchi's fiu, poate a răscumpăra lui, sau [vreun] că este nigh of rudă lui of lui family poate a răscumpăra lui; sau dacă he fi able, he poate a răscumpăra himself.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחשב עם קנהו משנת המכר לו עד שנת היובל והיה כסף ממכרו במספר שנים כימי שכיר יהיה עמו
verses.english: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
verses.romanian: și el să reckon cu el că a cumpărat lui din the an că he era vândut to lui unto the an of jubile: și the preț of lui sale shall fi according unto the number of ani, după the time of an hired slujitor shall it fi cu el.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם עוד רבות בשנים לפיהן ישיב גאלתו מכסף מקנתו
verses.english: If [there be] yet many years [behind], according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.romanian: dacă [acolo fi] yet many ani [behind], according lor el să a da again the preț of lui redemption out of the money că he era a cumpărat căci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מעט נשאר בשנים עד שנת היובל וחשב לו כפי שניו ישיב את גאלתו
verses.english: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, [and] according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
verses.romanian: și dacă acolo remain dar few ani unto the an of jubile, atunci el să count cu el, [și] according unto lui ani shall he a da lui again the preț of lui redemption.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כשכיר שנה בשנה יהיה עמו לא ירדנו בפרך לעיניך
verses.english: [And] as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: [and the other] shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
verses.romanian: [și] as a yearly hired slujitor shall he fi cu el: [și the other] shall nu rule cu rigour peste lui in tău sight.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא יגאל באלה ויצא בשנת היובל הוא ובניו עמו
verses.english: And if he be not redeemed in these [years], then he shall go out in the year of jubile, [both] he, and his children with him.
verses.romanian: și dacă he fi nu răscumpărat in these [ani], atunci el să a merge out in the an of jubile, [both] he, și lui copii cu el.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לי בני ישראל עבדים עבדי הם אשר הוצאתי אתם מארץ מצרים אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: For unto me the children of Israel [are] servants; they [are] my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: căci mie the copii of Israel [sunt] slujitori; they [sunt] meu slujitori pe care I a adus forth out of the țară of Egypt: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא תעשו לכם אלילים ופסל ומצבה לא תקימו לכם ואבן משכית לא תתנו בארצכם להשתחות עליה כי אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up [any] image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: să a face voi no idols nor graven image, neither rear voi up a standing image, neither shall voi a așeza up [vreun] image of piatră in vostru țară, to bow down unto it: căci I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את שבתתי תשמרו ומקדשי תיראו אני יהוה
verses.english: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: să a păzi meu șabaturi, și reverence meu sanctuary: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם בחקותי תלכו ואת מצותי תשמרו ועשיתם אתם
verses.english: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.romanian: dacă voi a umbla in meu decrete, și a păzi meu porunci, și a face ei;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתי גשמיכם בעתם ונתנה הארץ יבולה ועץ השדה יתן פריו
verses.english: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.romanian: atunci voi a da voi rain in due season, și the țară shall yield ei rod, și the copaci of the câmp shall yield lor rod.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשיג לכם דיש את בצר ובציר ישיג את הזרע ואכלתם לחמכם לשבע וישבתם לבטח בארצכם
verses.english: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.romanian: și vostru threshing shall reach unto the vintage, și the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: și voi să mănânce vostru bread to the full, și a locui in vostru țară safely.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתי שלום בארץ ושכבתם ואין מחריד והשבתי חיה רעה מן הארץ וחרב לא תעבר בארצכם
verses.english: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make [you] afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.romanian: și voi a da peace in the țară, și să minciună down, și niciun shall a face [voi] afraid: și voi rid evil beasts out of the țară, neither shall the sword a merge prin vostru țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ורדפתם את איביכם ונפלו לפניכם לחרב
verses.english: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.romanian: și să chase vostru enemies, și ei să fall înainte voi by the sword.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ורדפו מכם חמשה מאה ומאה מכם רבבה ירדפו ונפלו איביכם לפניכם לחרב
verses.english: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.romanian: și cinci al vostru shall chase an sută, și an sută al vostru shall a pune zece mie to flight: și vostru enemies shall fall înainte voi by the sword.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופניתי אליכם והפריתי אתכם והרביתי אתכם והקמתי את בריתי אתכם
verses.english: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
verses.romanian: căci voi au respect vouă, și a face voi fruitful, și multiply voi, și establish meu legământ cu voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלתם ישן נושן וישן מפני חדש תוציאו
verses.english: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.romanian: și voi să mănânce old store, și a aduce forth the old pentru că of the new.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתי משכני בתוככם ולא תגעל נפשי אתכם
verses.english: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.romanian: și voi a așeza meu tabernacle în mijlocul voi: și meu soul shall nu abhor voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והתהלכתי בתוככם והייתי לכם לאלהים ואתם תהיו לי לעם
verses.english: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.
verses.romanian: și voi a umbla în mijlocul voi, și va fi vostru Dumnezeu, și să fi meu people.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אני יהוה אלהיכם אשר הוצאתי אתכם מארץ מצרים מהיות להם עבדים ואשברה מטות עולכם ואוליך אתכם קוממית
verses.english: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.romanian: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu, care a adus voi forth out of the țară of Egypt, că voi should nu fi lor bondmen; și I au broken the bands of vostru yoke, și a făcut voi a merge upright.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא תשמעו לי ולא תעשו את כל המצות האלה
verses.english: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.romanian: dar dacă voi will nu hearken mie, și will nu a face toți these porunci;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם בחקותי תמאסו ואם את משפטי תגעל נפשכם לבלתי עשות את כל מצותי להפרכם את בריתי
verses.english: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, [but] that ye break my covenant:
verses.romanian: și dacă să despise meu decrete, sau dacă vostru soul abhor meu judecăți, so că voi will nu a face toți meu porunci, [dar] că voi break meu legământ:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אף אני אעשה זאת לכם והפקדתי עליכם בחלה את השחפת ואת הקדחת מכלות עינים ומדיבת נפש וזרעתם לריק זרעכם ואכלהו איביכם
verses.english: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.romanian: I de asemenea will a face this vouă; voi even appoint peste voi terror, consumption, și the burning ague, că shall consume the eyes, și cause sorrow of heart: și să sow vostru sămânță in vain, căci vostru enemies să mănânce it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתי פני בכם ונגפתם לפני איביכם ורדו בכם שנאיכם ונסתם ואין רדף אתכם
verses.english: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.romanian: și voi a așeza meu face împotriva voi, și să fi înjunghiat înainte vostru enemies: they că hate să reign peste voi; și să flee când niciun pursueth voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם עד אלה לא תשמעו לי ויספתי ליסרה אתכם שבע על חטאתיכם
verses.english: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.romanian: și dacă voi will nu yet căci toți this hearken mie, atunci voi punish voi de șapte ori more căci vostru păcate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושברתי את גאון עזכם ונתתי את שמיכם כברזל ואת ארצכם כנחשה
verses.english: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
verses.romanian: și voi break the pride of vostru power; și voi a face vostru cer as fier, și vostru pământ as brass:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותם לריק כחכם ולא תתן ארצכם את יבולה ועץ השדה לא יתן פריו
verses.english: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the field yield their fruits.
verses.romanian: și vostru strength shall fi spent in vain: căci vostru țară shall nu yield ei rod, neither shall the copaci of the câmp yield lor roade.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם תלכו עמי קרי ולא תבאו לשמע לי ויספתי עליכם מכה שבע כחטאתיכם
verses.english: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.romanian: și dacă voi a umbla contrary mie, și will nu hearken mie; voi a aduce de șapte ori more plagues upon voi după vostru păcate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושלחתי בכם את חית השדה ושכלה אתכם והכריתה את בהמתכם והמעיטה אתכם ונשמו דרככם
verses.english: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your [high] ways shall be desolate.
verses.romanian: voi de asemenea send wild beasts în mijlocul voi, care shall rob voi of vostru copii, și destroy vostru cattle, și a face voi few in number; și vostru [high] căi shall fi desolate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם באלה לא תוסרו לי והלכתם עמי קרי
verses.english: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.romanian: și dacă voi will nu fi reformed by mine by these things, dar will a umbla contrary mie;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והלכתי גם אני עמכם בקרי והכיתי אתכם גם אני שבע על חטאתיכם
verses.english: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.romanian: atunci will I de asemenea a umbla contrary vouă, și will punish voi yet de șapte ori căci vostru păcate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבאתי עליכם חרב נקמת נקם ברית ונאספתם אל עריכם ושלחתי דבר בתוככם ונתתם ביד אויב
verses.english: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of [my] covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.romanian: și voi a aduce a sword upon voi, că shall avenge the quarrel of [meu] legământ: și când voi sunt gathered together în vostru cities, voi send the pestilence în mijlocul voi; și să fi delivered into the hand of the enemy.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בשברי לכם מטה לחם ואפו עשר נשים לחמכם בתנור אחד והשיב לחמכם במשקול ואכלתם ולא תשבעו
verses.english: [And] when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver [you] your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.romanian: [și] când I au broken the staff of vostru bread, zece femei shall bake vostru bread in unu oven, și ei să deliver [voi] vostru bread again by weight: și voi să mănânce, și nu fi satisfied.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בזאת לא תשמעו לי והלכתם עמי קרי
verses.english: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.romanian: și dacă voi will nu căci toți this hearken mie, dar a umbla contrary mie;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והלכתי עמכם בחמת קרי ויסרתי אתכם אף אני שבע על חטאתיכם
verses.english: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.romanian: atunci voi a umbla contrary vouă de asemenea in fury; și I, even I, will chastise voi de șapte ori căci vostru păcate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלתם בשר בניכם ובשר בנתיכם תאכלו
verses.english: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.
verses.romanian: și voi să mănânce the flesh of vostru fii, și the flesh of vostru fiice shall voi eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשמדתי את במתיכם והכרתי את חמניכם ונתתי את פגריכם על פגרי גלוליכם וגעלה נפשי אתכם
verses.english: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.romanian: și voi destroy vostru high locuri, și a tăia down vostru images, și cast vostru carcases upon the carcases of vostru idols, și meu soul shall abhor voi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתי את עריכם חרבה והשמתי את מקדשכם ולא אריח בריח ניחחכם
verses.english: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.romanian: și voi a face vostru cities waste, și a aduce vostru sanctuaries unto desolation, și voi nu smell the savour of vostru sweet odours.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשמתי אני את הארץ ושממו עליה איביכם הישבים בה
verses.english: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.romanian: și voi a aduce the țară into desolation: și vostru enemies care a locui therein shall fi astonished at it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתכם אזרה בגוים והרקתי אחריכם חרב והיתה ארצכם שממה ועריכם יהיו חרבה
verses.english: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
verses.romanian: și voi scatter voi în mijlocul the heathen, și will draw out a sword după voi: și vostru țară shall fi desolate, și vostru cities waste.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אז תרצה הארץ את שבתתיה כל ימי אשמה ואתם בארץ איביכם אז תשבת הארץ והרצתה את שבתתיה
verses.english: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye [be] in your enemies' land; [even] then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
verses.romanian: atunci shall the țară enjoy ei șabaturi, as long as it lieth desolate, și voi [fi] in vostru enemies' țară; [even] atunci shall the țară odihnă, și enjoy ei șabaturi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ימי אשמה תשבת את אשר לא שבתה בשבתתיכם בשבתכם עליה
verses.english: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.
verses.romanian: As long as it lieth desolate it shall odihnă; pentru că it a făcut nu odihnă in vostru șabaturi, când voi a locuit upon it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנשארים בכם והבאתי מרך בלבבם בארצות איביהם ורדף אתם קול עלי נדף ונסו מנוסת חרב ונפלו ואין רדף
verses.english: And upon them that are left [alive] of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.romanian: și upon ei că sunt left [alive] al vostru voi send a faintness into lor hearts in the lands of lor enemies; și the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase ei; și ei să flee, as fleeing din a sword; și ei să fall când niciun pursueth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכשלו איש באחיו כמפני חרב ורדף אין ולא תהיה לכם תקומה לפני איביכם
verses.english: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.romanian: și ei să fall unu upon another, as it erau înainte a sword, când niciun pursueth: și să au no power to stand înainte vostru enemies.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואבדתם בגוים ואכלה אתכם ארץ איביכם
verses.english: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.romanian: și să perish în mijlocul the heathen, și the țară of vostru enemies să mănânce voi up.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנשארים בכם ימקו בעונם בארצות איביהם ואף בעונות אבותם אתם ימקו
verses.english: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies' lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.romanian: și they că sunt left al vostru shall pine away in lor nelegiuire in vostru enemies' lands; și de asemenea in the nelegiuiri of lor fathers shall they pine away cu ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והתודו את עונם ואת עון אבותם במעלם אשר מעלו בי ואף אשר הלכו עמי בקרי
verses.english: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
verses.romanian: dacă ei să confess lor nelegiuire, și the nelegiuire of lor fathers, cu lor trespass care they trespassed împotriva mine, și că de asemenea they au a umblat contrary mie;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אף אני הלך עמם בקרי והבאתי אתם בארץ איביהם או אז יכנע לבבם הערל ואז ירצו את עונם
verses.english: And [that] I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
verses.romanian: și [că] I de asemenea au a umblat contrary lor, și au a adus ei into the țară of lor enemies; dacă atunci lor uncircumcised hearts fi smerit, și they atunci accept of the punishment of lor nelegiuire:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזכרתי את בריתי יעקב ואף את בריתי יצחק ואף את בריתי אברהם אזכר והארץ אזכר
verses.english: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.romanian: atunci will I a-și aduce aminte meu legământ cu Jacob, și de asemenea meu legământ cu Isaac, și de asemenea meu legământ cu Abraham will I a-și aduce aminte; și voi a-și aduce aminte the țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והארץ תעזב מהם והרצתה את שבתתיה באשמה מהם והם ירצו את עונם יען ביען במשפטי מאסו ואת חקותי געלה נפשם
verses.english: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.romanian: The țară de asemenea shall fi left al lor, și shall enjoy ei șabaturi, în timp ce she lieth desolate fără ei: și ei să accept of the punishment of lor nelegiuire: pentru că, even pentru că they despised meu judecăți, și pentru că lor soul abhorred meu decrete.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואף גם זאת בהיותם בארצות איביהם לא מאסתים ולא געלתים לכלותם להפר בריתי אתם כי אני יהוה אלהיהם
verses.english: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I [am] the LORD their God.
verses.romanian: și yet căci toți că, când they fi in the țară of lor enemies, voi nu cast ei away, neither will I abhor ei, to destroy ei utterly, și to break meu legământ cu ei: căci I [am] DOMNUL lor Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזכרתי להם ברית ראישונים אשר הוצאתי אתם מארץ מצרים לעיני הגוים להיות להם לאלהים אני יהוה
verses.english: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: dar voi căci lor sakes a-și aduce aminte the legământ of lor ancestors, pe care I a adus forth out of the țară of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, că I might fi lor Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה החקים והמשפטים והתורות אשר נתן יהוה בינו ובין בני ישראל בהר סיני ביד משה
verses.english: These [are] the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the decrete și judecăți și legi, care DOMNUL a făcut between lui și the copii of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a vorbit unto Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם איש כי יפלא נדר בערכך נפשות ליהוה
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons [shall be] for the LORD by thy estimation.
verses.romanian: a vorbi unto the copii of Israel, și a spune lor, când a om shall a face a singular vow, the persons [shall fi] căci DOMNUL by tău estimation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה ערכך הזכר מבן עשרים שנה ועד בן ששים שנה והיה ערכך חמשים שקל כסף בשקל הקדש
verses.english: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.romanian: și tău estimation shall fi of the mascul din douăzeci ani old even unto șaizeci ani old, even tău estimation shall fi cincizeci shekels of argint, după the shekel of Sanctuarul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם נקבה היא והיה ערכך שלשים שקל
verses.english: And if it [be] a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.romanian: și dacă it [fi] a femelă, atunci tău estimation shall fi treizeci shekels.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מבן חמש שנים ועד בן עשרים שנה והיה ערכך הזכר עשרים שקלים ולנקבה עשרת שקלים
verses.english: And if [it be] from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.romanian: și dacă [it fi] din cinci ani old even unto douăzeci ani old, atunci tău estimation shall fi of the mascul douăzeci shekels, și căci the femelă zece shekels.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מבן חדש ועד בן חמש שנים והיה ערכך הזכר חמשה שקלים כסף ולנקבה ערכך שלשת שקלים כסף
verses.english: And if [it be] from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation [shall be] three shekels of silver.
verses.romanian: și dacă [it fi] din a lună old even unto cinci ani old, atunci tău estimation shall fi of the mascul cinci shekels of argint, și căci the femelă tău estimation [shall fi] trei shekels of argint.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מבן ששים שנה ומעלה אם זכר והיה ערכך חמשה עשר שקל ולנקבה עשרת שקלים
verses.english: And if [it be] from sixty years old and above; if [it be] a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.romanian: și dacă [it fi] din șaizeci ani old și deasupra; dacă [it fi] a mascul, atunci tău estimation shall fi fifteen shekels, și căci the femelă zece shekels.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם מך הוא מערכך והעמידו לפני הכהן והעריך אתו הכהן על פי אשר תשיג יד הנדר יעריכנו הכהן
verses.english: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.romanian: dar dacă he fi poorer than tău estimation, atunci el să present himself înainte the preot, și the preot shall valoare lui; după lui ability că vowed shall the preot valoare lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בהמה אשר יקריב ממנה קרבן ליהוה כל אשר יתן ממנו ליהוה יהיה קדש
verses.english: And if [it be] a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD, all that [any man] giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.
verses.romanian: și dacă [it fi] a beast, whereof oameni a aduce an jertfă unto DOMNUL, toți că [vreun om] giveth of such unto DOMNUL shall fi sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יחלפנו ולא ימיר אתו טוב ברע או רע בטוב ואם המר ימיר בהמה בבהמה והיה הוא ותמירתו יהיה קדש
verses.english: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.romanian: el să nu alter it, nor change it, a good căci a bad, sau a bad căci a good: și dacă el să at toți change beast căci beast, atunci it și the exchange thereof shall fi sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם כל בהמה טמאה אשר לא יקריב ממנה קרבן ליהוה והעמיד את הבהמה לפני הכהן
verses.english: And if [it be] any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD, then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.romanian: și dacă [it fi] vreun necurat beast, of care they a face nu a aduce a jertfă unto DOMNUL, atunci el să present the beast înainte the preot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעריך הכהן אתו בין טוב ובין רע כערכך הכהן כן יהיה
verses.english: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, [who art] the priest, so shall it be.
verses.romanian: și the preot shall valoare it, whether it fi good sau bad: as tu valuest it, [care art] the preot, so shall it fi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם גאל יגאלנו ויסף חמישתו על ערכך
verses.english: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth [part] thereof unto thy estimation.
verses.romanian: dar dacă he will at toți a răscumpăra it, atunci el să add a fifth [part] thereof unto tău estimation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש כי יקדיש את ביתו קדש ליהוה והעריכו הכהן בין טוב ובין רע כאשר יעריך אתו הכהן כן יקום
verses.english: And when a man shall sanctify his house [to be] holy unto the LORD, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.romanian: și când a om shall a sfinți lui casă [to fi] sfânt unto DOMNUL, atunci the preot shall estimate it, whether it fi good sau bad: as the preot shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם המקדיש יגאל את ביתו ויסף חמישת כסף ערכך עליו והיה לו
verses.english: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth [part] of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.
verses.romanian: și dacă he că sfințit it will a răscumpăra lui casă, atunci el să add the fifth [part] of the money of tău estimation unto it, și it shall fi lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם משדה אחזתו יקדיש איש ליהוה והיה ערכך לפי זרעו זרע חמר שערים בחמשים שקל כסף
verses.english: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD [some part] of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed [shall be valued] at fifty shekels of silver.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om shall a sfinți unto DOMNUL [some part] of a câmp of lui stăpânire, atunci tău estimation shall fi după the sămânță thereof: an homer of orz sămânță [shall fi valued] at cincizeci shekels of argint.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם משנת היובל יקדיש שדהו כערכך יקום
verses.english: And if he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.
verses.romanian: și dacă he a sfinți lui câmp din the an of jubile, după tău estimation it shall stand.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם אחר היובל יקדיש שדהו וחשב לו הכהן את הכסף על פי השנים הנותרת עד שנת היובל ונגרע מערכך
verses.english: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.
verses.romanian: dar dacă he a sfinți lui câmp după the jubile, atunci the preot shall reckon lui the money după the ani că remain, even unto the an of the jubile, și it shall fi abated din tău estimation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם גאל יגאל את השדה המקדיש אתו ויסף חמישת כסף ערכך עליו וקם לו
verses.english: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth [part] of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.
verses.romanian: și dacă he că sfințit the câmp will in vreun wise a răscumpăra it, atunci el să add the fifth [part] of the money of tău estimation unto it, și it shall fi assured to lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא יגאל את השדה ואם מכר את השדה לאיש אחר לא יגאל עוד
verses.english: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
verses.romanian: și dacă he will nu a răscumpăra the câmp, sau dacă he au vândut the câmp to another om, it shall nu fi răscumpărat vreun more.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה השדה בצאתו ביובל קדש ליהוה כשדה החרם לכהן תהיה אחזתו
verses.english: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD, as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest's.
verses.romanian: dar the câmp, când it goeth out in the jubile, shall fi sfânt unto DOMNUL, as a câmp devoted; the stăpânire thereof shall fi the preot's.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם את שדה מקנתו אשר לא משדה אחזתו יקדיש איש ליהוה
verses.english: And if [a man] sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which [is] not of the fields of his possession;
verses.romanian: și dacă [a om] a sfinți unto DOMNUL a câmp care he sunt a cumpărat, care [este] nu of the câmpuri of lui stăpânire;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחשב לו הכהן את מכסות הערכך עד שנת היובל ונתן את הערכך ביום ההוא קדש ליהוה
verses.english: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, [even] unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, [as] a holy thing unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot shall reckon lui the worth of tău estimation, [even] unto the an of the jubile: și el să a da thine estimation in că zi, [as] a sfânt thing unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בשנת היובל ישוב השדה לאשר קנהו מאתו לאשר לו אחזת הארץ
verses.english: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, [even] to him to whom the possession of the land [did belong].
verses.romanian: In the an of the jubile the câmp shall a se întoarce lui of pe care it era a cumpărat, [even] to lui to pe care the stăpânire of the țară [a făcut belong].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל ערכך יהיה בשקל הקדש עשרים גרה השקל
verses.english: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.
verses.romanian: și toți tău estimations shall fi după the shekel of Sanctuarul: douăzeci gerahs shall fi the shekel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך כל בכור אשר יבכר ליהוה בבהמה לא יקדיש איש אתו אם שור אם שה ליהוה הוא
verses.english: But all the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD's firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether [it be] ox, or sheep: it [is] the LORD's.
verses.romanian: dar toți the firstling of the beasts, care should fi DOMNUL's firstling, no om shall a sfinți it; whether [it fi] bou, sau sheep: it [este] DOMNUL's.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בבהמה הטמאה ופדה בערכך ויסף חמישתו עליו ואם לא יגאל ונמכר בערכך
verses.english: And if [it be] of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem [it] according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth [part] of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.
verses.romanian: și dacă [it fi] of an necurat beast, atunci el să a răscumpăra [it] după thine estimation, și shall add a fifth [part] of it thereto: sau dacă it fi nu răscumpărat, atunci it shall fi vândut după tău estimation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך כל חרם אשר יחרם איש ליהוה מכל אשר לו מאדם ובהמה ומשדה אחזתו לא ימכר ולא יגאל כל חרם קדש קדשים הוא ליהוה
verses.english: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, [both] of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing [is] most holy unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, că a om shall devote unto DOMNUL of toți că he sunt, [both] of om și beast, și of the câmp of lui stăpânire, shall fi vândut sau răscumpărat: fiecare devoted thing [este] preasfânt unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל חרם אשר יחרם מן האדם לא יפדה מות יומת
verses.english: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; [but] shall surely be put to death.
verses.romanian: niciun devoted, care shall fi devoted of oameni, shall fi răscumpărat; [dar] shall negresit fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל מעשר הארץ מזרע הארץ ומפרי העץ ליהוה הוא קדש ליהוה
verses.english: And all the tithe of the land, and [whether] of the seed of the land, [or] of the fruit of the tree, [is] the LORD's: [it is] holy unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și toți the tithe of the țară, și [whether] of the sămânță of the țară, [sau] of the rod of the copac, [este] DOMNUL's: [it este] sfânt unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם גאל יגאל איש ממעשרו חמישתו יסף עליו
verses.english: And if a man will at all redeem [ought] of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth [part] thereof.
verses.romanian: și dacă a om will at toți a răscumpăra [ought] of lui tithes, el să add thereto the fifth [part] thereof.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל מעשר בקר וצאן כל אשר יעבר תחת השבט העשירי יהיה קדש ליהוה
verses.english: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, [even] of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și concerning the tithe of the cireadă, sau of the turmă, [even] of whatsoever passeth sub the rod, the tenth shall fi sfânt unto DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יבקר בין טוב לרע ולא ימירנו ואם המר ימירנו והיה הוא ותמירתו יהיה קדש לא יגאל
verses.english: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
verses.romanian: el să nu a cerceta whether it fi good sau bad, neither shall he change it: și dacă he change it at toți, atunci both it și the change thereof shall fi sfânt; it shall nu fi răscumpărat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה המצות אשר צוה יהוה את משה אל בני ישראל בהר סיני
verses.english: These [are] the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the porunci, care DOMNUL a poruncit Moise căci the copii of Israel in mount Sinai.
